statement:
@[simp] lemma whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap_id (x : Γ) :
    whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap A β (𝟙 x) = eqToHom (by simp [sigmaMap_id])

name: whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSimgaMap_comp_aux
statement:
lemma whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSimgaMap_comp_aux {A A' B B' C C' : Type*}
    [Category A] [Category A'] [Category B] [Category B'] [Category C] [Category C']
    (F : Functor.Iso A B) (G : Functor.Iso B C) (lamA : A ⥤ A') (lamB : B ⥤ B') (lamC : C ⥤ C')
    (F' : A' ⥤ B') (G' : B' ⥤ C')
    (lamF : lamA ⋙ F' ⟶ F.hom ⋙ lamB) (lamG : lamB ⋙ G' ⟶ G.hom ⋙ lamC)
    (H1 : A ⥤ C') (e1 : H1 = _) (H2 : A ⥤ C') (e2 : F.hom ⋙ G.hom ⋙ lamC = H2) :
    whiskerLeft (G.inv ⋙ F.inv)
      (eqToHom e1 ≫ whiskerRight lamF G' ≫ whiskerLeft F.hom lamG ≫ eqToHom e2) =
    eqToHom (by aesop) ≫
      whiskerRight (whiskerLeft G.inv (whiskerLeft F.inv lamF ≫ eqToHom (by simp))) G' ≫
      whiskerLeft G.inv lamG ≫
      eqToHom (by aesop)
proof:
:=
  calc _
    _ = eqToHom (by aesop) ≫
      (G.inv ⋙ F.inv).whiskerLeft (whiskerRight lamF G') ≫
      (G.inv ⋙ F.inv ⋙ F.hom).whiskerLeft lamG ≫
      eqToHom (by aesop) := by aesop
    _ = (eqToHom (by aesop)) ≫
      whiskerLeft (G.inv ⋙ F.inv) (whiskerRight lamF G') ≫
      eqToHom (by simp) ≫
      whiskerLeft G.inv lamG ≫
      eqToHom (by aesop) := by
        congr 2
        simp only [Functor.assoc, ← heq_eq_eq, heq_eqToHom_comp_iff, heq_comp_eqToHom_iff,
          comp_eqToHom_heq_iff]
        rw! (castMode := .all) [F.inv_hom_id, Functor.comp_id]
        simp
    _ = eqToHom (by aesop) ≫
      whiskerRight (whiskerLeft G.inv (whiskerLeft F.inv lamF ≫ eqToHom (by simp))) G' ≫
      whiskerLeft G.inv lamG ≫
      eqToHom (by aesop) := by aesop_cat

name: whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap_comp
statement:
lemma whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap_comp {x y z} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :
    whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap A β (f ≫ g)
    = eqToHom (by simp [Functor.assoc, sigmaMap_comp])
    ≫ whiskerRight (whiskerLeft (A.map (CategoryTheory.inv g))
      (whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap A β f)) (sigmaMap (β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) g)
    ≫ whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap A β g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap, lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap_comp]
  have hAfg : A.map (CategoryTheory.inv (f ≫ g)) = (Grpd.Functor.iso A g).inv ≫
    (Grpd.Functor.iso A f).inv := by simp [Grpd.Functor.iso]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [hAfg]
  erw [whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSimgaMap_comp_aux (Grpd.Functor.iso A f) (Grpd.Functor.iso A g)
    _ _ _ (sigmaMap (β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) f) (sigmaMap (β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) g)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, Grpd.Functor.iso_hom, Grpd.Functor.iso_inv]

name: lamMapFiber_id
statement: @[simp] lemma lamMapFiber_id (x : Γ) : lamMapFiber A β (𝟙 x) = eqToHom (by simp)

lemma lamMapFiber_comp {x y z} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :

name: lam_map_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lam_map_base {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) : ((lam A β).map f).base =
    piMap A (β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) f

name: lam_map_fib
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lam_map_fib {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) : ((lam A β).map f).fiber = lamMapFiber A β f

name: lam_comp_forgetToGrpd
statement: lemma lam_comp_forgetToGrpd : lam A β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd = pi A (β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd)

name: lam_naturality_aux
statement:
lemma lam_naturality_aux (x) :
    ι A (σ.obj x) ⋙ β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd = ι (σ ⋙ A) x ⋙ pre A σ ⋙ β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd

name: lamObjFiberObj_naturality
statement:
lemma lamObjFiberObj_naturality (x) :
    lamObjFiberObj A β (σ.obj x) ≍ lamObjFiberObj (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lamObjFiberObj, ← ι_comp_pre, comp_obj, Functor.assoc]
  congr!

name: lam_naturality_obj_aux
statement:
lemma lam_naturality_obj_aux (x) :
    Grpd.of (A.obj (σ.obj x) ⥤ sigmaObj (β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) (σ.obj x)) ≍
    Grpd.of (A.obj (σ.obj x) ⥤ sigmaObj ((pre A σ ⋙ β) ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) x)

name: lam_naturality_obj
statement:
theorem lam_naturality_obj (x : Δ) : HEq (lamObjFiber A β (σ.obj x))
    (lamObjFiber (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lamObjFiber]
  apply Grpd.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.hext (lam_naturality_obj_aux A β σ x)
  · simp only [sigma.fstAuxObj, Functor.assoc]
    congr!
    any_goals simp [lam_naturality_aux]
  · apply lamObjFiberObj_naturality

name: lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap.app_naturality
statement:
lemma lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap.app_naturality {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) (a) :
    lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap.app A β (σ.map f) a ≍
    lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap.app (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β) f a
proof:
:= by
  apply Hom.hext'
  any_goals apply Grpd.Functor.hcongr_obj
  any_goals apply Grpd.comp_hcongr
  any_goals simp only [comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, heq_eq_eq]
  any_goals apply sigmaObj_naturality
  any_goals apply lam_naturality_aux
  any_goals apply sigmaMap_naturality_heq
  any_goals apply lamObjFiberObj_naturality
  any_goals simp [app]; rfl

name: lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap_naturality
statement:
lemma lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap_naturality {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap A β (σ.map f) ≍
    lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β) f
proof:
:= by
  apply Grpd.NatTrans.hext
  any_goals apply Grpd.comp_hcongr
  any_goals simp only [comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, heq_eq_eq, eqToHom_refl]
  any_goals apply sigmaObj_naturality
  any_goals apply lamObjFiberObj_naturality
  · apply sigmaMap_naturality_heq
  · apply lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap.app_naturality

name: whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap_naturality_heq
statement:
lemma whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap_naturality_heq {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap A β (σ.map f) ≍
    whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β) f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [whiskerLeftInvLamObjObjSigMap, Functor.comp_map]
  apply HEq.trans (comp_eqToHom_heq _ _)
  apply HEq.trans _ (comp_eqToHom_heq _ _).symm
  rw [Functor.map_inv, Functor.map_inv, Functor.map_inv]
  apply Grpd.whiskerLeft_hcongr_right
  any_goals apply Grpd.comp_hcongr
  any_goals simp only [comp_obj, heq_eq_eq]
  any_goals apply sigmaObj_naturality
  any_goals apply lamObjFiberObj_naturality
  · apply sigmaMap_naturality_heq
  · apply lamObjFiberObjCompSigMap_naturality

name: lam_naturality_map
statement:
lemma lam_naturality_map {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    lamMapFiber A β (σ.map f) ≍ lamMapFiber (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β) f

name: lam_naturality
statement: theorem lam_naturality : σ ⋙ lam A β = lam (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ β)
proof:
:= by
  apply PGrpd.Functor.hext
  · apply pi_naturality
  · apply lam_naturality_obj
  · apply lam_naturality_map

name: lamObjFiberObj_inversion_heq
statement:
lemma lamObjFiberObj_inversion_heq (x) :
    lamObjFiberObj A (pi.inversion B s hs) x ≍ (PGrpd.objFiber' hs x).obj
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [lamObjFiberObj]
  rw! [pi.inversion_comp_forgetToGrpd B s hs]
  simp only [sec_eq_lift, Grpd.forgetToCat.eq_1, heq_eq_eq]
  symm
  apply Functor.IsPullback.lift_uniq
  · symm
    apply pi.ι_comp_inversion
  · exact (PGrpd.objFiber' hs x).property

name: lamObjFiber_inversion_heq'
statement:
lemma lamObjFiber_inversion_heq' (x) :
    lamObjFiber A (pi.inversion B s hs) x ≍ PGrpd.objFiber' hs x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [pi_obj]
  apply piObj.hext
  · rfl
  · simp [pi.inversion_comp_forgetToGrpd]
  · apply lamObjFiberObj_inversion_heq

name: lamObjFiber_inversion_heq
statement:
lemma lamObjFiber_inversion_heq (x) :
    lamObjFiber A (pi.inversion B s hs) x ≍ PGrpd.objFiber s x
proof:
:=
  HEq.trans (lamObjFiber_inversion_heq' A B s hs x) (PGrpd.objFiber'_heq hs)

name: pi.eta
statement: lemma pi.eta : lam A (inversion B s hs) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply PGrpd.Functor.hext 
  · rw [lam_comp_forgetToGrpd, inversion_comp_forgetToGrpd, hs]
  · apply lamObjFiber_inversion_heq
  · apply lamMapFiber_inversion_heq

name: Pi_app_eq
statement:
lemma Pi_app_eq {Γ : Ctx} (ab : y(Γ) ⟶ _) : ab ≫ Pi =
    yonedaCategoryEquiv.symm (FunctorOperation.pi _ (smallU.PtpEquiv.snd ab))

name: lam_app_eq
statement:
lemma lam_app_eq {Γ : Ctx} (ab : y(Γ) ⟶ smallU.Ptp.obj smallU.Tm) : ab ≫ lam =
    yonedaCategoryEquiv.symm (FunctorOperation.lam _ (smallU.PtpEquiv.snd ab))

name: smallUSig.pair_tp
statement:
theorem smallUSig.pair_tp : smallUSig.pair.{v} ≫ smallU.{v}.tp =
    smallU.comp.{v} ≫ smallUSig.Sig.{v}
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_yoneda
  intros Γ ab
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, smallUSig.pair_app_eq,
    smallUSig.Sig_app_eq, smallU_tp, π,
    ← yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_right,
    pair_comp_forgetToGrpd, smallUSig.Sig_app]
  congr 2
  · rw [fst_forgetToGrpd]
  · exact dependent_heq.{v} ab

name: lam_tp
statement: theorem lam_tp : smallUPi.lam ≫ smallU.tp = smallU.Ptp.map smallU.tp ≫ Pi
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_yoneda
  intros Γ ab
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, lam_app_eq, Pi_app_eq, smallU_tp, π,
    ← yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_right, lam_comp_forgetToGrpd]
  symm; congr 2
  · apply smallU.PtpEquiv.fst_app_comp_map_tp
  · apply smallU.PtpEquiv.snd_app_comp_map_tp

name: yonedaCategoryEquiv_forgetToGrpd
statement:
theorem yonedaCategoryEquiv_forgetToGrpd : yonedaCategoryEquiv s ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd
    = pi (smallU.PtpEquiv.fst AB) (smallU.PtpEquiv.snd AB)
proof:
:= by
  erw [← yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_right, hs]
  rw [smallUPi.Pi_app_eq, yonedaCategoryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: fac_left
statement: theorem fac_left : lift.{v} AB s hs ≫ lam.{v} = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [lam_app_eq, yonedaCategoryEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  dsimp only [lift]
  conv => left; right; rw! [smallU.PtpEquiv.snd_mk]
  rw! [smallU.PtpEquiv.fst_mk]
  simp [map_id_eq, pi.eta]

name: isPullback
proof:
:=
  Limits.RepPullbackCone.is_pullback lam_tp
    (fun s => lift.{v, max u (v+1)} s.snd s.fst s.condition)
    (fun s => fac_left.{v, max u (v+1)} s.snd s.fst s.condition)
    (fun s => fac_right.{v, max u (v+1)} s.snd s.fst s.condition)
    (fun s m hml hmr =>
      hom_ext.{v, max u (v+1)} m (lift.{v, max u (v+1)} s.snd s.fst s.condition)
      (by rw [hmr, fac_right.{v, max u (v+1)}]) (by rw [hml, fac_left.{v, max u (v+1)}]))

name: yonedaCatEquiv_yonedaEquivSymm
yonedaCatEquiv_naturality_left
statement:
theorem yonedaCatEquiv_naturality_left
    (A : yoneda.obj Γ ⟶ yonedaCat.obj C) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) :
    yonedaCatEquiv (yoneda.map σ ≫ A) =
    (Ctx.toGrpd.map σ) ⋙ yonedaCatEquiv A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [yonedaCatEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, ← yonedaEquiv_naturality]
  rfl

name: yonedaCatEquiv_naturality_right
statement:
theorem yonedaCatEquiv_naturality_right
    (A : yoneda.obj Γ ⟶ yonedaCat.obj D) (U : D ⥤ C) :
    yonedaCatEquiv (A ≫ yonedaCat.map U) = yonedaCatEquiv A ⋙ U

name: yonedaCatEquiv_symm_naturality_left
statement:
theorem yonedaCatEquiv_symm_naturality_left
    (A : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ C) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) :
    yoneda.map σ ≫ yonedaCatEquiv.symm A =
    yonedaCatEquiv.symm (Ctx.toGrpd.map σ ⋙ A)

name: yonedaCatEquiv_symm_naturality_right
statement:
theorem yonedaCatEquiv_symm_naturality_right
    (A : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ D) (U : D ⥤ C) :
    yonedaCatEquiv.symm (A ⋙ U) =
    yonedaCatEquiv.symm A ≫ yonedaCat.map U

name: yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left'
statement:
theorem yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left' (A : y(Γ) ⟶ y(Ctx.ofCategory C))
    {σ : y(Δ) ⟶ y(Γ)} : yonedaCategoryEquiv (σ ≫ A) =
    Ctx.toGrpd.map (Yoneda.fullyFaithful.preimage σ)
    ⋙ yonedaCategoryEquiv A
proof:
:= by
  have h : σ = ym(Yoneda.fullyFaithful.preimage σ) := by simp
  rw [h, yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left]
  rfl

name: yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_left
statement:
theorem yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_left {A : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ C} :
    yonedaCategoryEquiv.symm (Ctx.toGrpd.map σ ⋙ A) = ym(σ) ≫ yonedaCategoryEquiv.symm A

name: smallU_lift
statement:
theorem smallU_lift {Γ Δ : Ctx} (A : y(Γ) ⟶ smallU.{v}.Ty)
    (fst : y(Δ) ⟶ smallU.{v}.Tm) (snd : Δ ⟶ Γ)
    (w : fst ≫ smallU.{v}.tp = ym(snd) ≫ A) :
    (smallU.{v}.disp_pullback A).lift fst ym(snd) w =
    ym(Ctx.ofGrpd.map ((Functor.Groupoidal.isPullback _).lift
      (yonedaCategoryEquiv fst)
      (Ctx.toGrpd.map snd)
      (by erw [← yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_right, w,
        yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left])))
proof:
:= by
  apply (smallU.{v}.disp_pullback A).hom_ext
  · dsimp only [smallU_var]
    erw [← yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_left,
      (Functor.Groupoidal.isPullback (yonedaCategoryEquiv A)).fac_left,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simp
  · simp only [smallU_ext, smallU_Tm, smallU_Ty, smallU_var, Grpd.coe_of,
      smallU_disp,
      smallU_tp, IsPullback.lift_snd, ← Functor.map_comp, Grpd.comp_eq_comp,
      smallU.disp]
    erw [(isPullback (yonedaCategoryEquiv A)).fac_right, AsSmall.down_map_up_map]

name: toGrpd_obj_ofGrpd_obj
statement: @[simp] lemma toGrpd_obj_ofGrpd_obj (x) : toGrpd.obj (ofGrpd.obj x) = x

name: ofGrpd_obj_toGrpd_obj
statement: @[simp] lemma ofGrpd_obj_toGrpd_obj (x) : ofGrpd.obj (toGrpd.obj x) = x

name: toGrpd_map_ofGrpd_map
statement: @[simp] lemma toGrpd_map_ofGrpd_map {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) : toGrpd.map (ofGrpd.map f) = f

name: ofGrpd_map_toGrpd_map
statement: @[simp] lemma ofGrpd_map_toGrpd_map {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) : ofGrpd.map (toGrpd.map f) = f

name: map_eqToHom_toPGrpd
statement:
theorem map_eqToHom_toPGrpd {Γ : Type*} [Category Γ] (A A' : Γ ⥤ Grpd) (h : A = A'):
    map (eqToHom h) ⋙ toPGrpd A' = toPGrpd A

name: smallU_substWk
statement:
theorem smallU_substWk (A : y(Γ) ⟶ smallU.{v}.Ty) (σA eq) : smallU.substWk σ A σA eq =
    (Ctx.ofGrpd.map $ Grpd.homOf $ yonedaCategoryEquivPre σ A σA eq)
proof:
:= by
  apply Yoneda.fullyFaithful.map_injective
  apply (smallU.disp_pullback A).hom_ext
  · conv => right; erw [← yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_left]
    rw [substWk_var, smallU_var, yonedaCategoryEquivPre, Ctx.toGrpd_map_ofGrpd_map,
      Functor.assoc, pre_toPGrpd, Grothendieck.Groupoidal.map_eqToHom_toPGrpd]
    dsimp only [smallU_Ty, smallU_ext, smallU.var]
  · conv => left; rw [← Functor.map_comp, substWk_disp]
    simp only [smallU_disp, ← Functor.map_comp, Grpd.homOf, yonedaCategoryEquivPre,
      Grpd.comp_eq_comp, Functor.assoc, smallU.disp]
    rw [pre_comp_forget, ← Functor.assoc, map_forget]
    rfl

name: smallU_sec
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallU_sec {Γ : Ctx} (α : y(Γ) ⟶ smallU.{v}.Tm) :
    smallU.sec _ α rfl = Ctx.ofGrpd.map (sec _ (yonedaCategoryEquiv α) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  apply Yoneda.fullyFaithful.map_injective
  apply (smallU.disp_pullback _).hom_ext
  . erw [Universe.sec_var, smallU_var, ← yonedaCategoryEquiv_symm_naturality_left,
      Equiv.eq_symm_apply, Ctx.toGrpd_map_ofGrpd_map, sec_toPGrpd]
    rfl
  . rw [← Functor.map_comp, sec_disp]
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, smallU_Tm, smallU_Ty, smallU_tp, smallU_ext,
      smallU_disp, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl

name: fst_comp_right
statement:
theorem fst_comp_right {D : Type (v + 1)} [Category.{v, v + 1} D] (F : C ⥤ D) :
    fst (AB ≫ smallU.Ptp.map ym(Ctx.homOfFunctor F)) = fst (AB)

name: hext
statement:
theorem hext (AB1 AB2 : y(Γ) ⟶ smallU.{v}.Ptp.obj y(U.{v})) (hfst : fst AB1 = fst AB2)
    (hsnd : HEq (snd AB1) (snd AB2)) : AB1 = AB2
proof:
:= by
  have hfst' : Universe.PtpEquiv.fst smallU AB1 = Universe.PtpEquiv.fst smallU AB2 := by
    dsimp [fst] at hfst
    aesop
  apply Universe.PtpEquiv.ext smallU (yonedaCategoryEquiv.symm (fst AB2)) ?_ hfst' ?_
  · simpa [fst]
  · dsimp [snd] at hsnd
    rw! (castMode := .all) [hfst'] at hsnd
    simp only [smallU_Ty, eqRec_heq_iff_heq, heq_eq_eq, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at hsnd
    exact hsnd

name: fst_mk
statement:
lemma fst_mk (A : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ Grpd.{v,v}) (B : ∫(A) ⥤ C) :
    fst (mk A B) = A

name: Grpd.eqToHom_comp_heq
statement:
lemma Grpd.eqToHom_comp_heq {A B : Grpd} {C : Type*} [Category C]
    (h : A = B) (F : B ⥤ C) : eqToHom h ⋙ F ≍ F

name: snd_mk_heq
statement:
lemma snd_mk_heq (A : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ Grpd.{v,v}) (B : ∫(A) ⥤ C) :
    snd (mk A B) ≍ B
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [snd, mk]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [Universe.PtpEquiv.fst_mk, Universe.PtpEquiv.snd_mk]
  simp

name: snd_mk
statement:
lemma snd_mk (A : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ Grpd.{v,v}) (B : ∫(A) ⥤ C) :
    snd (mk A B) = map (eqToHom (fst_mk A B)) ⋙ B
proof:
:= by
  have : _ = map (eqToHom (fst_mk A B)) := eqToHom_eq_homOf_map (fst_mk A B)
  rw [← this]
  apply eq_of_heq; apply (snd_mk_heq A B).trans; symm; apply Grpd.eqToHom_comp_heq

name: snd_forgetToGrpd
statement: theorem snd_forgetToGrpd : snd ab ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd = sec _ (fst ab) rfl ⋙ (dependent ab)
proof:
:= by
  erw [← yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_right, Universe.compDomEquiv.snd_tp ab,
    smallU_sec, yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left]
  rfl

name: fst_forgetToGrpd
statement:
theorem fst_forgetToGrpd : fst ab ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd =
    smallU.PtpEquiv.fst (ab ≫ comp.{v})
proof:
:= by
  erw [smallU.PtpEquiv.fst, ← compDomEquiv.fst_tp ab, ← yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_right]
  rfl

name: dependent_eq
statement:
theorem dependent_eq : dependent ab =
    map (eqToHom (fst_forgetToGrpd ab)) ⋙ smallU.PtpEquiv.snd (ab ≫ comp.{v})
proof:
:= by
  conv => rhs; rw! (castMode := .all) [← fst_forgetToGrpd]
  erw [eqToHom_refl, map_id_eq, Functor.id_comp]
  simp only [← heq_eq_eq, heq_eqRec_iff_heq, dependent, compDomEquiv.dependent, PtpEquiv.snd, comp]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [compDomEquiv.fst_tp]
  simp; rfl

name: dependent_heq
statement: theorem dependent_heq : HEq (dependent ab) (smallU.PtpEquiv.snd (ab ≫ comp.{v}))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dependent_eq]
  apply Functor.precomp_heq_of_heq_id
  · rw [fst_forgetToGrpd]
  · rw [fst_forgetToGrpd]
  · apply map_eqToHom_heq_id_cod

name: fst_naturality
statement: theorem fst_naturality : fst (ym(σ) ≫ ab) = Ctx.toGrpd.map σ ⋙ fst ab
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [fst]
  rw [← Universe.compDomEquiv.comp_fst, yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left]

name: dependent_naturality
statement:
theorem dependent_naturality : dependent (ym(σ) ≫ ab) =
    map (eqToHom (by rw [fst_naturality, Functor.assoc]))
    ⋙ pre _ (Ctx.toGrpd.map σ) ⋙ dependent ab
proof:
:= by
  rw [dependent, dependent,
    ← Universe.compDomEquiv.comp_dependent (eq1 := rfl)
      (eq2 := by simp [← compDomEquiv.comp_fst]),
    smallU_substWk, yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left,
    Ctx.toGrpd_map_ofGrpd_map, yonedaCategoryEquivPre, Grpd.homOf_comp,
    Grpd.comp_eq_comp, Grpd.homOf]
  simp [Functor.assoc]; rfl

name: snd_naturality
statement: theorem snd_naturality : snd (ym(σ) ≫ ab) = Ctx.toGrpd.map σ ⋙ snd ab
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [snd]
  rw [← Universe.compDomEquiv.comp_snd, yonedaCategoryEquiv_naturality_left]

name: fst_mk
statement:
theorem fst_mk (α : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ PGrpd.{v,v})
    (B : ∫(α ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) ⥤ Grpd.{v,v}) (β : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ PGrpd.{v,v})
    (h : β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd = sec _ α rfl ⋙ B)
    : fst (mk α B β h) = α

name: snd_mk
statement:
theorem snd_mk (α : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ PGrpd.{v,v})
    (B : ∫(α ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd) ⥤ Grpd.{v,v}) (β : Ctx.toGrpd.obj Γ ⥤ PGrpd.{v,v})
    (h : β ⋙ PGrpd.forgetToGrpd = sec _ α rfl ⋙ B)
    : snd (mk α B β h) = β

name: toE''_
statement:
theorem toE''_π'' : Cat.homOf toE''.{v,u} ≫ Cat.homOf π''.{v+1, max u (v+2)} =
  Cat.homOf π''.{v, max u (v+2)} ≫ Cat.homOf toU''.{v,u}

name: isPullback_
statement:
theorem isPullback_π''_π'' :
    IsPullback
      (Cat.homOf toE''.{v,max u (v+2)})
      (Cat.homOf π''.{_,max u (v+2)})
      (Cat.homOf π''.{v+1,max u (v+2)})
      (Cat.homOf toU''.{v,max u (v+2)})

name: isPullback_y
statement:
theorem isPullback_yπ_yπ :
    IsPullback ym(toE.{v,max u (v+2)}) ym(π.{v, max u (v+2)})
      ym(π.{v+1,max u (v+2)}) ym(toU.{v,max u (v+2)})

name: isPullback_disp'_asSmallForgetToGrpd
statement:
theorem isPullback_disp'_asSmallForgetToGrpd :
    IsPullback
      (Cat.homOf (toPGrpd (classifier A) ⋙ AsSmall.up))
      (Cat.homOf (Functor.Grothendieck.forget
        (classifier A ⋙ Grpd.forgetToCat)))
      (Cat.homOf $ AsSmall.down ⋙ forgetToGrpd ⋙ AsSmall.up)
      (Cat.homOf (Ctx.toGrpd.map A ⋙
        Core.inclusion (AsSmall Grpd)))
proof:
:=
  Cat.isPullback rfl $ Functor.IsPullback.ofIso'
    (toPGrpd (classifier A))
    (Functor.Grothendieck.forget (classifier A ⋙ Grpd.forgetToCat))
    forgetToGrpd
    (classifier A)
    (Functor.Groupoidal.isPullback (classifier A))
    (toPGrpd (classifier A) ⋙ AsSmall.up)
    (Functor.Grothendieck.forget (classifier A ⋙ Grpd.forgetToCat))
    (AsSmall.down ⋙ forgetToGrpd ⋙ AsSmall.up)
    (Ctx.toGrpd.map A ⋙ Core.inclusion (AsSmall Grpd))
    (Functor.Iso.refl _)
    AsSmall.downIso
    (Functor.Iso.refl _)
    AsSmall.downIso
    rfl
    rfl
    rfl
    rfl

name: isPullback_coreDisp'_
statement:
theorem isPullback_coreDisp'_π' :
  IsPullback
    (coreVar' A)
    (coreDisp' A)
    (Grpd.homOf π''.core)
    (coreA A)

name: isPullback_disp'_coreDisp'
statement:
theorem isPullback_disp'_coreDisp' :
  IsPullback
    (Grpd.homOf (Core.functorToCore (Functor.id _)))
    (disp' A)
    (coreDisp' A)
    (Grpd.homOf (Core.functorToCore (Functor.id _)))

name: isPullback_disp'_
statement:
theorem isPullback_disp'_π' :
  IsPullback
    (Grpd.homOf (Core.functorToCore (toPGrpd (classifier A) ⋙ AsSmall.up)))
    (disp' A)
    (Grpd.homOf π''.core)
    (Ctx.toGrpd.map A)
proof:
:= by
  convert IsPullback.paste_horiz
    (isPullback_disp'_coreDisp' A) (isPullback_coreDisp'_π' A)
  convert_to Ctx.toGrpd.map A =
    Grpd.homOf (Core.functorToCore (𝟭 Γ.1)) ≫
      Core.map.map (Cat.homOf (Ctx.toGrpd.map A))
      ≫ Core.map.map (Cat.homOf (Core.inclusion (AsSmall Grpd)))
  have h := Core.adjunction.unit.naturality (Ctx.toGrpd.map A)
  simp only [AsSmall.down_obj, Grpd.forgetToCat, Ctx.equivalence,
    Core.adjunction, Functor.comp_map, id_eq, ← Category.assoc, Ctx.toGrpd] at *
  rw [← h]
  rfl

name: liftVar_lt_add

name: comp_wU
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_wU (Δ Γ : Ctx) (σ : y(Δ) ⟶ y(Γ)) : σ ≫ wU = wU

name: Context.typed.val_cast
statement:

lemma Context.typed.val_cast {Γ : Context Ctx} {A B : Γ.ty} (h : A = B) (x : Γ.typed A) :

name: Context.cons_fst

name: substCons_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem substCons_var {Γ Δ : Ctx} (σ : y(Γ) ⟶ y(Δ))
    (e : y(Γ) ⟶ Tm) (A : y(Δ) ⟶ Ty) (eTy : e ≫ tp = σ ≫ A) :
    substCons σ e A eTy ≫ var _ _ = e

name: substCons_disp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem substCons_disp {Γ Δ : Ctx} (σ : y(Γ) ⟶ y(Δ))

name: comp_substUnit
statement:
theorem comp_substUnit {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : y(Δ) ⟶ y(Γ)) (f : Γ ⟶ ⊤_ Ctx) (f' : Δ ⟶ ⊤_ Ctx) :
    σ ≫ yoneda.map f = yoneda.map f'

name: comp_substCons
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_substCons {Γ Γ' Δ : Ctx} (τ : y(Γ') ⟶ y(Γ)) (σ : y(Γ) ⟶ y(Δ))
    (e : y(Γ) ⟶ Tm) (A : y(Δ) ⟶ Ty) (eTy : e ≫ tp = σ ≫ A) :
    τ ≫ substCons σ e A eTy = substCons (τ ≫ σ) (τ ≫ e) A (by simp [eTy])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substCons, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp

name: substSnd_ty
statement:
theorem substSnd_ty {Γ Δ : Ctx} {A : y(Δ) ⟶ Ty} (σ : y(Γ) ⟶ y(ext Δ A)) :
    substSnd σ ≫ tp = substFst σ ≫ A

name: comp_mkEl
statement:
theorem comp_mkEl {Δ Γ : Context Ctx} (σ : y(Δ.1) ⟶ y(Γ.1)) (A : Γ.typed wU) :
    σ ≫ mkEl A = mkEl ((A.subst σ).cast (comp_wU ..))
proof:
:= by
  simp [mkEl]; rw [← Category.assoc, comp_substCons]; congr 2; apply comp_substUnit

name: comp_mkPi
statement:
theorem comp_mkPi {Γ Δ : Context Ctx} (σ : y(Δ.1) ⟶ y(Γ.1)) (A : Γ.ty) (B : (Γ.cons A).ty) :
    σ ≫ mkPi A B = mkPi (σ ≫ A) (weakSubst σ A ≫ B)

name: comp_mkLam'
statement:
theorem comp_mkLam' {Γ Δ : Context Ctx} (σ : y(Δ.1) ⟶ y(Γ.1)) (A : Γ.ty) (B : (Γ.cons A).tm) :
    σ ≫ mkLam' A B = mkLam' (σ ≫ A) (weakSubst σ A ≫ B)

name: Context.comp_subst
comp_mkLam
statement:
theorem comp_mkLam {Γ Δ : Context Ctx} (σ : y(Δ.1) ⟶ y(Γ.1))
    (A : Γ.ty) (B : (Γ.cons A).ty) (e : (Γ.cons A).typed B) :
    σ ≫ (mkLam A B e).1 =
      (mkLam (σ ≫ A) (weakSubst σ A ≫ B) (e.subst (Δ := (Δ.cons (σ ≫ A))) (weakSubst σ A))).1

name: mkPApp'_aux_tp
statement:
theorem mkPApp'_aux_tp {Γ : Ctx} (A : y(Γ) ⟶ Ty) (B : y(ext Γ A) ⟶ Ty)
    (f : y(Γ) ⟶ Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ tp = mkP A B ≫ NaturalModelPi.Pi) :
    let p
proof:
:= mkPApp'_aux A B f f_tp
    (⟨p.1, p.2 ≫ tp⟩ : (A : y(Γ) ⟶ Ty) × (y(ext Γ A) ⟶ Ty)) = ⟨A, B⟩ := by
  unfold mkPApp'_aux
  set g := NaturalModelPi.Pi_pullback.isLimit.lift (PullbackCone.mk f (mkP A B) f_tp)
  intro p
  apply mkP_equiv.symm.injective
  have : g ≫ (P tp).map tp = mkP A B :=
    NaturalModelPi.Pi_pullback.isLimit.fac _ (some .right)
  show mkP p.1 (p.2 ≫ tp) = mkP A B
  rw [← mkP_app]
  simp [mkP, p, this]

name: mkPApp'_aux_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkPApp'_aux_fst {Γ : Ctx} (A : y(Γ) ⟶ Ty) (B : y(ext Γ A) ⟶ Ty)
    (f : y(Γ) ⟶ Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ tp = mkP A B ≫ NaturalModelPi.Pi) :
    (mkPApp'_aux A B f f_tp).fst = A

name: mkPApp'_aux_snd_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkPApp'_aux_snd_tp {Γ : Ctx} (A : y(Γ) ⟶ Ty) (B : y(ext Γ A) ⟶ Ty)
    (f : y(Γ) ⟶ Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ tp = mkP A B ≫ NaturalModelPi.Pi) :
    (mkPApp'_aux A B f f_tp).snd ≫ tp = eqToHom (by simp) ≫ B
proof:
:= by
  have h := mkPApp'_aux_tp A B f f_tp
  simp only [Sigma.mk.inj_iff, mkPApp'_aux_fst, true_and] at h
  set B' := eqToHom _ ≫ B
  have : HEq B B' := by 
    simp only [B']
    set pf := of_eq_true _
    . clear_value pf
      have := mkPApp'_aux_fst A B f f_tp
      generalize (mkPApp'_aux A B f f_tp).fst = x at pf this
      cases this
      simp
    . simp
  exact eq_of_heq (h.trans this)

name: comp_mkPApp
statement:
theorem comp_mkPApp {Γ Δ : Context Ctx} (σ : y(Δ.1) ⟶ y(Γ.1)) (A : Γ.ty) (B : (Γ.cons A).ty)
    (f : Γ.typed (mkPi A B)) :
    weakSubst σ A ≫ (mkPApp A B f).1 =
    (mkPApp (σ ≫ A) (weakSubst σ A ≫ B) ((f.subst σ).cast (comp_mkPi ..))).1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mkPApp, Context.typed.val_cast, Context.typed.subst_coe]
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [eqToHom_naturality _ (mkPApp'_aux_fst ..).symm]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr! 1
  . congr 2
    rw [comp_mkPApp'_aux]
  . congr! 1
  . rw [comp_mkPApp'_aux]

name: comp_mkApp
statement:
theorem comp_mkApp {Γ Δ : Context Ctx} (σ : y(Δ.1) ⟶ y(Γ.1)) (A : Γ.ty) (B : (Γ.cons A).ty)
    (f : Γ.typed (mkPi A B)) (a : Γ.typed A) :
    σ ≫ (mkApp A B f a).1 =
    (mkApp (σ ≫ A) (weakSubst σ A ≫ B) ((f.subst σ).cast (comp_mkPi ..)) (a.subst σ)).1

name: ofTerm_app
statement:
theorem ofTerm_app (Γ : Context Ctx) {f a e'} :
    e' ∈ ofTerm Γ (.app B f a) ↔
      ∃ f' ∈ ofTerm Γ f, ∃ a' ∈ ofTerm Γ a, ∃ t', ∃ ht' : a' ≫ tp = t',
      ∃ B' ∈ ofType (Γ.cons t') B, ∃ hB : f' ≫ tp = mkPi t' B',
      e' = (mkApp _ B' ⟨f', hB⟩ ⟨a', ht'⟩).1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofTerm, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff, Part.mem_assert_iff,
    Part.mem_some_iff]
  exact ⟨
    fun ⟨_, hf, _, ha, _, hB, H, e⟩ => ⟨_, hf, _, ha, _, rfl, _, hB, H, e⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hf, _, ha, _, rfl, _, hB, H, e⟩ => ⟨_, hf, _, ha, _, hB, H, e⟩⟩

name: Context.dispN_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem Context.dispN_cons (Γ : Context Ctx) (A : Γ.ty) (X : Γ.tyN k) :
    (Γ.cons A).dispN X.up = weakSubst (Γ.dispN X) A

name: Context.consN_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem Context.consN_cons (Γ : Context Ctx) (A : Γ.ty) (X : Γ.tyN k) :
    (Γ.cons A).consN X.up = (Γ.consN X).cons (Γ.dispN X ≫ A)

name: ofType_liftN
statement:
theorem ofType_liftN {k : Nat} {Γ : Context Ctx} :
  ∀ {A A'} (X : Γ.tyN k), A' ∈ ofType Γ A → Context.dispN Γ X ≫ A' ∈ ofType (Γ.consN X) (A.liftN 1 k)
  | .univ, _, _, H => by
    simp only [ofType, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.mem_some_iff] at H
    subst H; simp only [TyExpr.liftN, ofType, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.mem_some_iff]; apply comp_wU
  | .pi A B, _, X, H => by
    simp only [ofType, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff,
      Part.mem_some_iff] at H
    obtain ⟨A', hA, B', hB, rfl⟩
proof:
:= H
    simp only [TyExpr.liftN, ofType, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff,
      Part.mem_some_iff]
    refine ⟨_, ofType_liftN X hA, _, ofType_liftN X.up hB, ?_⟩
    apply comp_mkPi
  | .el A, _, X, H => by
    simp only [ofType, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff, Part.mem_assert_iff,
      Part.mem_some_iff] at H
    obtain ⟨A', hA, ha, rfl⟩ := H
    simp only [TyExpr.liftN, ofType, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff,
      Part.mem_assert_iff, Part.mem_some_iff]
    refine ⟨_, ofTerm_liftN X hA, by simp [ha], ?_⟩
    simp only [mkEl, ← Category.assoc]; congr 1
    rw [comp_substCons]; congr 1; apply comp_substUnit

name: ofTerm_liftN
statement:
theorem ofTerm_liftN {k : Nat} {Γ : Context Ctx} : ∀ {e e'} (X : Γ.tyN k),
    e' ∈ ofTerm Γ e → Context.dispN Γ X ≫ e' ∈ ofTerm (Γ.consN X) (e.liftN 1 k)
  | .bvar n, e', ⟨hX, X⟩, H => by
    let ⟨Γ, S⟩
proof:
:= Γ
    simp only [Expr.liftN, ofTerm, Context.var, Context.consN, Context.dispN] at H ⊢
    dsimp [Context.tm] at X hX e'
    induction k generalizing n Γ with
    | zero =>
      simp only [CtxStack.dropN, CtxStack.extN, Context.cons, liftVar_base', CtxStack.var,
        Part.map_eq_map, Part.mem_map_iff]
      exact ⟨_, H, rfl⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain _ | ⟨A, S⟩ := S; · nomatch hX
      cases n with simp only [CtxStack.var, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.mem_some_iff, Part.map_eq_map,
        Part.mem_map_iff] at H
      | zero =>
        subst e'
        simp only [CtxStack.extN, weakSubst, substCons_var, liftVar_zero, CtxStack.var,
          Part.pure_eq_some, Part.mem_some_iff]
      | succ n =>
        obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := H
        simp only [CtxStack.extN, liftVar_succ, CtxStack.var, Part.map_eq_map, Part.mem_map_iff]
        refine ⟨_, ih n _ S e (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hX) X he, ?_⟩
        simp only [Context.weak, weakSubst, substCons_disp_assoc, Category.assoc]
  | .app B f a, _, X, H => by
    simp only [ofTerm_app, Expr.liftN] at H ⊢
    obtain ⟨f', hf, a', ha, _, rfl, B, hB, h, rfl⟩ := H
    refine ⟨_, ofTerm_liftN X hf, _, ofTerm_liftN X ha,
      Γ.dispN X ≫ a' ≫ tp, by simp, _, ofType_liftN X.up hB, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Category.assoc, h, comp_mkPi, Context.dispN_cons]
    · rw [comp_mkApp]; rfl
  | .lam t e, _, X, H => by
    simp only [ofTerm, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff,
      Part.mem_some_iff, Expr.liftN] at H ⊢
    obtain ⟨t', ht, e', he, rfl⟩ := H
    refine ⟨_, ofType_liftN X ht, _, ofTerm_liftN X.up he, ?_⟩
    simp only [comp_mkLam]; rfl
  | .pi A B, _, X, H => by
    simp only [ofTerm, Part.pure_eq_some, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.mem_bind_iff,
      Part.mem_assert_iff, Part.mem_some_iff, Expr.liftN] at H ⊢
    obtain ⟨A', hA, HA, B', hB, HB, rfl⟩ := H
    refine ⟨_, ofTerm_liftN X hA, ?_, _, ?_, ?_, comp_mkSmallPi ..⟩
    · simp only [Category.assoc, HA, comp_wU]
    · have : ∀ A'' (h : Γ.dispN X ≫ mkEl ⟨A', HA⟩ = A''),
        eqToHom (h ▸ rfl) ≫ weakSubst (Γ.dispN X) (mkEl ⟨A', HA⟩) ≫ B' ∈
          ofTerm ((Γ.consN X).cons A'') (Expr.liftN 1 B (k + 1)) := by
        rintro _ rfl; exact ofTerm_liftN X.up hB
      exact this _ (comp_mkEl ..)
    · simp only [weakSubst', Context.typed.subst_coe, Category.assoc, HB, comp_wU]

name: ofType_lift
statement:
theorem ofType_lift {Γ : Context Ctx} {A A'} (X : Γ.ty) (H : A' ∈ ofType Γ A) :
    Context.weak Γ X A' ∈ ofType (Γ.cons X) A.lift

name: ofTerm_lift
statement:
theorem ofTerm_lift {Γ : Context Ctx} {e e'} (X : Γ.ty) (H : e' ∈ ofTerm Γ e) :
    Context.weak Γ X e' ∈ ofTerm (Γ.cons X) e.lift

name: ofTerm_ofType_correct
statement:
theorem ofTerm_ofType_correct :
    (∀ {Γ e A}, HasType Γ e A → ∀ {Γ'}, Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ →
      ∃ A' ∈ ofType Γ' A, ∃ e' ∈ ofTerm Γ' e, e' ≫ tp = A') ∧
    (∀ {Γ A}, IsType Γ A → ∀ {Γ'}, Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ →
      (ofType Γ' A).Dom)
proof:
:= by
  let ofTerm_correct Γ e A := ∀ {Γ'}, Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ →
      ∃ A' ∈ ofType Γ' A, ∃ e' ∈ ofTerm Γ' e, e' ≫ tp = A'
  let ofType_correct Γ A := ∀ {Γ'}, Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ → (ofType Γ' A).Dom
  refine
    ⟨@HasType.rec (fun Γ e A _ => ofTerm_correct Γ e A) (fun Γ A _ => ofType_correct Γ A)
      ?weak ?bvar ?app ?lam ?univ ?el ?pi,
     @IsType.rec (fun Γ e A _ => ofTerm_correct Γ e A) (fun Γ A _ => ofType_correct Γ A)
      ?weak ?bvar ?app ?lam ?univ ?el ?pi⟩
  case bvar =>
    intro A Γ Γ' hΓ
    simp [ofCtx] at hΓ
    obtain ⟨Γ', _, A', hA, rfl⟩ := hΓ
    refine ⟨_, ofType_lift A' hA, _, by rw [ofTerm]; apply Part.mem_some, ?_⟩
    rw [(disp_pullback A').w]; rfl
  case weak =>
    intro e A Γ _ ihe Γ' hΓ
    simp [ofCtx] at hΓ
    obtain ⟨Γ', hΓ, A', hA, rfl⟩ := hΓ
    obtain ⟨_, hA', e', he', rfl⟩ := ihe hΓ
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA'
    refine ⟨_, ofType_lift _ hA, _, ofTerm_lift _ he', by simp [Context.weak]⟩
  case app =>
    intro A B f a Γ _ _ _ ihB ihf iha Γ' hΓ
    obtain ⟨_, hA, a', ha, rfl⟩ := iha hΓ
    obtain ⟨B', hB⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.1 <| ihB (by simpa [ofCtx] using ⟨_, hΓ, _, hA, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨_, hP, f', hf, rfl⟩ := ihf hΓ
    have := Part.mem_unique hP (by simp [ofType]; exact ⟨_, hA, _, hB, rfl⟩)
    simp [ofTerm_app]
    exact ⟨_, ofType_inst ⟨_, rfl⟩ ha hB, _, ⟨_, hf, _, ha, _, rfl, _, hB, this, rfl⟩, (mkApp ..).2⟩
  case lam =>
    intro A B e Γ _ _ ihA ihe Γ' hΓ
    have ⟨A', hA⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.1 (ihA hΓ)
    obtain ⟨_, hB, e', he, rfl⟩ := ihe (by simpa [ofCtx] using ⟨_, hΓ, _, hA, rfl⟩)
    simp [ofType, ofTerm]
    exact ⟨_, ⟨_, hA, _, hB, rfl⟩, _, ⟨_, hA, _, he, rfl⟩, (mkLam ..).2⟩
  case el =>
    intro A Γ _ ihA Γ' hΓ
    simp [ofType, Part.assert]
    have := ihA hΓ; simp [ofType] at this
    have ⟨_, ⟨h, rfl⟩, eq⟩ := this
    exact ⟨h, eq⟩
  case pi =>
    intro A B Γ _ _ ihA ihB Γ' hΓ
    simp [ofType]
    refine ⟨ihA hΓ, ihB ?_⟩; simp [ofCtx]
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, _, Part.get_mem _, rfl⟩
  case univ => intro Γ Γ' _; simp [ofType]

name: ofTerm_correct
statement:
theorem ofTerm_correct {Γ e A} (H : HasType Γ e A) {Γ'} (hΓ : Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ) :
    ∃ A' ∈ ofType Γ' A, ∃ e' ∈ ofTerm Γ' e, e' ≫ tp = A'

name: ofTerm_correct_ty
statement:
theorem ofTerm_correct_ty {Γ e A} (H : HasType Γ e A) {Γ'} (hΓ : Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ) :
    (ofType Γ' A).Dom
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, ⟨h, rfl⟩, _⟩ := ofTerm_correct H hΓ
  h

name: ofTerm_correct_tm
statement:
theorem ofTerm_correct_tm {Γ e A} (H : HasType Γ e A) {Γ'} (hΓ : Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ) :
    (ofTerm Γ' e).Dom
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, _, _, ⟨h, rfl⟩, _⟩ := ofTerm_correct H hΓ
  h

name: ofTerm_correct_tp
statement:
theorem ofTerm_correct_tp {Γ A} (H : HasType Γ e A) {Γ'} (hΓ : Γ' ∈ ofCtx (Ctx := Ctx) Γ) :
    (ofTerm Γ' e).get (ofTerm_correct_tm H hΓ) ≫ tp =
    (ofType Γ' A).get (ofTerm_correct_ty H hΓ)
proof:
:=

name: hext
statement: theorem hext {x y : ∫ F} (hbase : x.base = y.base) (hfiber : HEq x.fiber y.fiber) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨xbase, xfiber⟩
  subst hbase
  subst hfiber
  rfl

name: hext_iff
statement:
theorem hext_iff {x y : ∫ F} : x.base = y.base ∧ HEq x.fiber y.fiber
    ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨ hα , hstr ⟩
    exact hext hα hstr
  · intro hCD
    subst hCD
    exact ⟨ rfl , HEq.rfl ⟩

proof:
:= by
  cases f; cases g

name: hext'
statement:
theorem hext' (h : F = F') {x : ∫ F} {y : ∫ F'}

proof:
:= by
  rcases x; rcases y
  subst hbase
  congr

name: Hom.hext'
statement:
theorem Hom.hext' (h : F = F') {X Y : ∫ F} {X' Y' : ∫ F'} (hX : HEq X X') (hY : HEq Y Y')
    (f : Hom X Y) (g : Hom X' Y') (w_base : HEq f.base g.base) (w_fiber : HEq f.fiber g.fiber) :
    HEq f g
proof:
:= by
  cases f; cases g
  congr

name: FunctorTo.hext
statement:
theorem FunctorTo.hext (G H : D ⥤ ∫ F)
    (hbase : G ⋙ forget _ = H ⋙ forget _)
    (hfiber_obj : ∀ x : D, HEq (G.obj x).fiber (H.obj x).fiber)
    (hfiber_map : ∀ {x y : D} (f : x ⟶ y), HEq (G.map f).fiber (H.map f).fiber)
    : G = H
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro x
    apply Grothendieck.hext
    · exact Functor.congr_obj hbase x
    · apply hfiber_obj
  · intro x y f
    fapply Grothendieck.Hom.hext
    · simp only [Hom.comp_base, base_eqToHom]
      exact Functor.congr_hom hbase f
    · simp only [Hom.comp_fiber, fiber_eqToHom, eqToHom_map, heq_eqToHom_comp_iff,
        heq_comp_eqToHom_iff]
      rw! [base_eqToHom, eqToHom_map, hfiber_map f, Cat.map_eqToHom]
      simp

name: subst'_subst'
statement:
theorem subst'_subst' {S₁ S₂ S₃ bvar₁ up₁ bvar₂ up₂ bvar₃ up₃}
    (hup : ∀ ξ σ τ, bvar₃ τ = subst' bvar₂ up₂ ξ ∘ bvar₁ σ →
      bvar₃ (up₃ τ) = subst' bvar₂ up₂ (up₂ ξ) ∘ bvar₁ (up₁ σ))
    (ξ : S₂) (σ : S₁) (τ : S₃) (t : Expr)
    (H1 : bvar₃ τ = subst' bvar₂ up₂ ξ ∘ bvar₁ σ) :
    (t.subst' bvar₁ up₁ σ).subst' bvar₂ up₂ ξ = t.subst' bvar₃ up₃ τ

:= by
  simp [funext_iff] at *
  induction t generalizing ξ σ τ <;> dsimp [subst'] <;> grind

    (hup : ∀ ξ σ, up (subst' bvar' up' ξ ∘ σ) = subst' bvar' up' (up' ξ) ∘ up σ)
    (ξ : S') (σ) (t : Expr) :
    (t.subst σ).subst' bvar' up' ξ = t.subst fun i => (σ i).subst' bvar' up' ξ
proof:
:= by
  refine subst'_subst' (fun _ _ _ H => ?_) _ _ _ _ rfl
  cases H
  exact hup ..

name: rename_subst'

    (t.rename ξ).subst' (v' ∘ ·) up' σ = t.subst' (v' ∘ ·) up' (σ ∘ ξ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [rename, subst]
  induction t generalizing σ ξ <;> dsimp [subst'] <;> simp [*]

name: rename_subst
statement: theorem rename_subst (σ ξ) (t : Expr) : (t.rename ξ).subst σ = t.subst (σ ∘ ξ)

  apply rename_subst' (v' := id); apply up_comp_ren_sb

name: up_comp_sb_ren
statement:
theorem up_comp_sb_ren (σ : Nat → Expr) (ξ : Nat → Nat) :
    up (rename ξ ∘ σ) = rename (upr ξ) ∘ up σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> (unfold up; dsimp [snoc, rename, subst', upr])
  simp [← rename.eq_1]
  conv => lhs; rw [rename_eq_subst_ofRen, rename_subst]
  conv => rhs; rw [rename_eq_subst_ofRen, rename_subst]
  rfl

name: up_comp_sb'_ren
statement:

    (σ) (ξ : S) :
    up (v' ξ ∘ σ) = v' (up' ξ) ∘ upr σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> simp [up, snoc, rename, upr, *]

name: subst'_rename
statement:
theorem subst'_rename (ξ : S) (σ) (t : Expr) :
    (t.rename σ).subst' v' up' ξ = t.subst (v' ξ ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [rename, subst]
  have := up_comp_sb'_ren up0 upS
  induction t generalizing ξ σ <;> dsimp [subst'] <;> simp [*]

name: up_comp_sb'
statement:
theorem up_comp_sb' (ξ : S) (σ : Nat → Expr) :
    up (subst' v' up' ξ ∘ σ) = subst' v' up' (up' ξ) ∘ up σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> (unfold up; dsimp [snoc, rename, subst', upr])
  · symm; apply up0
  · simp [← rename.eq_1]
    rw [subst'_rename up0 upS]
    apply subst'_subst'
    · rintro ξ σ _ rfl
      refine (up_comp_sb_ren _ _).trans ?_
      ext i; simp; congr; cases i <;> simp [up, *]
    · ext i; simp [upS, rename]

name: subst_subst'
statement:

proof:
:= by
  apply subst'_subst'
  · rintro _ _ _ rfl
    dsimp
    rw [up_comp_sb' up0 upS]
  · rfl

name: subst_rename

name: subst'_subst

proof:
:= by
  apply subst'_subst'
  · rintro _ _ _ rfl
    dsimp
    refine (up_comp ..).trans ?_
    simp [comp, subst]; congr!
    ext ⟨⟩ <;> simp [up, up0, upS]
  · rfl

theorem snoc_wk_zero : snoc wk (Expr.bvar 0) = Expr.bvar

name: snoc_comp_wk_succ
statement: theorem snoc_comp_wk_succ (σ n) : snoc (comp wk σ) (bvar (n + 1)) = comp wk (snoc σ (bvar n))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> dsimp [comp, snoc, wk, -ofRen_succ, subst, ofRen, subst']

name: snoc_comp_wk_zero_subst
statement: theorem snoc_comp_wk_zero_subst (σ) : snoc (comp σ Expr.wk) ((Expr.bvar 0).subst σ) = σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> dsimp [snoc, comp, subst, subst', wk, ofRen, -ofRen_succ]

name: ofRen_comp
statement: theorem ofRen_comp (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Nat → Nat) : ofRen (ξ₁ ∘ ξ₂) = comp (ofRen ξ₁) (ofRen ξ₂)

name: wk_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wk_app (n) : wk n = .bvar (n + 1)

name: subst_bvar'
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_bvar' {σ i} :
  subst σ (.bvar i) = σ i

name: subst_pi
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_pi {σ l l' A B} :
  subst σ (.pi l l' A B) = .pi l l' (A.subst σ) (B.subst (up σ))

name: subst_sigma
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_sigma {σ l l' A B} :
  subst σ (.sigma l l' A B) = .sigma l l' (A.subst σ) (B.subst (up σ))

name: subst_lam
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_lam {σ l l' A B} :
  subst σ (.lam l l' A B) = .lam l l' (A.subst σ) (B.subst (up σ))

name: subst_app
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_app {σ l l' B} {fn arg} :
  subst σ (.app l l' B fn arg) = .app l l' (B.subst (up σ)) (fn.subst σ) (arg.subst σ)

name: subst_pair
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_pair {σ l l' B t u} :
  subst σ (.pair l l' B t u) = .pair l l' (B.subst (up σ)) (t.subst σ) (u.subst σ)

name: subst_fst
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_fst {σ l l' A B p} :
  subst σ (.fst l l' A B p) = .fst l l' (A.subst σ) (B.subst (up σ)) (p.subst σ)

name: subst_snd
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_snd {σ l l' A B p} :
  subst σ (.snd l l' A B p) = .snd l l' (A.subst σ) (B.subst (up σ)) (p.subst σ)

name: subst_Id
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_Id {σ l A t u} :
  subst σ (.Id l A t u) = .Id l (A.subst σ) (t.subst σ) (u.subst σ)

name: subst_refl
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_refl {σ l t} :
  subst σ (.refl l t) = .refl l (t.subst σ)

name: subst_idRec
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_idRec {σ l l' t C r u h} :
  subst σ (.idRec l l' t C r u h) =
  .idRec l l' (t.subst σ) (C.subst (up <| up σ)) (r.subst σ) (u.subst σ) (h.subst σ)

name: subst_univ
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_univ {σ l} :
  subst σ (.univ l) = .univ l

name: subst_el
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_el {σ a} :
  subst σ (.el a) = .el (a.subst σ)

name: subst_code
statement:
@[autosubst low] theorem subst_code {σ A} :
  subst σ (.code A) = .code (A.subst σ)

name: subst_toSb_subst
statement:
theorem subst_toSb_subst (B a : Expr) σ :
    (B.subst a.toSb).subst σ = (B.subst (Expr.up σ)).subst (a.subst σ).toSb

name: subst_snoc_toSb_subst
statement:
theorem subst_snoc_toSb_subst (B a b : Expr) σ :
    (B.subst <| Expr.snoc a.toSb b).subst σ =
      (B.subst <| Expr.up <| Expr.up σ).subst (Expr.snoc (a.subst σ).toSb (b.subst σ))

name: sb_irrel
statement:
theorem sb_irrel :
    (∀ {Γ l A}, Γ ⊢[l] A →
      ∀ (σ σ'), (∀ i < Γ.length, σ i = σ' i) → A.subst σ = A.subst σ') ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
      ∀ (σ σ'), (∀ i < Γ.length, σ i = σ' i) → t.subst σ = t.subst σ')
proof:
:= by
  have helper {σ σ' n} (h : ∀ i < n, σ i = σ' i) : ∀ i < n + 1, Expr.up σ i = Expr.up σ' i := by
    intro i lt
    rw [Expr.up_eq_snoc, Expr.up_eq_snoc]
    cases i
    . simp
    . simp [Expr.comp, h _ (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp lt)]
  mutual_induction WfTp
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  case bvar lk _ _ _ h =>
    have := h _ lk.lt_length
    simp [Expr.subst, this]
  case conv => solve_by_elim
  all_goals dsimp [Expr.subst, List.length_cons] at *; try congr 1 <;> solve_by_elim

name: sbOfTms_nil
statement:
@[autosubst]
theorem sbOfTms_nil : sbOfTms [] = Expr.bvar

name: sbOfTms_cons
statement:
@[autosubst]
theorem sbOfTms_cons (t ts k) :
    sbOfTms (t :: ts) k = Expr.snoc (sbOfTms ts (k + 1)) t
proof:
:= by
  ext i; cases i
  . simp [sbOfTms]
  . dsimp [sbOfTms]; congr 2; omega

name: sbOfTms_map_wk
statement:
@[autosubst]
theorem sbOfTms_map_wk (ts k) :
    sbOfTms (ts.map (·.subst Expr.wk)) (k+1) = Expr.comp Expr.wk (sbOfTms ts k)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  unfold sbOfTms
  rw [show (Expr.bvar (i + (k + 1))) = (Expr.bvar (i + k)).subst Expr.wk from rfl]
  simp [Expr.comp]

name: up_sbOfTms
statement:
theorem up_sbOfTms (ts k) :
    Expr.up (sbOfTms ts k) = sbOfTms (.bvar 0 :: ts.map (·.subst Expr.wk)) k

name: sbOfTms_get_eq
statement: theorem sbOfTms_get_eq (ts k i) : i < ts.length → sbOfTms ts k i = sbOfTms ts 0 i
proof:
:= by
  intro
  rw [sbOfTms, sbOfTms, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨by omega, rfl⟩]
  simp

name: WfTp.sbOfTms_irrel
statement:
theorem WfTp.sbOfTms_irrel {Γ l A ts} (wf : Γ ⊢[l] A) (le : Γ.length ≤ ts.length) (k) :
    A.subst (sbOfTms ts k) = A.subst (sbOfTms ts 0)
proof:
:=
  sb_irrel.1 wf (sbOfTms ts k) (sbOfTms ts 0) fun i _ => sbOfTms_get_eq ts k i (by omega)

name: WfTm.sbOfTms_irrel
statement:
theorem WfTm.sbOfTms_irrel {Γ l A t ts} (wf : Γ ⊢[l] t : A) (le : Γ.length ≤ ts.length) (k) :
    t.subst (sbOfTms ts k) = t.subst (sbOfTms ts 0)
proof:
:=
  sb_irrel.2 wf (sbOfTms ts k) (sbOfTms ts 0) fun i _ => sbOfTms_get_eq ts k i (by omega)

name: mkLam_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkLam_tp {Γ : Ctx} (A : y(Γ) ⟶ M.Ty) (B : y(M.ext A) ⟶ M.Ty)
    (t : y(M.ext A) ⟶ M.Tm) (t_tp : t ≫ M.tp = B) :
    M.mkLam A t ≫ M.tp = M.mkPi A B
proof:
:= by
  simp [mkLam, mkPi, NaturalModelPi.Pi_pullback.w]
  rw [← Category.assoc, M.Ptp_equiv_naturality, t_tp]

name: hom_ext
statement:
lemma hom_ext {c d : C} {f : c ⟶ d} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {g₁ g₂ : x ⟶[f] y}
    (h : g₁.hom = g₂.hom) : g₁ = g₂

name: over_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma over_base {c d : C} {f : c ⟶ d} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} (g : BasedLift P f x y) :
    P.map g.hom = eqToHom (x.2) ≫ f ≫ (eqToHom (y.over).symm)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Category.assoc _ _ _, ← g.over, assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, comp_id]

name: tauto_over_base
statement:
lemma tauto_over_base (f : (P.obj x) ⟶ (P.obj y)) (e : (Fiber.tauto x) ⟶[f] (Fiber.tauto y)) :
    P.map e.hom = f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fiber.coe_mk, over_base, eqToHom_refl, comp_id, id_comp]

name: id_hom
statement: lemma id_hom {x : P⁻¹ c} : (id x).hom = 𝟙 x.1

name: comp_hom
statement:
lemma comp_hom  {c d d': C} {f₁ : c ⟶ d} {f₂ : d ⟶ d'} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'}
    (g₁ : x ⟶[f₁] y) (g₂ : y ⟶[f₂] z) : (g₁ ≫ₗ g₂).hom = g₁.hom ≫ g₂.hom

name: comp_hom'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_hom' {c d d': C} {f₁ : c ⟶ d} {f₂ : d ⟶ d'} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'}
    {g₁ : x ⟶[f₁] y} {g₂ : y ⟶[f₂] z} {h : x ⟶[f₁ ≫ f₂] z} :
    (g₁ ≫ₗ g₂) = h ↔ g₁.hom ≫ g₂.hom = h.hom
proof: := ⟨fun H ↦ H ▸ rfl, fun H ↦ hom_ext H⟩

name: tauto_comp_hom
statement:
lemma tauto_comp_hom {e e' e'' : E} {g : e ⟶ e'} {g' : e' ⟶ e''} :
    (tauto (P:= P) g ≫ₗ tauto g').hom = g ≫ g'

name: comp_tauto_hom
statement:
lemma comp_tauto_hom {x y z : E} {f : P.obj x ⟶ P.obj y} {l : Fiber.tauto x ⟶[f] (Fiber.tauto y)}
    {g : y ⟶ z} : (l ≫ₗ tauto g).hom = l.hom ≫ g

name: eq_id_of_hom_eq_id
statement:
lemma eq_id_of_hom_eq_id {c : C} {x : P⁻¹ c} {g : x ⟶[𝟙 c] x} :
(g.hom = 𝟙 x.1) ↔ (g = id x)

name: hom_comp_cast
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro
  simp_all only [comp]
  rfl
  intro h
  rw [← comp_hom, h, cast_hom]

name: id_comp_cast
proof:
:= by
  simp_all only [comp, id, id_comp]; rfl

name: assoc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma assoc {I J K L: C} {f₁ : I ⟶ J} {f₂ : J ⟶ K} {f₃ : K ⟶ L} {W : P⁻¹ I} {X : P⁻¹ J}
    {Y : P⁻¹ K} {Z : P⁻¹ L} (g₁ : W ⟶[f₁] X) (g₂ : X ⟶[f₂] Y) (g₃ : Y ⟶[f₃] Z) :
    ((g₁ ≫ₗ g₂) ≫ₗ g₃) = castAssoc.invFun (g₁ ≫ₗ g₂ ≫ₗ g₃)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp]; ext; simp [cast_hom, castEquiv]

name: assoc_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma assoc_inv {c' c d d' : C} {f₁ : c' ⟶ c} {f₂ : c ⟶ d} {f₃ : d ⟶ d'} {w : P⁻¹ c'}
{x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'} (g₁ : w ⟶[f₁] x) (g₂ : x ⟶[f₂] y) (g₃ : y ⟶[f₃] z) :
castAssoc.toFun ((g₁ ≫ₗ g₂) ≫ₗ g₃) =  (g₁ ≫ₗ (g₂ ≫ₗ g₃))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp]; ext; simp [cast_hom, castEquiv]

name: tauto_comp_cast
statement:
lemma tauto_comp_cast {e e' e'' : E} {g : e ⟶ e'} {g' : e' ⟶ e''} :
    tauto (g ≫ g') = cast (P.map_comp g g').symm (tauto g ≫ₗ tauto g')

name: over_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma over_base (f : c ⟶ d) (y : P⁻¹ d) (g : Lift P f y) : P.map g.based_lift.hom =
    (eqToHom (g.src.over)) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (y.over).symm

name: gaplift_cast
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_cast (u : c' ⟶ c) {f' : c' ⟶ d} (g' : x' ⟶[f'] y)
    (h : f' = u ≫ f) : gaplift' g u g' h = gaplift g u (cast h g')

name: gaplift_property
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_property (u : c' ⟶ c) (g' : x' ⟶[u ≫ f] y) :
((gaplift g u g') ≫ₗ g) = g'

name: gaplift_hom_property
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_hom_property (u : c' ⟶ c) (g' : x' ⟶[u ≫ f] y) : (gaplift g u g').hom ≫  g.hom = g'.hom
proof: := by rw [← BasedLift.comp_hom _ _]; congr 1; exact gaplift_property g u g'

name: gaplift_uniq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_uniq {u : c' ⟶ c} (g' : x' ⟶[u ≫ f] y) (v : x' ⟶[u] x)
(hv : v ≫ₗ g = g') : v = gaplift (g:= g) u g'
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaplift]; rw [← (Cartesian.uniq_lift (P:= P) (f:= f) (g:= g) (z:= x') u g').uniq ⟨v,hv⟩]

name: gaplift_uniq'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_uniq' {u : c' ⟶ c} (v : x' ⟶[u] x) (v' : x' ⟶[u] x) (hv : v ≫ₗ g = v' ≫ₗ g) : v = v'
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaplift_uniq g (v' ≫ₗ g) v hv]; symm; apply gaplift_uniq; rfl

name: gaplift'_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift'_self : gaplift' g (𝟙 c) g (id_comp f).symm = BasedLift.id x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaplift_cast]
  symm
  apply gaplift_uniq
  simp_all only [BasedLift.comp, BasedLift.id, id_comp]
  rfl

name: gaplift_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_comp {u : c' ⟶ c} {u' : c'' ⟶ c'} {x'' : P⁻¹ c''}
{g' : x' ⟶[u ≫ f] y} [Cartesian (P:= P) (f:= u ≫ f) g']
{g'' : x'' ⟶[u' ≫ u ≫ f] y} :
(gaplift  (g:= g') u' g'') ≫ₗ (gaplift (g:= g) u g') =
gaplift (g:= g) (u' ≫ u) (BasedLift.castAssoc.invFun g'')
proof:
:= by
  refine gaplift_uniq (f:= f) g (castAssoc.invFun g'') ((gaplift (g:= g') u' g'') ≫ₗ (gaplift (g:= g) u g')) (by rw [BasedLift.assoc]; simp only [gaplift_property])

name: gapmap_over
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapmap_over {z : E} {u : P.obj z ⟶ P.obj x} {g' : Fiber.tauto z ⟶[u ≫ P.map g] Fiber.tauto y} : P.map (gapmap g gcart u g') = u

name: gapmap_property
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapmap_property {g : x ⟶ y} {gcart : CartMor P g} {z : E} {u : P.obj z ⟶ P.obj x} {g' : Fiber.tauto z ⟶[u ≫ P.map g] y} : (gapmap g gcart u g') ≫ g = g'.hom

name: gapmap_uniq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapmap_uniq {z : E} {u : P.obj z ⟶ P.obj x} {g' : Fiber.tauto z ⟶[u ≫ P.map g] Fiber.tauto y}  (v : Fiber.tauto z ⟶[u] x) (hv : v.hom ≫ g = g'.hom) : v.hom = gapmap g gcart u g'
proof:
:= by
  have : v = Classical.choose (gcart u g') := by
    refine (Classical.choose_spec (gcart u g')).2 v hv
  rw [this, gapmap]

name: cart_id
statement: lemma cart_id (e : E) : CartMor P (𝟙 e)
proof:
:= fun z u g' ↦ by
  use ⟨ g'.cast ((whisker_eq u (P.map_id e)).trans (comp_id _)), by aesop⟩
  constructor
  simp only [Fiber.tauto, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, castEquiv_apply_hom, comp_id]; rfl
  intro v hv; ext; aesop

name: cart_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cart_comp : StableUnderComposition (CartMor P)
proof:
:= fun x y z f g hf hg w u g' => by
  cases' hg (u ≫ P.map f) (g'.cast ((u ≫= P.map_comp f g).trans (Category.assoc u _ _).symm )) with lg hlg
  cases' (hf u lg) with lf hlf
  use lf
  constructor
  · simp only [Fiber.tauto_over, CartMor, ← Category.assoc, hlf.1, hlg.1, BasedLift.cast]
  · intro v hv
    have : v.hom ≫ f = lg.hom := (BasedLift.comp_hom').mp (hlg.2 (v ≫ₗ f) (hv ▸ assoc v.hom f g))
    apply hlf.2 v this

name: cart_iso
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cart_iso {x y : E} (g : x ⟶ y) [IsIso g] : CartMor P g
proof:
:=
  fun z u g' ↦ ⟨(g' ≫ₗ BasedLift.tauto (inv g)).cast
    (by simp only [Functor.map_inv, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, comp_id]),
      ⟨(IsIso.eq_comp_inv g).mp rfl, fun v hv ↦ by aesop⟩⟩

name: cart_iso_closed
statement:
lemma cart_iso_closed : RespectsIso (CartMor P) where
  left
proof:
:= fun e g hg => by apply cart_comp; exact cart_iso e.hom; assumption
  right := fun e g hg => by apply cart_comp; assumption; exact cart_iso e.hom

name: cart_pullback
statement: lemma cart_pullback [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan P] : StableUnderBaseChange (CartMor P)
proof: := fun x y w z f g f' g' pb gcart  => by

name: hom_ext
statement:
lemma hom_ext {c d : C} {f : c ⟶ d} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {g₁ g₂ : x ⟶[f] y}
    (h : g₁.hom = g₂.hom) : g₁ = g₂

name: over_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma over_base {c d : C} {f : c ⟶ d} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} (g : BasedLift P f x y) :
    P.map g.hom = eqToHom (x.2) ≫ f ≫ (eqToHom (y.over).symm)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Category.assoc _ _ _, ← g.over, assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, comp_id]

name: tauto_over_base
statement:
lemma tauto_over_base (f : (P.obj x) ⟶ (P.obj y)) (e : (Fiber.tauto x) ⟶[f] (Fiber.tauto y)) :
    P.map e.hom = f
proof: := by simp only [Fiber.coe_mk, over_base, eqToHom_refl, comp_id, id_comp]

name: id_hom
statement: lemma id_hom {x : P⁻¹ c} : (id x).hom = 𝟙 x.1

name: comp_hom
statement: lemma comp_hom  {c d d': C} {f₁ : c ⟶ d} {f₂ : d ⟶ d'} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'} (g₁ : x ⟶[f₁] y) (g₂ : y ⟶[f₂] z) : (g₁ ≫[l] g₂).hom = g₁.hom ≫ g₂.hom

name: comp_hom'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_hom' {c d d': C} {f₁ : c ⟶ d} {f₂ : d ⟶ d'} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'}
    {g₁ : x ⟶[f₁] y} {g₂ : y ⟶[f₂] z} {h : x ⟶[f₁ ≫ f₂] z} :
    (g₁ ≫[l] g₂) = h ↔ g₁.hom ≫ g₂.hom = h.hom
proof: := ⟨fun H ↦ H ▸ rfl, fun H ↦ hom_ext H⟩

name: tauto_comp_hom
statement:
lemma tauto_comp_hom {e e' e'' : E} {g : e ⟶ e'} {g' : e' ⟶ e''} :
    (tauto (P:= P) g ≫[l] tauto g').hom = g ≫ g'

name: comp_tauto_hom
statement:
lemma comp_tauto_hom {x y z : E} {f : P.obj x ⟶ P.obj y} {l : Fiber.tauto x ⟶[f] (Fiber.tauto y)}
    {g : y ⟶ z} : (l ≫[l] tauto g).hom = l.hom ≫ g

name: cast_hom
statement:
lemma cast_hom {c d : C} {f f' : c ⟶ d} {x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {g : x ⟶[f] y} {h : f = f'} :
    (cast h g).hom = g.hom

name: eq_id_of_hom_eq_id
statement:
lemma eq_id_of_hom_eq_id {c : C} {x : P⁻¹ c} {g : x ⟶[𝟙 c] x} :
(g.hom = 𝟙 x.1) ↔ (g = id x)

name: hom_comp_cast
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro
  simp_all only [comp]
  rfl
  intro h
  rw [← comp_hom, h, cast_hom]

name: id_comp_cast
proof:
:= by
  simp_all only [comp, id, id_comp]; rfl

name: assoc
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp, Category.assoc, castAssoc, cast]

name: assoc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma assoc {c' c d d' : C} {f₁ : c' ⟶ c} {f₂ : c ⟶ d} {f₃ : d ⟶ d'} {w : P⁻¹ c'} {x : P⁻¹ c}
    {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'} (g₁ : w ⟶[f₁] x) (g₂ : x ⟶[f₂] y) (g₃ : y ⟶[f₃] z) :
    ((g₁ ≫[l] g₂) ≫[l] g₃) = castAssoc.invFun (g₁ ≫[l] g₂ ≫[l] g₃)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp, Category.assoc, castAssoc, cast]

name: assoc_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma assoc_inv {c' c d d' : C} {f₁ : c' ⟶ c} {f₂ : c ⟶ d} {f₃ : d ⟶ d'} {w : P⁻¹ c'}
{x : P⁻¹ c} {y : P⁻¹ d} {z : P⁻¹ d'} (g₁ : w ⟶[f₁] x) (g₂ : x ⟶[f₂] y) (g₃ : y ⟶[f₃] z) :
castAssoc.toFun ((g₁ ≫[l] g₂) ≫[l] g₃) =  (g₁ ≫[l] (g₂ ≫[l] g₃))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp, Category.assoc, castAssoc, cast]

proof: := by rw [← BasedLift.comp_hom _ _]; congr 1; exact gaplift_property g u g'

name: gaplift_uniq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_uniq {u : c' ⟶ c} (g' : x' ⟶[u ≫ f] y) (v : x' ⟶[u] x)
(hv : (v ≫[l] g) = g') : v = gaplift (g:= g) u g'
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaplift]; rw [← (CartesianBasedLift.uniq_lift (P:= P) (f:= f) (g:= g) (z:= x') u g').uniq ⟨v,hv⟩]

name: gaplift_uniq'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_uniq' {u : c' ⟶ c} (v : x' ⟶[u] x) (v' : x' ⟶[u] x) (hv : (v ≫[l] g) = v' ≫[l] g) :
    v = v'
proof: := gaplift_uniq g (v' ≫[l] g) v hv ▸ (gaplift_uniq _ _ _ rfl).symm

name: gaplift'_self

@[simp]
lemma gaplift'_self : gaplift' g (𝟙 c) g (id_comp f).symm = BasedLift.id x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaplift_cast]
  apply (gaplift_uniq _ _ _ _).symm
  simp only [BasedLift.comp, BasedLift.id, id_comp]
  rfl

name: gaplift_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gaplift_comp {u : c' ⟶ c} {u' : c'' ⟶ c'} {x'' : P⁻¹ c''}
{g' : x' ⟶[u ≫ f] y} [CartesianBasedLift (P:= P) (f:= u ≫ f) g']
{g'' : x'' ⟶[u' ≫ u ≫ f] y} :
(gaplift  (g:= g') u' g'') ≫[l] (gaplift (g:= g) u g') =
gaplift (g:= g) (u' ≫ u) (BasedLift.castAssoc.invFun g'')
proof:
:= by
  refine gaplift_uniq (f:= f) g (castAssoc.invFun g'') ((gaplift (g:= g') u' g'') ≫[l] (gaplift (g:= g) u g')) (by rw [BasedLift.assoc]; simp only [gaplift_property])

name: gapmap_uniq
proof:
:= by
  have : v = Classical.choose (gcart u g') := by
    refine (Classical.choose_spec (gcart u g')).2 v hv
  rw [this]
  simp [gapmap]

name: gapmap_uniq'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gapmap_uniq' (g : x ⟶ y) (gcart : CartMor P g) {c : C} {z : P⁻¹ c}
(v₁ : (z : E) ⟶ x) (v₂ : (z : E) ⟶ x) (hv : v₁ ≫ g = v₂ ≫ g)
(hv' : P.map v₁ = P.map v₂) : v₁ = v₂
proof:
:= by
  let v₁' := tauto (P:= P) v₁
  let v₂' := tauto (P:= P) v₂
  let g' := v₂' ≫[l] tauto g
  have : P.map v₁ ≫ P.map g = P.map v₂ ≫ P.map g  := by rw [← P.map_comp, ← P.map_comp, hv]
  have hv₁ : v₁'.hom ≫ g = g'.hom := by simp_all only [Fiber.tauto_over, tauto_hom, BasedLift.comp]
  have hv₂' : (BasedLift.cast hv'.symm v₂').hom ≫ g = (BasedLift.cast  (this.symm) g').hom := by
    simp only [Fiber.tauto_over, tauto_hom, BasedLift.comp, cast_apply_hom]
  have H' := (gcart (P.map v₁) (BasedLift.cast (this.symm) g')).unique hv₁ hv₂'
  injection H'

name: cart_id
statement: lemma cart_id (e : E) : CartMor P (𝟙 e)
proof:
:= fun z u g' ↦ by
  stop
  use ⟨(BasedLift.cast ((whisker_eq u (P.map_id e)).trans (comp_id _))).toFun g', by aesop⟩
  constructor
  simp_all only [Fiber.tauto, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, cast_apply_hom, comp_id]
  intro v hv; ext; aesop

name: cart_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cart_comp : StableUnderComposition (CartMor P)
proof:
:= fun x y z f g hf hg w u g' => by
  cases' (hg (u ≫ P.map f) ((BasedLift.cast ((u ≫= P.map_comp f g).trans (Category.assoc u _ _).symm )).toFun g')) with lg hlg
  cases' (hf u lg) with lf hlf
  use lf
  constructor
  · simp only [Fiber.tauto_over, CartMor, ← Category.assoc, hlf.1, hlg.1, BasedLift.cast]
  · intro v hv
    have : v.hom ≫ f = lg.hom := (BasedLift.comp_hom').mp (hlg.2 (v ≫[l] f) (hv ▸ assoc v.hom f g))
    apply hlf.2 v this

statement:

lemma cart_iso {x y : E} (g : x ⟶ y) [IsIso g] : CartMor P g
proof:
:= fun z u g' => by
  use (BasedLift.cast (by simp)).toFun (g' ≫[l] BasedLift.tauto (inv g))
  simp
  intro v hv
  congr! 1
  aesop

statement:

  left
proof:
:= fun e g hg => by apply cart_comp; exact cart_iso e.hom; assumption
  right := fun e g hg => by apply cart_comp; assumption; exact cart_iso e.hom

    mapFiber α (inv f) = eqToHom (Functor.map_inv α f ▸ rfl) ≫ (inv (α.map f)).fiber

name: inv_mapFiber_heq
statement:
theorem inv_mapFiber_heq {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) [IsIso f] :
    inv (mapFiber α f) ≍ ((α ⋙ forgetToGrpd).map f).map (mapFiber α (inv f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapFiber_inv]
  simp [eqToHom_map, mapFiber]
  rw [Functor.Grothendieck.inv_fiber, Functor.Grothendieck.invFiber]
  simp [Grpd.forgetToCat]

name: Functor.hext
statement:
theorem Functor.hext (F G : Γ ⥤ PGrpd)
    (hbase : F ⋙ forgetToGrpd = G ⋙ forgetToGrpd)
    (hfiber_obj : ∀ x : Γ, HEq (F.obj x).fiber (G.obj x).fiber)
    (hfiber_map : ∀ {x y : Γ} (f : x ⟶ y), HEq (F.map f).fiber (G.map f).fiber)
    : F = G
proof:
:=
  Grothendieck.FunctorTo.hext F G hbase hfiber_obj hfiber_map

name: forgetToPCat_forgetToCat
isPullback'

name: substWk_eq
statement:
theorem substWk_eq (A : Γ ⟶ U.Ty.{v}) (σA : Δ ⟶ U.Ty.{v}) (eq) :
    U.substWk σ A σA eq =
    map (eqToHom (by subst eq; rfl)) ⋙ pre (toCoreAsSmallEquiv A) σ
proof:
:= by
  apply (U.disp_pullback A).hom_ext
  · rw [substWk_var]
    simp [var, Grpd.comp_eq_comp]
    rw [← toCoreAsSmallEquiv_symm_apply_comp_left, Functor.assoc, pre_toPGrpd,
      map_eqToHom_toPGrpd]
  · rw [substWk_disp]
    simp [Grpd.comp_eq_comp, Functor.assoc]
    erw [pre_comp_forget, ← Functor.assoc, map_forget]

name: sec_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem sec_eq {Γ : Ctx} (α : Γ ⟶ U.{v}.Tm) (A : Γ ⟶ U.{v}.Ty) (hα : α ≫ U.tp = A) :
    U.sec _ α hα = sec (toCoreAsSmallEquiv A) (toCoreAsSmallEquiv α)
    (by rw [← hα, Grpd.comp_eq_comp, tp, toCoreAsSmallEquiv_apply_comp_right])
proof:
:= by
  apply (U.disp_pullback _).hom_ext
  . erw [sec_var, U_var, var, Grpd.comp_eq_comp,
      ← toCoreAsSmallEquiv_symm_apply_comp_left, Equiv.eq_symm_apply, sec_toPGrpd]
    rfl
  . rw [sec_disp]
    rfl

name: sigmaMap_obj_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaMap_obj_base (a) :
    ((sigmaMap B f).obj a).base = (A.map f).obj a.base

name: sigmaMap_obj_fiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaMap_obj_fiber (a) :

name: sigmaMap_map_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaMap_map_base {a b : sigmaObj B x} {p : a ⟶ b} :
    ((sigmaMap B f).map p).base = (A.map f).map p.base

name: sigmaMap_map_fiber_aux
statement:
theorem sigmaMap_map_fiber_aux {a b : sigmaObj B x} {p : a ⟶ b} :
    (((ι A y ⋙ B)).map ((sigmaMap B f).map p).base).obj ((sigmaMap B f).obj a).fiber =
    (B.map ((ιNatTrans f).app (base b))).obj (((ι A x ⋙ B).map p.base).obj a.fiber)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sigmaObj, sigmaMap, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, pre_map_base, map_map_base,
    pre_obj_fiber, map_obj_fiber, Functor.whiskerRight_app]
  simp only [← Functor.comp_obj, ← Grpd.comp_eq_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 2
  exact ((ιNatTrans f).naturality p.base).symm

name: sigmaMap_map_fiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaMap_map_fiber {a b : sigmaObj B x} {p : a ⟶ b} :
    ((sigmaMap B f).map p).fiber =
    eqToHom (sigmaMap_map_fiber_aux B f) ≫ (B.map ((ιNatTrans f).app (base b))).map p.fiber
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sigmaObj, sigmaMap, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map,
    pre_map_fiber, map_map_fiber, Functor.whiskerRight_app]

name: sigmaMap_id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem sigmaMap_id_obj {p} : (sigmaMap B (𝟙 x)).obj p = p
proof:
:= by
  apply hext
  · simp [sigmaMap]
  · simp [sigmaMap, Grpd.eqToHom_obj]

name: sigmaMap_id_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaMap_id_map {p1 p2} {hp2 : p2 = (sigmaMap B (𝟙 x)).obj p2}
    (f : p1 ⟶ p2) :
    (sigmaMap B (𝟙 x)).map f =
    eqToHom (by simp) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (by simp)
proof:
:= by
  have h (a : A.obj x) : B.map ((ιNatTrans (𝟙 x)).app a) =
      eqToHom (by simp) :=
    calc
      B.map ((ιNatTrans (𝟙 x)).app a)
      _ = B.map (eqToHom (by simp)) := by
        rw [ιNatTrans_id_app]
      _ = eqToHom (by simp) := by
        simp
  have h1 : B.map ((ι A x).map (eqToHom hp2).base) = eqToHom (by simp) := by
    simp [sigmaObj, base_eqToHom]
  fapply Hom.ext
  · simp [sigmaObj, sigmaMap]
  · simp [sigmaObj, sigmaMap_map_fiber, Functor.congr_hom (h p2.base) f.fiber,
      Functor.congr_hom h1]

name: sigmaMap_id
statement: @[simp] theorem sigmaMap_id : sigmaMap B (𝟙 x) = 𝟭 _
proof:
:= by
    apply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    · intro p1 p2 f
      simp
    · intro p
      simp

name: sigmaMap_comp_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaMap_comp_obj {p} : (sigmaMap B (f ≫ g)).obj p =
    (sigmaMap B g).obj ((sigmaMap B f).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [sigmaMap]
  apply hext
  · simp
  · simp only [sigmaObj, Functor.comp_obj, pre_obj_fiber, map_obj_fiber, Functor.whiskerRight_app,
      ιNatTrans_comp_app, Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, Grpd.comp_eq_comp, Grpd.eqToHom_obj, cast_heq_iff_heq, heq_eq_eq]
    aesop_cat

name: sigmaMap_comp_map
proof:
:= by
  have h : B.map ((ιNatTrans (f ≫ g)).app q.base) =
    B.map ((ιNatTrans f).app q.base)
    ≫ B.map ((ιNatTrans g).app ((A.map f).obj q.base))
    ≫ eqToHom (by simp) := by simp
  fapply Hom.hext
  · simp only [sigmaObj, Grpd.coe_of, sigmaMap_obj_base, sigmaMap_map_base, Grpd.map_comp_map,
    comp_base, base_eqToHom]
  · have h3 : (ι A z ⋙ B).map (eqToHom h2).base
        = eqToHom (by simp only [sigmaMap, Functor.comp_obj]; congr 3) := by
      rw [base_eqToHom, eqToHom_map]
    simp only [sigmaObj, Grpd.coe_of, sigmaMap_obj_base, Functor.comp_obj, sigmaMap_map_base,
      Functor.comp_map, sigmaMap_obj_fiber, sigmaMap_map_fiber, Functor.congr_hom h,
      Grpd.comp_eq_comp, eqToHom_trans_assoc, comp_base, Functor.Groupoidal.comp_fiber,
      fiber_eqToHom, eqToHom_map, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, heq_eqToHom_comp_iff,
      heq_comp_eqToHom_iff, eqToHom_comp_heq_iff, comp_eqToHom_heq_iff]
    rw! (transparency := .default) [Functor.congr_hom h3]
    simp only [sigmaObj, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, heq_eqToHom_comp_iff,
      heq_comp_eqToHom_iff, heq_eq_eq]

name: sigmaMap_comp
statement: theorem sigmaMap_comp : sigmaMap B (f ≫ g) = sigmaMap B f ⋙ sigmaMap B g
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro p q hpq
    simp
  · intro p
    simp

name: sigmaMap_forget
statement: lemma sigmaMap_forget : sigmaMap B f ⋙ forget = forget ⋙ A.map f

name: sigma_naturality_aux
statement:
theorem sigma_naturality_aux (x) :
    ι (σ ⋙ A) x ⋙ pre A σ ⋙ B = ι A (σ.obj x) ⋙ B

name: whiskerRight_
statement:
lemma whiskerRight_ιNatTrans_naturality {x y : Δ} (f : x ⟶ y) :
  Functor.whiskerRight (ιNatTrans f) (pre A σ ⋙ B) =
    eqToHom (sigma_naturality_aux B σ x) ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (ιNatTrans (σ.map f)) B ≫
    eqToHom (by simp [Functor.assoc, sigma_naturality_aux B σ y])

name: sigma_naturality_obj
statement:
lemma sigma_naturality_obj (x) :
    Grpd.of (∫ι A (σ.obj x) ⋙ B)
    = Grpd.of (∫ι (σ ⋙ A) x ⋙ pre A σ ⋙ B)

name: sigmaObj_naturality
statement:
lemma sigmaObj_naturality (x) :
    sigmaObj B (σ.obj x) = sigmaObj (pre A σ ⋙ B) x

name: sigmaMap_naturality
statement:
lemma sigmaMap_naturality {x y : Δ} (f : x ⟶ y) : sigmaMap B (σ.map f)
    = Grpd.homOf (map (eqToHom (sigma_naturality_aux B σ x).symm)) ≫
    sigmaMap (pre A σ ⋙ B) f ≫
    Grpd.homOf (map (eqToHom (sigma_naturality_aux B σ y)))
proof:
:= by
  have : pre (ι A (σ.obj y) ⋙ B) (A.map (σ.map f))
      = map (eqToHom (by rw[← (sigma_naturality_aux B σ y)]))
      ⋙ pre (ι (σ ⋙ A) y ⋙ pre A σ ⋙ B) (A.map (σ.map f))
      ⋙ map (eqToHom (sigma_naturality_aux B σ y)) := by
    rw [pre_congr_functor]
  dsimp [Grpd.homOf, sigmaMap, ← Functor.assoc]
  rw [← map_comp_eq, whiskerRight_ιNatTrans_naturality]
  simp [map_comp_eq, this, Functor.assoc]

name: sigmaMap_naturality_heq
statement:
lemma sigmaMap_naturality_heq {x y : Δ} (f : x ⟶ y) : sigmaMap B (σ.map f)
    ≍ sigmaMap (pre A σ ⋙ B) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaMap_naturality]
  simp only [sigmaObj, Functor.comp_obj, Grpd.homOf,
    ← eqToHom_eq_homOf_map (sigma_naturality_aux B σ x).symm,
    ← eqToHom_eq_homOf_map (sigma_naturality_aux B σ y)]
  apply HEq.trans (eqToHom_comp_heq _ _)
  apply HEq.trans (comp_eqToHom_heq _ _)
  rfl

name: sigma_naturality
statement: theorem sigma_naturality : σ ⋙ sigma A B = sigma (σ ⋙ A) (pre A σ ⋙ B)
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.hext
  . apply sigmaObj_naturality
  . apply sigmaMap_naturality_heq

lemma assocIso_hom_app_base_base {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) (p) :

lemma assocIso_hom_app_fiber {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) (p) :

name: assocIso_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocIso_id {x} :
    assocIso B (𝟙 x) = eqToIso (by simp [sigmaMap_id, Functor.id_comp])
proof:
:= by
  simp [assocIso, preNatIso_congr B (ιNatIso_id A x), preNatIso_eqToIso]

name: assocIso_comp
statement:
theorem assocIso_comp {x y z : Γ} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) : assocIso B (f ≫ g) =
    assocIso B f ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (sigmaMap B f) (assocIso B g)
    ≪≫ eqToIso (by simp [sigmaMap_comp, Functor.assoc])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocFib, sigmaMap, assocIso, preNatIso_congr B (ιNatIso_comp A f g), Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom, eqToIso.hom, pre_comp, preNatIso_comp, preNatIso_eqToIso,
    isoWhiskerLeft_eqToIso, eqToIso_trans, Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_trans, Iso.trans_assoc]
  rfl

name: assocHom_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocHom_id {x : Γ} :
    assocHom B (𝟙 x) = eqToHom (by simp [sigmaMap_id, Functor.id_comp])

name: assocHom_comp
statement:
theorem assocHom_comp {x y z : Γ} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :
    assocHom B (f ≫ g) = assocHom B f ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (sigmaMap B f) (assocHom B g) ≫
      eqToHom (by simp [sigmaMap_comp, Functor.assoc])

name: assocFibObj_base
statement: @[simp] theorem assocFibObj_base (x : ∫ B) : (assocFibObj x).base = x.base.fiber

name: assocFibMap_aux
statement:
theorem assocFibMap_aux {x y : ∫ B} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    ((ι A y.base.base ⋙ B).map (Hom.fiber (Hom.base f))).obj
    (fiber ((sigmaMap B (Hom.base (Hom.base f))).obj (assocFibObj x))) =
    (B.map (Hom.base f)).obj x.fiber
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocFibObj, objMk_base, ← Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map,
    sigmaMap_obj_fiber, objMk_fiber]
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, ← Grpd.comp_eq_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply Hom.ext <;> simp

name: assocFibMap_base
statement:
@[simp↓] theorem assocFibMap_base {x y : ∫ B} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (assocFibMap f).base = f.base.fiber

name: assocFibMap_fiber
statement:
@[simp↓] theorem assocFibMap_fiber {x y : ∫ B} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (assocFibMap f).fiber = eqToHom (assocFibMap_aux ..) ≫ f.fiber

name: assocFibMap_id
statement: lemma assocFibMap_id (x : ∫ B) : assocFibMap (𝟙 x) = eqToHom (by simp)

name: assocFibMap_comp
statement:
lemma assocFibMap_comp {x y z : ∫ B} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :
    assocFibMap (f ≫ g) = eqToHom (by simp) ≫
    (sigmaMap B (Hom.base (Hom.base g))).map (assocFibMap f) ≫ assocFibMap g
proof:
:= by
  fapply Hom.ext
  · simp only [sigmaObj, Grpd.coe_of, comp_base, assocFibObj, sigmaMap_obj_base, objMk_base,
    ↓assocFibMap_base, Functor.Groupoidal.comp_fiber, assocFibMap, Functor.comp_obj,
    Functor.comp_map, sigmaMap_obj_fiber, objMk_fiber, base_eqToHom, sigmaMap_map_base, homMk_base]
  · simp only [assocFibObj, objMk_base, Functor.comp_obj, comp_base, sigmaMap, ↓assocFibMap_base,
      Functor.comp_map, objMk_fiber, ↓assocFibMap_fiber, Functor.Groupoidal.comp_fiber,
      eqToHom_trans_assoc, assocFibMap, ← heq_eq_eq, heq_eqToHom_comp_iff, eqToHom_comp_heq_iff]
    rw [Functor.Groupoidal.comp_fiber]
    simp only [objMk_base, Functor.comp_obj, comp_base, Functor.comp_map, objMk_fiber,
      heq_eqToHom_comp_iff]
    rw! [fiber_eqToHom, eqToHom_map]
    simp only [heq_eqToHom_comp_iff]
    rw [Functor.Groupoidal.comp_fiber]
    simp only [objMk_base, Functor.comp_obj, comp_base, homMk_base, Functor.comp_map, objMk_fiber,
      pre_map_fiber, map_map_fiber, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Grpd.comp_eq_comp, homMk_fiber,
      Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, eqToHom_trans_assoc, Category.assoc, heq_eqToHom_comp_iff]
    have : Hom.base g = (ιNatTrans (Hom.base (Hom.base g))).app y.base.fiber ≫
        (ι A z.base.base).map (Hom.fiber (Hom.base g)) := by
      fapply Hom.ext
      · simp
      · simp
    conv => left; rw! (castMode := .all) [this]
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Grpd.map_comp_map, Category.assoc, eqRec_heq_iff_heq,
      eqToHom_comp_heq_iff, heq_eq_eq]
    congr 1
    simp [← heq_eq_eq]
    rfl

name: assocFib_comp_forget
statement:
lemma assocFib_comp_forget (c : Γ) : assocFib B c ⋙ forget ⋙
    forget = ι (sigma A B) c ⋙ forget
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [assocFib]
  rw [ι_comp_forget, ← Functor.assoc, pre_comp_forget, Functor.assoc, ι_comp_forget]
  aesop_cat

name: assocFibObj_assocFib_obj
statement:
lemma assocFibObj_assocFib_obj (c : Γ) (x : sigmaObj B c) :
    assocFibObj ((assocFib B c).obj x) ≍ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocFib, assocFibObj, pre_obj_fiber, heq_eq_eq]
  apply Functor.Groupoidal.ext
  · simp
  · rw! (castMode := .all) [pre_obj_base]
    simp

name: assocFibMap_assocFib_map
statement:
lemma assocFibMap_assocFib_map (c : Γ) {x y : sigmaObj B c} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    assocFibMap ((assocFib B c).map f) ≍ f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [assocFib, assocFibMap]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [pre_obj_base]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [pre_obj_base]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [pre_map_base]
  apply Hom.hext' <;> simp

name: assocFib_forget_comp_forget_obj
statement:
lemma assocFib_forget_comp_forget_obj (x : ∫ B) :
    (assocFib B ((forget ⋙ forget).obj x)).obj
    (assocFibObj x) = x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [assocFib, assocFibObj]
  fapply Functor.Groupoidal.ext
  · fapply Functor.Groupoidal.ext
    · simp
    · rw! (castMode := .all) [pre_obj_base]
      simp
  · simp

name: assocHom_app_comp_pre_map_assocFibMap
statement:
lemma assocHom_app_comp_pre_map_assocFibMap {x y : ∫ B} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (assocHom B (Hom.base (Hom.base f))).app (assocFibObj x) ≫
      (pre B (ι A y.base.base)).map (assocFibMap f) ≍ f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [assocFibObj, assocHom, assocFibMap, assocIso]
  fapply Hom.hext' rfl
  · simp only [heq_eq_eq]
    exact assocFib_forget_comp_forget_obj x
  · simp only [heq_eq_eq]
    exact assocFib_forget_comp_forget_obj y
  · fapply Hom.hext' rfl
    · conv => right; rw [← assocFib_forget_comp_forget_obj x]
      simp
    · conv => right; rw [← assocFib_forget_comp_forget_obj y]
      simp
    · simp [ιNatIso_hom]
      apply Category.comp_id 
    · simp only [Functor.Groupoidal.comp_base, Functor.Groupoidal.comp_fiber, eqToHom_comp_heq_iff]
      rw [preNatIso_hom_app_base, ιNatIso_hom]
      rw! (transparency := .default) (castMode := .all) [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
      erw [Category.id_comp]
      rw! (castMode := .all) [pre_map_base]
      simp [- heq_eq_eq]
      rfl
  · simp

name: assocFib_comp_forget_comp_forget_obj
statement:
lemma assocFib_comp_forget_comp_forget_obj (c : Γ) (x : sigmaObj B c) :

name: forget_comp_forget_map_assocHom_app
statement:
lemma forget_comp_forget_map_assocHom_app {c c' : Γ} (f : c ⟶ c') (x : sigmaObj B c) :
    (Functor.Groupoidal.forget ⋙ Functor.Groupoidal.forget).map ((assocHom B f).app x) ≍ f

name: assocFibMap_assocHom_app
statement:
lemma assocFibMap_assocHom_app {c c' : Γ} (f : c ⟶ c') (x : sigmaObj B c) :
    assocFibMap ((assocHom B f).app x) ≍ 𝟙 ((sigmaMap B f).obj x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [assocFibMap, assocHom, assocIso]
  fapply Hom.hext' rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl
  · rfl
  · simp only [objMk_base, Functor.comp_obj, sigmaMap_obj_base, homMk_base, Functor.comp_map,
    sigmaMap_obj_fiber, objMk_fiber, homMk_fiber, preNatIso_hom_app_fiber, pre_comp,
    Category.comp_id, heq_eq_eq]
    symm
    apply Functor.Groupoidal.id_fiber

name: assoc_hom

proof:
:=

    rw [assoc_hom_comp_forget]

lemma assoc_inv_map_base_base {x y} (f : x ⟶ y) : ((assoc B).inv.map f).base.base = f.base
