  exact autosubst% wf <| wf' lk

name: upr
statement: theorem upr : WfRen Δ ξ Γ → WfRen ((A.rename ξ, l) :: Δ) (Expr.upr ξ) ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold WfRen; intro wf _ _ _ lk
  cases lk
  · rw [show (A.subst Expr.wk).rename (Expr.upr ξ) = (A.rename ξ).subst Expr.wk by autosubst]
    apply Lookup.zero
  · rename_i A _ lk
    rw [show (A.subst Expr.wk).rename (Expr.upr ξ) = (A.rename ξ).subst Expr.wk by autosubst]
    apply Lookup.succ _ (wf lk)

name: rename_all
statement:
theorem rename_all :
    (∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
      ∀ {Δ ξ}, WfCtx E Δ → WfRen Δ ξ Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.rename ξ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A B}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B →
      ∀ {Δ ξ}, WfCtx E Δ → WfRen Δ ξ Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.rename ξ ≡ B.rename ξ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
      ∀ {Δ ξ}, WfCtx E Δ → WfRen Δ ξ Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.rename ξ : A.rename ξ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t u}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A →
      ∀ {Δ ξ}, WfCtx E Δ → WfRen Δ ξ Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.rename ξ ≡ u.rename ξ : A.rename ξ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have ih_subst (B a : Expr χ) (ξ) :
      (B.subst a.toSb).rename ξ = (B.rename (Expr.upr ξ)).subst (a.rename ξ).toSb := by autosubst
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  all_goals dsimp only; try intros
  all_goals try simp only [Expr.rename, ih_subst] at *; clear ih_subst
  
  case ax p _ Ec _ _ ihA _ _ Δ ξ =>
    have := ihA Δ ξ
    simp only [Expr.rename_eq_subst_ofRen, Expr.subst_of_isClosed _ p.2.1] at this ⊢
    apply WfTm.ax Δ Ec this
  case bvar ξ => apply WfTm.bvar _ (ξ.lookup _) <;> assumption
  case lam_app' =>
    convert EqTm.lam_app' .. using 1
    · congr 2 <;> autosubst
    all_goals grind
  
  case idRec' ihA iht ihC ihr ihu ihh _ _ Δ ξ =>
    have ΔA := ihA Δ ξ
    convert have ΔAI := ?ΔAI; WfTm.idRec' ΔA _ (ihC ΔAI ?ξuu) _ _ _ using 1
    · autosubst
    case ΔAI =>
      have := Δ.snoc ΔA
      apply this.snoc
      have x := WfTm.bvar this (.zero ..)
      exact autosubst% WfTp.Id'
        (ihA this (WfRen.wk .. |>.comp ξ))
        (iht this (WfRen.wk .. |>.comp ξ))
        (autosubst% x)
    case ξuu =>
      convert ξ.upr.upr using 1
      congr 3 <;> autosubst
    · grind
    · exact autosubst% (ihr Δ ξ)
    all_goals grind
  case cong_idRec' ihA iht ihtt ihC ihr ihu ihh _ _ Δ ξ =>
    have ΔA := ihA Δ ξ
    convert have ΔAI := ?ΔAI; EqTm.cong_idRec' ΔA (iht Δ ξ) _ (ihC ΔAI ?ξuu) ?ξr _ _ using 1
    · autosubst
    case ΔAI =>
      have := Δ.snoc ΔA
      apply this.snoc
      have x := WfTm.bvar this (.zero ..)
      exact autosubst% WfTp.Id'
        (ihA this (WfRen.wk .. |>.comp ξ))
        (iht this (WfRen.wk .. |>.comp ξ))
        (autosubst% x)
    case ξuu =>
      convert ξ.upr.upr using 1
      congr 3 <;> autosubst
    case ξr =>
      exact autosubst% (ihr Δ ξ)
    all_goals grind
  case idRec_refl' ihA iht ihC ihr _ _ Δ ξ =>
    have ΔA := ihA Δ ξ
    convert have ΔAI := ?ΔAI; EqTm.idRec_refl' ΔA (iht Δ ξ) (ihC ΔAI ?ξuu) _ using 1
    · autosubst
    case ΔAI =>
      have := Δ.snoc ΔA
      apply this.snoc
      have x := WfTm.bvar this (.zero ..)
      exact autosubst% WfTp.Id'
        (ihA this (WfRen.wk .. |>.comp ξ))
        (iht this (WfRen.wk .. |>.comp ξ))
        (autosubst% x)
    case ξuu =>
      convert ξ.upr.upr using 1
      congr 3 <;> autosubst
    · exact autosubst% (ihr Δ ξ)
  
  grind_cases

name: WfCtx.lookup_wf
statement: theorem WfCtx.lookup_wf : WfCtx E Γ → Lookup Γ i A l → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A
proof:
:= by
  intro Γwf lk
  induction lk
  · rcases Γwf with _ | ⟨Γ, A⟩
    rw [← Expr.ofRen_succ, ← Expr.rename_eq_subst_ofRen]
    exact rename_all.1 A (Γ.snoc A) (WfRen.wk _ _ _)
  · rename_i ih
    rcases Γwf with _ | ⟨Γ, B⟩
    rw [← Expr.ofRen_succ, ← Expr.rename_eq_subst_ofRen]
    exact rename_all.1 (ih Γ) (Γ.snoc B) (WfRen.wk _ _ _)

statement:
theorem tp_wk : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B.subst Expr.wk
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A B => autosubst% rename_all.1 B (Γ.snoc A) (WfRen.wk ..)

statement:

    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B.subst Expr.wk ≡ B'.subst Expr.wk
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A BB' => autosubst% rename_all.2.1 BB' (Γ.snoc A) (WfRen.wk ..)

theorem eqTm_wk : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] b ≡ b' : B →

proof:
:=
  fun Γ A eq => autosubst% rename_all.2.2.2 eq (Γ.snoc A) (WfRen.wk ..)

name: eqSb_snoc
statement:
theorem eqSb_snoc : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ' →
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ A.subst σ' →
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t : A.subst σ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t' : A.subst σ' → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A.subst σ →
    EqSb E Δ (Expr.snoc σ t) (Expr.snoc σ' t') ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EqSb
  intro σσ' A; intros
  refine ⟨σσ'.1, σσ'.2.1.snoc A, fun lk => ?_⟩
  cases lk <;> (autosubst; grind)

name: eqSb_toSb
statement:
theorem eqSb_toSb : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t' : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    EqSb E Γ t.toSb t'.toSb ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  intro Γ A t t' tt'
  apply eqSb_snoc (EqSb.refl <| WfSb.id Γ)
  all_goals (try autosubst); grind [EqTp.refl_tp]

name: wfSb_snoc
statement:
theorem wfSb_snoc : WfSb E Δ σ Γ →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t : A.subst σ →
    WfSb E Δ (Expr.snoc σ t) ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun h A Aσ t => eqSb_snoc (EqSb.refl h) A Aσ Aσ (EqTp.refl_tp Aσ) t t (EqTm.refl_tm t) |>.wf_left

name: wfSb_toSb
statement:
theorem wfSb_toSb : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    WfSb E Γ t.toSb ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A t => by unfold WfSb; exact eqSb_toSb Γ A t t (EqTm.refl_tm t)

name: eqSb_up
statement:
theorem eqSb_up : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ' →
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ A.subst σ' →
    EqSb E ((A.subst σ, l) :: Δ) (Expr.up σ) (Expr.up σ') ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EqSb
  intro σσ' A Aσ Aσ' Aσeq
  have ΔAσ := σσ'.1.snoc Aσ
  refine ⟨ΔAσ, σσ'.2.1.snoc A, fun lk => ?_⟩
  cases lk
  · rw [Expr.up_eq_snoc σ, Expr.up_eq_snoc σ']
    repeat any_goals apply And.intro
    · exact autosubst% rename_all.1 Aσ ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · exact autosubst% rename_all.1 Aσ' ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · exact autosubst% rename_all.2.1 Aσeq ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · exact autosubst% WfTm.bvar ΔAσ (Lookup.zero ..)
    · dsimp
      convert WfTm.conv (WfTm.bvar ΔAσ (Lookup.zero ..)) ?_
      exact autosubst% rename_all.2.1 Aσeq ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · exact autosubst% EqTm.refl_tm (WfTm.bvar ΔAσ (Lookup.zero ..))
  next lk =>
    have := σσ'.2.2 lk
    repeat any_goals apply And.intro
    · exact autosubst% rename_all.1 this.1 ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · exact autosubst% rename_all.1 this.2.1 ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · exact autosubst% rename_all.2.1 this.2.2.1 ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..)
    · convert rename_all.2.2.1 this.2.2.2.1 ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..) using 1 <;>
        autosubst; rfl
    · convert autosubst% rename_all.2.2.1 this.2.2.2.2.1 ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..) using 1 <;>
        autosubst; rfl
    · rw [Expr.up_eq_snoc σ, Expr.up_eq_snoc σ']
      convert rename_all.2.2.2 this.2.2.2.2.2 ΔAσ (WfRen.wk ..) using 1 <;>
        (autosubst; try rw [Expr.comp, Function.comp])

name: wfSb_wk
statement: theorem wfSb_wk {Γ A l} : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → WfSb E ((A,l) :: Γ) Expr.wk Γ
proof:
:=
  fun h h' => WfSb.ofRen (h.snoc h') h (WfRen.wk ..)

name: wfSb_up
statement:
theorem wfSb_up : WfSb E Δ σ Γ →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ →
    WfSb E ((A.subst σ, l) :: Δ) (Expr.up σ) ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun h A Aσ => eqSb_up (EqSb.refl h) A Aσ Aσ (EqTp.refl_tp Aσ) |>.wf_left

name: Id_bvar
statement:
theorem Id_bvar : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l] .Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0)
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A t => WfTp.Id' (tp_wk Γ A A) (tm_wk Γ A t) (.bvar (Γ.snoc A) (.zero ..))

name: subst_all
statement:
theorem subst_all :
    (∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
      (∀ {Δ σ}, WfSb E Δ σ Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ) ∧
        ∀ {Δ σ σ'}, EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ A.subst σ') ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A B}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B →
      ∀ {Δ σ σ'}, EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ B.subst σ') ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
      (∀ {Δ σ}, WfSb E Δ σ Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ : A.subst σ) ∧
        ∀ {Δ σ σ'}, EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ ≡ t.subst σ' : A.subst σ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t u}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A →
      ∀ {Δ σ σ'}, EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ ≡ u.subst σ' : A.subst σ)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  all_goals dsimp; try intros
  all_goals try simp only [Expr.subst_toSb_subst, Expr.subst_snoc_toSb_subst, Expr.subst] at *
  case ax p _ Ec _ _ ihA =>
    constructor
    . introv σ
      have := ihA.1 σ
      simp only [Expr.subst_of_isClosed _ p.2.1] at this ⊢
      apply WfTm.ax σ.wf_dom Ec this
    . introv eq
      have := ihA.1 eq.wf_left
      simp [Expr.subst_of_isClosed _ p.2.1] at this ⊢
      apply EqTm.refl_tm <| WfTm.ax eq.wf_dom Ec this
  case bvar => grind [EqSb.lookup, WfSb.lookup]
  case pi' => grind [WfTp.pi', EqTp.cong_pi']
  case sigma' => grind [WfTp.sigma', EqTp.cong_sigma']
  case Id' => grind [WfTp.Id', EqTp.cong_Id]
  case univ => grind [WfSb.wf_dom, EqSb.wf_dom, WfTp.univ]
  case el => grind [WfTp.el, EqTp.cong_el]
  case symm_tp => grind [EqSb.symm]
  case lam' => grind [WfTm.lam', EqTm.cong_lam']
  case app' ihA _ _ _ =>
    constructor
    · grind [WfTm.app']
    · introv σ
      apply EqTm.cong_app' (ihA.1 σ.wf_left) <;> grind
  case pair' => grind [WfTm.pair', EqTm.cong_pair']
  case fst' => grind [WfTm.fst', EqTm.cong_fst']
  case snd' => grind [WfTm.snd', EqTm.cong_snd']
  case refl' => grind [WfTm.refl', EqTm.cong_refl']
  case idRec' A t _ _ _ _ ihA iht ihC _ _ _ =>
    constructor
    · introv σ
      have Γ := σ.wf_cod
      have Δ := σ.wf_dom
      have Aσ := ihA.1 σ
      apply WfTm.idRec' Aσ _ ?C
      case C =>
        apply ihC.1
        convert wfSb_up (wfSb_up σ A Aσ) (Id_bvar Γ A t) _ using 1
        · autosubst
        · exact autosubst% Id_bvar Δ Aσ (iht.1 σ)
      all_goals grind
    · introv σσ'
      have σ := σσ'.wf_left
      have σ' := σσ'.wf_right
      have Γ := σ.wf_cod
      have Δ := σ.wf_dom
      have Aσ := ihA.1 σ
      have Aσ' := ihA.1 σ'
      apply EqTm.cong_idRec' Aσ _ _ ?C
      case C =>
        apply ihC.2
        convert eqSb_up (eqSb_up σσ' A Aσ Aσ' (ihA.2 σσ')) (Id_bvar Γ A t) _ _ _ using 1
        · autosubst
        · exact autosubst% Id_bvar Δ Aσ (iht.1 σ)
        · exact autosubst% WfTp.Id' (tp_wk Δ Aσ Aσ') (tm_wk Δ Aσ (iht.1 σ'))
            (.conv (.bvar (Δ.snoc Aσ) (.zero ..)) (eqTp_wk Δ Aσ (ihA.2 σσ')))
        · have := (eqSb_up σσ' A Aσ Aσ' (ihA.2 σσ')).lookup (.zero ..)
          exact autosubst% EqTp.cong_Id
            (eqTp_wk Δ Aσ (ihA.2 σσ'))
            (eqTm_wk Δ Aσ (iht.2 σσ'))
            (autosubst% this)
      all_goals grind
  case code => grind [WfTm.code, EqTm.cong_code]
  case conv => grind [WfTm.conv, EqTm.conv_eq]
  case cong_idRec' A t _ _ _ _ _ ihA iht ihtt' ihC _ _ _ _ _ σσ' _ =>
    
    have σ := σσ'.wf_left
    have σ' := σσ'.wf_right
    have Γ := σ.wf_cod
    have Δ := σ.wf_dom
    have Aσ := ihA.1 σ
    have Aσ' := ihA.1 σ'
    apply EqTm.cong_idRec' Aσ _ _ ?C
    case C =>
      apply ihC
      convert eqSb_up (eqSb_up σσ' A Aσ Aσ' (ihA.2 σσ')) (Id_bvar Γ A t) _ _ _ using 1
      · autosubst
      · exact autosubst% Id_bvar Δ Aσ (iht.1 σ)
      · exact autosubst% WfTp.Id' (tp_wk Δ Aσ Aσ') (tm_wk Δ Aσ (iht.1 σ'))
          (.conv (.bvar (Δ.snoc Aσ) (.zero ..)) (eqTp_wk Δ Aσ (ihA.2 σσ')))
      · have := (eqSb_up σσ' A Aσ Aσ' (ihA.2 σσ')).lookup (.zero ..)
        exact autosubst% EqTp.cong_Id
          (eqTp_wk Δ Aσ (ihA.2 σσ'))
          (eqTm_wk Δ Aσ (iht.2 σσ'))
          (autosubst% this)
    all_goals grind
  case app_lam' =>
    apply EqTm.trans_tm' _ (EqTm.app_lam' ..)
    · autosubst; grind [eqSb_snoc, wfSb_snoc]
    · autosubst; grind [eqSb_snoc, wfSb_snoc]
    all_goals grind
  case fst_pair' => apply EqTm.trans_tm' _ (EqTm.fst_pair' ..) <;> grind
  case snd_pair' =>
    apply EqTm.trans_tm' _ (EqTm.snd_pair' ..)
    . grind
    · autosubst; grind [eqSb_snoc, wfSb_snoc]
    all_goals grind
  case idRec_refl' A t _ _ ihA iht ihC _ _ _ σσ' _ =>
    have σ := σσ'.wf_left
    have σ' := σσ'.wf_right
    have Γ := σ.wf_cod
    have Δ := σ.wf_dom
    have Aσ := ihA.1 σ
    have Aσ' := ihA.1 σ'
    have Id := Id_bvar Γ A t
    apply (EqTm.idRec_refl' Aσ _ ?C ..).trans_tm' ?C'
    case C =>
      apply ihC.1
      convert wfSb_up (wfSb_up σ A Aσ) Id _ using 1
      · autosubst
      · exact autosubst% Id_bvar Δ Aσ (iht.1 σ)
    case C' =>
      autosubst; apply ihC.1
      have := wfSb_snoc σ A Aσ (iht.1 σ)
      apply wfSb_snoc this Id
      · exact autosubst% WfTp.Id' Aσ (iht.1 σ) (iht.1 σ)
      · exact autosubst% WfTm.refl' Aσ (iht.1 σ)
    all_goals grind
  case code_el iha _ _ _ eq =>
    have aσ' := iha.1 eq.wf_right
    have := aσ'.le_univMax
    apply (iha.2 eq).trans_tm' (WfTp.univ eq.wf_dom <| by omega)
    apply EqTm.code_el aσ'
  case lam_app' ihA ihB ihf _ _ _ σσ' =>
    apply (ihf.2 σσ').trans_tm' (by grind [WfTp.pi'])
    have := EqTm.lam_app'
      (ihA.1 <| σσ'.wf_right)
      (ihB.1 <| by grind)
      (ihf.1 <| σσ'.wf_right)
    convert this.conv_eq _ using 3 <;> autosubst
    grind [EqTp.cong_pi', EqSb.symm, Expr.up_eq_snoc]
  case pair_fst_snd' =>
    apply EqTm.trans_tm' _ (EqTm.pair_fst_snd' ..) <;>
      grind [WfTp.sigma', EqTm.cong_pair', EqTm.cong_fst', EqTm.cong_snd']
  case symm_tm' => grind [EqTm.conv_eq, EqSb.symm]
  grind_cases

name: WfTp.subst_eq
statement:
theorem WfTp.subst_eq (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) (hσσ' : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ A.subst σ'

name: EqTp.subst_eq
statement:
theorem EqTp.subst_eq (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B) (hσσ' : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ B.subst σ'

name: WfTm.subst_eq
statement:
theorem WfTm.subst_eq (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) (hσσ' : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ ≡ t.subst σ' : A.subst σ

name: EqTm.subst_eq
statement:
theorem EqTm.subst_eq (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A) (hσσ' : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ ≡ u.subst σ' : A.subst σ

name: WfTp.subst
statement: theorem WfTp.subst (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) (hσ : WfSb E Δ σ Γ) : E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ

name: EqTp.subst
statement:
theorem EqTp.subst (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B) (hσ : WfSb E Δ σ Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ B.subst σ

name: WfTm.subst
statement:
theorem WfTm.subst (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) (hσ : WfSb E Δ σ Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ : A.subst σ

name: EqTm.subst
statement:
theorem EqTm.subst (h : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A) (hσ : WfSb E Δ σ Γ) :
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t.subst σ ≡ u.subst σ : A.subst σ

name: snoc
statement:
theorem snoc : WfSb E Δ σ Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t : A.subst σ →
    WfSb E Δ (Expr.snoc σ t) ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun σ A t => wfSb_snoc σ A (A.subst σ) t

name: up
statement:
theorem up : WfSb E Δ σ Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
    WfSb E ((A.subst σ, l) :: Δ) (Expr.up σ) ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun σ A => wfSb_up σ A (A.subst σ)

name: up
statement:
theorem up : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
    EqSb E ((A.subst σ, l) :: Δ) (Expr.up σ) (Expr.up σ') ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun σσ' A => eqSb_up σσ' A (A.subst σσ'.wf_left) (A.subst σσ'.wf_right) (A.subst_eq σσ')

name: Axioms.Wf.atCtx
statement: theorem Axioms.Wf.atCtx {c Al} : E.Wf → WfCtx E Γ → E c = some Al → E ∣ Γ ⊢[Al.val.2] Al.val.1
proof:
:= by
  intro E Γwf Ec
  induction Γ
  . exact E Ec
  . rename_i ih
    rcases Γwf with _ | ⟨Γwf, A⟩
    simpa [Expr.subst_of_isClosed _ Al.2.1] using (ih Γwf).subst (SubstProof.wfSb_wk Γwf A)

name: snoc_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_zero {X} (σ : Nat → X) (x : X) : snoc σ x 0 = x

name: snoc_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_succ {X} (σ : Nat → X) (x : X) (n) : snoc σ x (n + 1) = σ n

name: upr_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upr_id : upr id = id

name: up_bvar
statement:
@[simp]
theorem up_bvar (χ) : up (χ := χ) Expr.bvar = Expr.bvar

name: subst_bvar
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subst_bvar (χ) : subst (χ := χ) Expr.bvar = id
proof:
:= by
  ext t; dsimp; induction t <;> grind [subst, up_bvar]

name: subst_snoc_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subst_snoc_zero (σ : Nat → Expr χ) (t : Expr χ) : subst (snoc σ t) (.bvar 0) = t

name: ofRen_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofRen_id (χ) : ofRen χ id = Expr.bvar

name: ofRen_upr
statement: theorem ofRen_upr (χ ξ) : ofRen χ (upr ξ) = up (ofRen χ ξ)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> simp [ofRen, upr, up, snoc, rename]

name: rename_eq_subst_ofRen
statement: theorem rename_eq_subst_ofRen (χ) (ξ : Nat → Nat) : rename ξ = subst (ofRen χ ξ)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  induction t generalizing ξ <;> dsimp [rename, subst]
  case bvar => simp [ofRen]
  all_goals grind [ofRen_upr]

name: bvar_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bvar_comp (σ : Nat → Expr χ) : comp Expr.bvar σ = σ

name: comp_bvar
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_bvar (σ : Nat → Expr χ) : comp σ Expr.bvar = σ

name: up_comp_ren_sb
statement:
theorem up_comp_ren_sb (ξ : Nat → Nat) (σ : Nat → Expr χ) :
    up (σ ∘ ξ) = up σ ∘ upr ξ

name: rename_subst
statement: theorem rename_subst (σ ξ) (t : Expr χ) : (t.rename ξ).subst σ = t.subst (σ ∘ ξ)
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing σ ξ
  all_goals grind [rename, subst, up_comp_ren_sb]

name: up_comp_sb_ren
statement:
theorem up_comp_sb_ren (σ : Nat → Expr χ) (ξ : Nat → Nat) :
    up (rename ξ ∘ σ) = rename (upr ξ) ∘ up σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> (unfold up; dsimp [snoc, rename, upr])
  conv => lhs; rw [rename_eq_subst_ofRen, rename_subst]
  conv => rhs; rw [rename_eq_subst_ofRen, rename_subst]
  rfl

name: subst_rename
statement:
theorem subst_rename (ξ σ) (t : Expr χ) :
    (t.subst σ).rename ξ = t.subst (rename ξ ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing ξ σ
  all_goals grind [subst, rename, up_comp_sb_ren]

name: up_comp
statement:
theorem up_comp (σ τ : Nat → Expr χ) :
    up (comp σ τ) = comp (up σ) (up τ)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> simp [up, comp, snoc]
  simp [subst_rename, rename_subst]; congr

name: subst_subst
statement:
theorem subst_subst (σ τ : Nat → Expr χ) (t : Expr χ) :
    (t.subst τ).subst σ = t.subst (comp σ τ)
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing σ τ
  case bvar => dsimp [subst, comp]
  all_goals grind [subst, up_comp]

name: comp_assoc
statement: theorem comp_assoc (σ τ ρ : Nat → Expr χ) : comp σ (comp τ ρ) = comp (comp σ τ) ρ
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  conv => rhs; enter [0]; unfold comp
  dsimp; rw [← subst_subst]; dsimp [comp]

name: comp_snoc
statement:
theorem comp_snoc (σ τ : Nat → Expr χ) (t : Expr χ) :
    comp σ (snoc τ t) = snoc (comp σ τ) (t.subst σ)

name: ofRen_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofRen_succ (χ) : ofRen χ Nat.succ = wk

name: up_eq_snoc
statement: theorem up_eq_snoc (σ : Nat → Expr χ) : up σ = snoc (comp wk σ) (.bvar 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; unfold up comp; congr 1; ext j
  rw [rename_eq_subst_ofRen]; congr 1

name: snoc_comp_wk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_comp_wk (σ : Nat → Expr χ) (t) : comp (snoc σ t) wk = σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> dsimp [comp, snoc, wk, ofRen, subst, -ofRen_succ]

name: snoc_wk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_wk_zero (χ) : snoc wk (Expr.bvar (χ := χ) 0) = Expr.bvar

name: snoc_comp_wk_succ
statement:
theorem snoc_comp_wk_succ (σ : Nat → Expr χ) (n) :
    snoc (comp wk σ) (bvar (n + 1)) = comp wk (snoc σ (bvar n))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> dsimp [comp, snoc, wk, -ofRen_succ, subst, ofRen]

name: snoc_comp_wk_zero_subst
statement:
theorem snoc_comp_wk_zero_subst (σ : Nat → Expr χ) :
    snoc (comp σ Expr.wk) ((Expr.bvar 0).subst σ) = σ
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> dsimp [snoc, comp, subst, wk, ofRen, -ofRen_succ]

name: ofRen_comp
statement:
theorem ofRen_comp (χ) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Nat → Nat) :
    ofRen χ (ξ₁ ∘ ξ₂) = comp (ofRen χ ξ₁) (ofRen χ ξ₂)

name: wk_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wk_app (χ) (n) : wk (χ := χ) n = .bvar (n + 1)

name: subst_toSb_subst
statement:
theorem subst_toSb_subst (B a : Expr χ) σ :
    (B.subst a.toSb).subst σ = (B.subst (Expr.up σ)).subst (a.subst σ).toSb

name: subst_snoc_toSb_subst
statement:
theorem subst_snoc_toSb_subst (B a b : Expr χ) σ :
    (B.subst <| Expr.snoc a.toSb b).subst σ =
      (B.subst <| Expr.up <| Expr.up σ).subst (Expr.snoc (a.subst σ).toSb (b.subst σ))

name: SbIsBvar.up
statement: theorem SbIsBvar.up {σ : Nat → Expr χ} {n} : SbIsBvar σ n → SbIsBvar (Expr.up σ) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro σk ⟨⟩ lt
  . simp [Expr.up_eq_snoc]
  . have := σk (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp lt)
    simp [Expr.up_eq_snoc, Expr.comp, this, Expr.subst]

name: SbIsBvar.zero
statement: theorem SbIsBvar.zero (σ : Nat → Expr χ) : SbIsBvar σ 0

name: subst_of_isClosed'
statement:
theorem subst_of_isClosed' {e : Expr χ} {k} {σ : Nat → Expr χ} :
    e.isClosed k → SbIsBvar σ k → e.subst σ = e
proof:
:= by
  intro h hσ
  induction e generalizing k σ
  case bvar =>
    simp only [isClosed, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    simp [subst, hσ h]
  all_goals grind [subst, isClosed, → SbIsBvar.up]

name: subst_of_isClosed
statement: theorem subst_of_isClosed {e : Expr χ} (σ : Nat → Expr χ) : e.isClosed → e.subst σ = e

name: EqCtx.inv_snoc
statement:
theorem EqCtx.inv_snoc {A l} : EqCtx E ((A, l) :: Γ) Γ' →
    ∃ Γ'' A', Γ' = ((A', l) :: Γ'') ∧ EqCtx E Γ Γ'' ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A')

name: EqCtx.wf_left
statement: theorem EqCtx.wf_left : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → WfCtx E Γ
proof:
:= by
  intro eq; induction eq <;> grind [WfCtx.nil, WfCtx.snoc, EqTp.wf_ctx, EqTp.wf_left]

name: EqCtx.wf_right
statement: theorem EqCtx.wf_right : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → WfCtx E Γ'
proof:
:= by
  intro eq; induction eq <;> grind [WfCtx.nil, WfCtx.snoc, EqTp.wf_ctx, EqTp.wf_right]

name: EqCtx.wf_sb
statement: theorem EqCtx.wf_sb : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → WfSb E Γ Expr.bvar Γ'
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h
  case nil => exact WfSb.id WfCtx.nil
  case snoc' Γ Γ' A A' l _ eq eq' sb =>
    have wk : WfSb E ((A, l) :: Γ) Expr.wk Γ := WfSb.wk eq.wf_left
    have wk' : WfSb E ((A, l) :: Γ) Expr.wk Γ' := WfSb.comp wk sb
    have : WfSb E ((A, l) :: Γ) (Expr.snoc Expr.wk (Expr.bvar 0)) ((A', l) :: Γ') := by
      apply WfSb.snoc wk' eq'.wf_right
      have := WfTm.bvar (eq.wf_ctx.snoc eq.wf_left) (Lookup.zero ..)
      exact this.conv (eq.subst wk)
    convert this using 1; autosubst

name: WfTp.conv_ctx
statement: theorem WfTp.conv_ctx : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ' ⊢[l] A
proof:
:= by
  intro eq A
  convert A.subst eq.symm.wf_sb using 1 <;> autosubst

name: WfTm.conv_ctx
statement: theorem WfTm.conv_ctx : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ Γ' ⊢[l] t : A
proof:
:= by
  intro eq t
  convert t.subst eq.symm.wf_sb using 1 <;> autosubst

proof:
:= by
  intro eq AB
  convert AB.subst eq.symm.wf_sb using 1 <;> autosubst

name: EqTm.conv_ctx
statement: theorem EqTm.conv_ctx : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A → E ∣ Γ' ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A
proof:
:= by
  intro eq tu
  convert tu.subst eq.symm.wf_sb using 1 <;> autosubst

name: WfSb.conv_dom
statement: theorem WfSb.conv_dom : EqCtx E Δ Δ' → WfSb E Δ σ Γ → WfSb E Δ' σ Γ
proof:
:= by
  intro eq σ
  convert eq.symm.wf_sb.comp σ using 1 <;> autosubst

name: WfSb.conv_cod
statement: theorem WfSb.conv_cod : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → WfSb E Δ σ Γ → WfSb E Δ σ Γ'
proof:
:= by
  intro eq σ
  exact σ.comp eq.wf_sb

name: EqCtx.snoc
statement: theorem EqCtx.snoc : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' → EqCtx E ((A, l) :: Γ) ((A', l) :: Γ')
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A => .snoc' Γ A (A.conv_ctx Γ)

name: EqCtx.trans
statement: theorem EqCtx.trans : EqCtx E Γ Γ' → EqCtx E Γ' Γ'' → EqCtx E Γ Γ''
proof:
:= by
  intro h h'; induction h generalizing Γ''
  . assumption
  . have := h'.inv_snoc
    grind [EqCtx.snoc, EqCtx.symm, EqTp.trans_tp, EqTp.conv_ctx]

name: EqCtx.lookup_eq
statement:
theorem EqCtx.lookup_eq : EqCtx E Γ Γ' →
    Lookup Γ i A l → Lookup Γ' i A' l' → l = l' ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A')
proof:
:= by
  intro eq lk lk'
  induction lk generalizing Γ' A'
  . cases lk'
    have ⟨_, _, _, _, eqA⟩ := eq.inv_snoc
    have := eqA.subst (WfSb.wk eqA.wf_left)
    grind
  . rename_i ih
    rcases lk' with _ | ⟨_, lk'⟩
    have ⟨_, _, h, eq, eqB⟩ := eq.inv_snoc
    cases h
    have := (ih eq lk').2.subst (WfSb.wk eqB.wf_left)
    grind

name: isClosed_all
statement:
theorem isClosed_all :
    (∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → A.isClosed Γ.length) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → t.isClosed Γ.length)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfTp
  case bvar =>
    intros; rename_i lk _
    simp [Expr.isClosed, lk.lt_length]
  all_goals grind [Expr.isClosed]

name: snoc_get
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_get (E : Axioms χ) (l c A l_le A_cl) :
    E.snoc l c A l_le A_cl c = some ⟨(A, l), ⟨A_cl, l_le⟩⟩

name: le_snoc
statement:
theorem le_snoc {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') (l c A l_le A_cl) (Ec : E c = none) :
    E ≤ E'.snoc l c A l_le A_cl
proof:
:= by
  intro d Al Ed
  have : d ≠ c := by grind
  simpa [snoc, this, ↓reduceIte] using le Ed

name: le_snoc_self
statement:
theorem le_snoc_self (E : Axioms χ) (l c A l_le A_cl) (Ec : E c = none) :
    E ≤ E.snoc l c A l_le A_cl
proof:
:=
  le_snoc (refl _) l c A l_le A_cl Ec

name: snoc_le
statement:
theorem snoc_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') (l c A l_le A_cl)
    (E'c : E' c = some ⟨(A, l), ⟨A_cl, l_le⟩⟩) :
    E.snoc l c A l_le A_cl ≤ E'
proof:
:= by
  intro d Al Ed
  by_cases eq : d = c
  . cases eq; convert E'c using 2; simpa [snoc] using Ed.symm
  . simp only [snoc, eq, ↓reduceIte] at Ed; exact le Ed

name: of_le_all
statement:
theorem of_le_all {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') :
    (∀ {Γ}, WfCtx E Γ → WfCtx E' Γ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A B}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B → E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t u}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A → E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  case ax =>
    intros; rename_i Ec _ Γ ihA
    apply WfTm.ax Γ (le Ec) ihA
  grind_cases

name: WfTm.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem WfTm.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} {Γ A t l} (le : E ≤ E') (Γt : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) :
    E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A

name: EqTm.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem EqTm.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} {Γ A t u l} (le : E ≤ E') (Γtu : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A) :
    E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A

name: Axioms.Wf.snoc
proof:
:= by
  intro d Al Ed
  simp only [Axioms.snoc] at Ed
  have le := E.le_snoc_self l c A Awf.le_univMax Awf.isClosed Ec
  by_cases eq : d = c <;> simp only [eq, ↓reduceIte] at Ed
  . cases Ed
    exact Awf.of_axioms_le le
  . exact (Ewf Ed).of_axioms_le le

name: WfTp.inv_pi
statement:
theorem WfTp.inv_pi {Γ A B l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .pi l l' A B →
    l₀ = max l l' ∧ (E ∣ (A,l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → ∀ {A' B l₁ l₂}, A = .pi l₁ l₂ A' B →
        l = max l₁ l₂ ∧ (E ∣ (A', l₁) :: Γ ⊢[l₂] B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind

name: WfTp.inv_sigma
statement:
theorem WfTp.inv_sigma {Γ A B l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .sigma l l' A B →
    l₀ = max l l' ∧ (E ∣ (A,l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → ∀ {A' B l₁ l₂}, A = .sigma l₁ l₂ A' B →
        l = max l₁ l₂ ∧ (E ∣ (A', l₁) :: Γ ⊢[l₂] B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind

name: WfTp.inv_Id
statement:
theorem WfTp.inv_Id {Γ A t u l₀ l} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .Id l A t u →
    l₀ = l ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ T}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] T → ∀ {l t u}, T = .Id l A t u →
        l₀ = l ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind

name: WfTp.inv_univ
statement: theorem WfTp.inv_univ {Γ l₀ l} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .univ l → l₀ = l+1
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → ∀ {l₁}, A = .univ l₁ → l = l₁+1 from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind

name: WfTp.inv_el
statement: theorem WfTp.inv_el {Γ a l} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .el a → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l+1] a : .univ l
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → ∀ {a}, A = .el a → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l+1] a : .univ l from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind

name: WfTp.pi
statement:
theorem WfTp.pi {Γ A B l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .pi l l' A B

name: WfTp.sigma
statement:
theorem WfTp.sigma {Γ A B l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .sigma l l' A B

name: WfTp.Id
statement:
theorem WfTp.Id {Γ A t u l} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .Id l A t u
proof:
:=
  fun t u => WfTp.Id' t.wf_tp t u

name: EqTp.cong_pi
statement:
theorem EqTp.cong_pi {Γ A A' B B' l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .pi l l' A B ≡ .pi l l' A' B'
proof:
:=
  fun hAA' hBB' => EqTp.cong_pi' hAA'.wf_left hAA'.wf_right hAA' hBB'

name: EqTp.cong_sigma
statement:
theorem EqTp.cong_sigma {Γ A A' B B' l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .sigma l l' A B ≡ .sigma l l' A' B'
proof:
:=
  fun hAA' hBB' => EqTp.cong_sigma' hAA'.wf_left hAA'.wf_right hAA' hBB'

name: WfTm.lam
statement:
theorem WfTm.lam {Γ A B t l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] t : B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .lam l l' A t : .pi l l' A B

name: WfTm.app
statement:
theorem WfTm.app {Γ A B f a l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] f : .pi l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] a : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .app l l' B f a : B.subst a.toSb
proof:
:=
  fun hf ha =>
    have ⟨_, hB⟩ := hf.wf_tp.inv_pi
    WfTm.app' hB.wf_binder hB hf ha

name: WfTm.pair
statement:
theorem WfTm.pair {Γ A B t u l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] u : B.subst t.toSb →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .pair l l' B t u : .sigma l l' A B
proof:
:=
  fun hB ht hu => WfTm.pair' ht.wf_tp hB ht hu

name: WfTm.fst
statement:
theorem WfTm.fst {Γ A B p l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p : .sigma l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .fst l l' A B p : A
proof:
:=
  fun hp =>
    have ⟨_, hB⟩ := hp.wf_tp.inv_sigma
    WfTm.fst' hB.wf_binder hB hp

name: WfTm.snd
statement:
theorem WfTm.snd {Γ A B p l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p : .sigma l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .snd l l' A B p : B.subst (Expr.fst l l' A B p).toSb
proof:
:=
  fun hp =>
    have ⟨_, hB⟩ := hp.wf_tp.inv_sigma
    WfTm.snd' hB.wf_binder hB hp

name: WfTm.refl
statement:
theorem WfTm.refl {Γ A t l} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .refl l t : .Id l A t t

name: WfTm.idRec
statement:
theorem WfTm.idRec {Γ A M t r u h l l'} :
    E ∣ (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] M →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] r : M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t) →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] h : .Id l A t u →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .idRec l l' t M r u h : M.subst (.snoc u.toSb h)
proof:
:=
  fun M r h =>
    have ⟨_, t, u⟩ := h.wf_tp.inv_Id
    .idRec' t.wf_tp t M r u h

name: EqTm.cong_lam
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_lam {Γ A A' B t t' l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] t ≡ t' : B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .lam l l' A t ≡ .lam l l' A' t' : .pi l l' A B
proof:
:=
  fun hAA' htt' => EqTm.cong_lam' hAA'.wf_left hAA'.wf_right hAA' htt'

name: EqTm.cong_app
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_app {Γ A B B' f f' a a' l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] f ≡ f' : .pi l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] a ≡ a' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .app l l' B f a ≡ .app l l' B' f' a' : B.subst a.toSb
proof:
:=
  fun hBB' hff' haa' => EqTm.cong_app' haa'.wf_tp hBB' hff' haa'

name: EqTm.cong_pair
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_pair {Γ A B B' t t' u u' l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] u ≡ u' : B.subst t.toSb →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] .pair l l' B t u ≡ .pair l l' B' t' u' : .sigma l l' A B
proof:
:=
  fun hBB' htt' huu' => EqTm.cong_pair' htt'.wf_tp hBB' htt' huu'

name: EqTm.cong_fst
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_fst {Γ A A' B B' p p' l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p ≡ p' : .sigma l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .fst l l' A B p ≡ .fst l l' A' B' p' : A
proof:
:=
  fun hAA' hBB' hpp' => EqTm.cong_fst' hAA'.wf_left hAA' hBB' hpp'

name: EqTm.cong_snd
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_snd {Γ A A' B B' p p' l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p ≡ p' : .sigma l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .snd l l' A B p ≡ .snd l l' A' B' p' : B.subst (Expr.fst l l' A B p).toSb
proof:
:=
  fun hAA' hBB' hpp' => EqTm.cong_snd' hAA'.wf_left hAA' hBB' hpp'

name: EqTm.cong_idRec
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_idRec {Γ A M M' t t' r r' u u' h h' l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    E ∣ (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] M ≡ M' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] r ≡ r' : M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t) →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u ≡ u' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] h ≡ h' : .Id l A t u →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .idRec l l' t M r u h ≡ .idRec l l' t' M' r' u' h' : M.subst (.snoc u.toSb h)
proof:
:=
  fun teq Meq req ueq heq => .cong_idRec' teq.wf_tp teq.wf_left teq Meq req ueq heq

name: EqTm.app_lam
statement:
theorem EqTm.app_lam {Γ A B t u l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] t : B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .app l l' B (.lam l l' A t) u ≡ t.subst u.toSb : B.subst u.toSb
proof:
:=
  fun ht hu => EqTm.app_lam' hu.wf_tp ht.wf_tp ht hu

name: EqTm.fst_pair
statement:
theorem EqTm.fst_pair {Γ A B t u l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] u : B.subst t.toSb →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .fst l l' A B (.pair l l' B t u) ≡ t : A
proof:
:=
  fun hB ht hu => EqTm.fst_pair' ht.wf_tp hB ht hu

name: EqTm.snd_pair
statement:
theorem EqTm.snd_pair {Γ A B t u l l'} :
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] u : B.subst t.toSb →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .snd l l' A B (.pair l l' B t u) ≡ u : B.subst t.toSb
proof:
:=
  fun hB ht hu => EqTm.snd_pair' ht.wf_tp hB ht hu

name: EqTm.cong_refl
statement:
theorem EqTm.cong_refl {Γ A t t' l} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .refl l t ≡ .refl l t' : .Id l A t t

name: EqTm.idRec_refl
statement:
theorem EqTm.idRec_refl {Γ A M t r l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] M →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] r : M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t) →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] .idRec l l' t M r t (.refl l t) ≡ r : M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t)
proof:
:=
  fun t M r => .idRec_refl' t.wf_tp t M r

name: EqTm.lam_app
statement:
theorem EqTm.lam_app {Γ A B f l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] f : .pi l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] f ≡
      .lam l l' A (.app l l' (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk)) (f.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0)) :
      .pi l l' A B
proof:
:=
  fun hf =>
    have ⟨_, hB⟩ := hf.wf_tp.inv_pi
    EqTm.lam_app' hB.wf_binder hB hf

name: EqTm.pair_fst_snd
statement:
theorem EqTm.pair_fst_snd {Γ A B p l l'} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p : .sigma l l' A B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p ≡ .pair l l' B (.fst l l' A B p) (.snd l l' A B p) : .sigma l l' A B
proof:
:=
  fun hp =>
    have ⟨_, hB⟩ := hp.wf_tp.inv_sigma
    EqTm.pair_fst_snd' hB.wf_binder hB hp

name: EqTm.symm_tm
statement:
theorem EqTm.symm_tm {Γ A t t' l} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t' ≡ t : A

name: EqTm.trans_tm
statement:
theorem EqTm.trans_tm {Γ A t t' t'' l} :
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t' ≡ t'' : A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t'' : A
proof:
:=
  fun htt' ht't'' => EqTm.trans_tm' htt'.wf_tp htt' ht't''

name: WfTp.Id_bvar
statement:
theorem WfTp.Id_bvar {Γ A t l} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l] .Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0)

name: WfTm.inv_ax
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_ax {Γ A C c l₀} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .ax c A : C →
    ∃ Al, E c = some Al ∧ A = Al.val.1 ∧ l₀ = Al.val.2 ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ Al.val.1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] t : C → ∀ {c A}, t = .ax c A → ∃ Al,
        E c = some Al ∧ A = Al.val.1 ∧ l₀ = Al.val.2 ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ Al.val.1) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  all_goals try grind
  case ax =>
    intros; rename_i Γ Ec A _ _ _ _ eq; cases eq
    exact ⟨_, Ec, rfl, rfl, .refl_tp A⟩
  case conv => grind [EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_bvar
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_bvar {Γ A i l} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] .bvar i : A →
    ∃ B, Lookup Γ i B l ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : C → ∀ {i}, t = .bvar i → ∃ B,
        Lookup Γ i B l ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;>
    grind [EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp, WfCtx.lookup_wf]

name: WfTm.inv_lam
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_lam {Γ A C b l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .lam l l' A b : C →
    l₀ = max l l' ∧ ∃ B,
      (E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] b : B) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] C ≡ .pi l l' A B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : C → ∀ {A b l₁ l₂}, t = .lam l₁ l₂ A b →
        l = max l₁ l₂ ∧ ∃ B,
          (E ∣ (A, l₁) :: Γ ⊢[l₂] b : B) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l₁ l₂] C ≡ .pi l₁ l₂ A B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;>
    try grind [WfTp.pi, WfTm.wf_tp, EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_app
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_app {Γ B C f a l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .app l l' B f a : C →
    l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A,
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] f : .pi l l' A B) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] a : A) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ B.subst a.toSb)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] t : C → ∀ {B f a l l'}, t = .app l l' B f a →
        l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A,
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] f : .pi l l' A B) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] a : A) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ B.subst a.toSb) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;>
    grind [InvProof.tp_inst, WfTp.wf_ctx, EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_pair
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_pair {Γ B C t u l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .pair l l' B t u : C →
    l₀ = max l l' ∧ ∃ A,
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] u : B.subst t.toSb) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ .sigma l l' A B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : C → ∀ {B t' u' l₁ l₂}, t = .pair l₁ l₂ B t' u' →
        l = max l₁ l₂ ∧ ∃ A,
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₁] t' : A) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₂] u' : B.subst t'.toSb) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ .sigma l₁ l₂ A B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind [WfTp.sigma, WfTm.wf_tp, EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_fst
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_fst {Γ A B C p l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .fst l l' A B p : C →
    l₀ = l ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p : .sigma l l' A B) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ A)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : C → ∀ {A B p l₁ l₂}, t = .fst l₁ l₂ A B p →
        l = l₁ ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l₁ l₂] p : .sigma l₁ l₂ A B) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ A) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind [EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_snd
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_snd {Γ A B C p l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .snd l l' A B p : C →
    l₀ = l' ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p : .sigma l l' A B) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ B.subst (Expr.fst l l' A B p).toSb)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : C → ∀ {A B p l₁ l₂}, t = .snd l₁ l₂ A B p →
        l = l₂ ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l₁ l₂] p : .sigma l₁ l₂ A B) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ B.subst (Expr.fst l₁ l₂ A B p).toSb) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;>
    grind [InvProof.tp_inst, EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp, WfTm.fst, WfTp.wf_ctx]

name: WfTm.inv_refl
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_refl {Γ C t l₀ l} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .refl l t : C →
    l₀ = l ∧ ∃ A, (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ .Id l A t t)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ C t'}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] t' : C → ∀ {l t}, t' = .refl l t →
        l₀ = l ∧ ∃ A, (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ .Id l A t t) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> grind [WfTp.Id,  EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, EqTp.trans_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_idRec
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_idRec {Γ M C t r u h l₀ l l'} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .idRec l l' t M r u h : C →
    l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A,
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧
      (E ∣ (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] M) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] r : M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t)) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] h : .Id l A t u) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ M.subst (.snoc u.toSb h))
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l₀ C t'}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] t' : C → ∀ {t M r u h l l'},
      t' = .idRec l l' t M r u h → l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A,
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧
        (E ∣ (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] M) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] r : M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t)) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] h : .Id l A t u) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ M.subst (.snoc u.toSb h)) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case refl t M r u h _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    refine ⟨rfl, _, t, M, r, u, h, ?_⟩
    apply EqTp.refl_tp <| M.subst (WfSb.snoc (WfSb.toSb u) _ _)
    . grind [WfTp.Id_bvar, WfTp.wf_ctx]
    . autosubst; assumption
  case conv => grind [EqTp.trans_tp, EqTp.symm_tp]

name: WfTm.inv_code
statement:
theorem WfTm.inv_code {Γ A C l₀} : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] .code A : C →
    ∃ l, l₀ = l+1 ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l+1] C ≡ .univ l)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l C t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : C → ∀ {A}, t = .code A →
        ∃ l₁, l = l₁+1 ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₁] A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₁+1] C ≡ .univ l₁) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction WfCtx <;> try grind [EqTp.refl_tp, WfTp.univ, WfTp.wf_ctx]
  case conv =>
    intros; rename_i ih _ _ eq
    obtain ⟨_, rfl, _⟩ := ih eq
    grind [EqTp.trans_tp, EqTp.symm_tp]

name: eqSb_snoc'
statement:
theorem eqSb_snoc' : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
    E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t : A.subst σ → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t' : A.subst σ' → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A.subst σ →
    EqSb E Δ (Expr.snoc σ t) (Expr.snoc σ' t') ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  intro σσ' A t t' tt'
  apply eqSb_snoc σσ' A (A.subst σσ'.wf_left) (A.subst σσ'.wf_right) (A.subst_eq σσ') t t' tt'

name: wfSb_conv_binder
statement:
theorem wfSb_conv_binder : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    WfSb E ((A', l) :: Γ) Expr.bvar ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  intro Γ A A' AA'
  rw [show Expr.bvar = Expr.up Expr.bvar by autosubst, Expr.up_eq_snoc]
  apply WfSb.snoc
  . apply wfSb_wk <;> assumption
  . assumption
  . apply WfTm.conv (WfTm.bvar (WfCtx.snoc Γ A') (Lookup.zero ..))
    apply eqTp_wk Γ A' AA'.symm_tp

name: tp_conv_binder
statement:
theorem tp_conv_binder : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B → E ∣ (A', l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B
proof:
:= by
  intro Γ A A' AA' B
  exact autosubst% B.subst (wfSb_conv_binder Γ A A' AA')

name: tm_conv_binder
statement:
theorem tm_conv_binder : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A' →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] t : B → E ∣ (A', l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] t : B
proof:
:= by
  intro Γ A A' AA' t
  exact autosubst% t.subst (wfSb_conv_binder Γ A A' AA')

name: tp_inst
statement:
theorem tp_inst : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] B.subst t.toSb
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A t B => subst_all.1 B |>.1 ((WfSb.id Γ).snoc A (autosubst% t))

name: tm_inst
statement:
theorem tm_inst : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
    E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] b : B →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] b.subst t.toSb : B.subst t.toSb
proof:
:=
  fun Γ A t b => subst_all.2.2.1 b |>.1 ((WfSb.id Γ).snoc A (autosubst% t))

name: eqtp_inst
statement:
theorem eqtp_inst : WfCtx E Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t' : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A →
    E ∣ ((A, l) :: Γ) ⊢[l'] B ≡ B' →
    E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] B.subst t.toSb ≡ B'.subst t'.toSb
proof:
:= by
  intro Γ A t t' tt' BB'
  apply subst_all.2.1 BB' (eqSb_snoc ..)
  all_goals (try autosubst); grind [WfSb.id, EqSb.refl, EqTp.refl_tp]

name: inv_all
statement:
theorem inv_all :
    (∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A →
      WfCtx E Γ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A B}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B →
      (WfCtx E Γ) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] B)) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A →
      (WfCtx E Γ) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A)) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t u}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A →
      (WfCtx E Γ) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] u : A))
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  all_goals dsimp; try intros
  case bvar => grind [WfCtx.lookup_wf]
  case cong_pi' => grind [WfTp.pi']
  case cong_sigma' => grind [WfTp.sigma']
  case cong_Id => grind [WfTp.Id', WfTm.conv]
  case cong_el => grind [WfTp.el]
  case el_code => grind [WfTp.el, WfTm.code]
  case lam' => grind [WfTp.pi']
  case app' => grind [tp_inst]
  case pair' => grind [WfTp.sigma']
  case snd' => grind [tp_inst, WfTm.fst']
  case refl' => grind [WfTp.Id']
  case idRec' C _ _ h _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?C⟩
    case C =>
      apply C.subst ((wfSb_toSb _ _ _).snoc _ (autosubst% h))
      all_goals grind [Id_bvar]
    all_goals grind
  case code => grind [WfTp.univ]
  case cong_lam' B _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, WfTm.conv (WfTm.lam' (B := B) ?_ ?_) ?_⟩
    all_goals grind [WfTm.lam', EqTp.cong_pi', EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp, WfTp.pi']
  case cong_app' Γ ihB ihf iha =>
    refine ⟨Γ, ?_, ?_,
      WfTm.conv
        (WfTm.app' iha.2.1 ihB.2.2
          (WfTm.conv ihf.2.2.2 ?_)
          iha.2.2.2)
        ?_⟩
    all_goals grind [EqTp.cong_pi', EqTp.refl_tp, tp_inst, eqtp_inst, EqTp.symm_tp, WfTm.app']
  case cong_pair' ihB iht ihu =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_,
      WfTm.conv (WfTm.pair' iht.2.1 ihB.2.2 ?_ (WfTm.conv ihu.2.2.2 ?_)) ?_⟩
    all_goals grind [WfTp.sigma', EqTp.cong_sigma', WfTm.pair', EqTp.refl_tp, EqTp.symm_tp,
      eqtp_inst]
  case cong_fst' ihA ihB ihp =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, WfTm.conv (WfTm.fst' ihA.2.2 ?_ (WfTm.conv ihp.2.2.2 ?_)) ?_⟩
    all_goals grind [WfTm.fst', EqTp.cong_sigma', EqTp.symm_tp]
  case cong_snd' ihA ihB ihp =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_,
      WfTm.conv (WfTm.snd' ihA.2.2 ?_ (WfTm.conv ihp.2.2.2 ?_))
        (eqtp_inst ihA.1 ihA.2.1
          (WfTm.conv (WfTm.fst' ihA.2.2 ?_ ?_) ?_)
          ?_ ?_ ?_)⟩
    all_goals grind [tp_inst, WfTm.fst', WfTm.snd', EqTp.cong_sigma', WfTm.conv,
      EqTm.symm_tm', EqTm.cong_fst', EqTp.symm_tp]
  case cong_refl' eq iheq =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?c⟩
    case c =>
      apply (WfTm.refl' iheq.2.1 iheq.2.2.2).conv
      grind [EqTp.cong_Id, EqTm.symm_tm', EqTp.refl_tp]
    all_goals grind [WfTp.Id', WfTm.refl']
  case cong_idRec' A t teq Ceq _ ueq heq _ _ iht ihC ihr _ ihh =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?C, ?_, ?c⟩
    case C =>
      apply ihC.2.1.subst <| WfSb.snoc (wfSb_toSb _ _ _) _ (autosubst% ihh.2.2.1)
      all_goals grind [Id_bvar]
    case c =>
      apply (WfTm.idRec' iht.2.1 ..).conv
      . apply EqTp.symm_tp
        apply Ceq.subst_eq
        apply eqSb_snoc' (eqSb_toSb ..) _ ?hwf ?h'wf ?hh'
        case hwf => exact autosubst% ihh.2.2.1
        case h'wf =>
          autosubst
          apply ihh.2.2.2.conv <| EqTp.cong_Id (.refl_tp A) (.refl_tm t) ueq
        case hh' => exact autosubst% heq
        all_goals grind [Id_bvar, EqTm.symm_tm']
      . grind
      . apply tp_conv_binder _ _ _ ?eq ihC.2.2
        case eq =>
          apply EqTp.cong_Id (.refl_tp <| tp_wk _ A A) (eqTm_wk _ _ teq)
              (EqTm.refl_tm (WfTm.bvar _ (.zero ..)))
            <;> grind
        all_goals grind [Id_bvar]
      . apply ihr.2.2.2.conv
        apply Ceq.subst_eq
        apply eqSb_snoc' (eqSb_toSb ..) _ _ ?rwf _
        case rwf =>
          autosubst
          apply (WfTm.refl' A iht.2.2.2).conv
          grind [EqTp.cong_Id, EqTm.symm_tm', EqTm.refl_tm, EqTp.refl_tp]
        all_goals (try autosubst); grind [Id_bvar, WfTm.refl', EqTm.cong_refl']
      . grind
      . grind [EqTp.cong_Id, WfTm.conv, EqTp.refl_tp]
    all_goals grind [WfTm.idRec']
  case cong_code => grind [WfTp.univ, WfTm.code]
  case app_lam' => grind [WfTm.app', WfTm.lam', tp_inst, tm_inst]
  case fst_pair' => grind [WfTm.fst', WfTm.pair']
  case snd_pair' A B _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, WfTm.conv (WfTm.snd' ?_ ?_ ?_) ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals grind [eqtp_inst, EqTp.refl_tp, EqTm.fst_pair', WfTm.fst', WfTm.pair']
  case code_el => grind [WfTm.code, WfTp.el, WfTm.le_univMax]
  case idRec_refl' ihA _ _ =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?r, ?_⟩
    case r => apply WfTm.idRec' ihA.2 <;> grind [WfTm.refl']
    all_goals grind
  case lam_app' A B _ _ _ Awf Bwf fwf Γwf _ _ =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, WfTm.lam' ?_ ?app⟩
    
    case app =>
      have : (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk)).subst (Expr.bvar 0).toSb = B := by autosubst
      conv in B => rw [← this]
      apply WfTm.app' (A := A.subst Expr.wk)
      . grind [tp_wk]
      . apply (subst_all.1 Bwf).1
        . rw [Expr.up_eq_snoc]
          apply WfSb.snoc _ Awf
          . apply WfTm.bvar _ _
            . grind [tp_wk]
            . rw [show ∀ (A : Expr χ), A.subst (Expr.comp Expr.wk Expr.wk) =
                (A.subst Expr.wk).subst Expr.wk by intro; autosubst]
              apply Lookup.zero
          . apply WfSb.ofRen
            . grind [tp_wk]
            . assumption
            . apply WfRen.comp (WfRen.wk ..) (WfRen.wk ..)
      . exact tm_wk Γwf Awf fwf
      . exact WfTm.bvar (by grind) (Lookup.zero ..)
    all_goals grind
  case pair_fst_snd' => grind [WfTm.pair', WfTm.fst', WfTm.snd']
  case conv_eq => grind [EqTp.symm_tp, WfTm.conv]
  grind_cases

name: WfCtx.inv_snoc
statement:
theorem WfCtx.inv_snoc : WfCtx E ((A, l) :: Γ) → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A | .snoc _ hA => hA

statement:
theorem mk : WfCtx E Δ → WfCtx E Γ → (∀ {i A l}, Lookup Γ i A l → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] σ i : A.subst σ) →
    WfSb E Δ σ Γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold WfSb EqSb
  intro Δ Γ h
  refine ⟨Δ, Γ, fun lk => ?_⟩
  replace h := h lk
  exact ⟨h.wf_tp, h.wf_tp, EqTp.refl_tp h.wf_tp, h, h, EqTm.refl_tm h⟩

statement: theorem wk : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → WfSb E ((A, l) :: Γ) Expr.wk Γ

name: comp
statement: theorem comp : WfSb E Θ σ Δ → WfSb E Δ σ' Γ → WfSb E Θ (Expr.comp σ σ') Γ
proof:
:= by
  intro σ σ'
  apply mk σ.wf_dom σ'.wf_cod
  intro _ _ _ lk
  exact autosubst% σ'.lookup lk |>.subst σ

name: toSb
statement: theorem toSb : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → WfSb E Γ t.toSb ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=
  fun t => SubstProof.wfSb_toSb t.wf_ctx t.wf_tp t

name: mk
statement:
theorem mk : WfCtx E Δ → WfCtx E Γ →
    (∀ {i A l}, Lookup Γ i A l →
      (E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] A.subst σ ≡ A.subst σ') ∧ (E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] σ i ≡ σ' i : A.subst σ)) →
    EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold EqSb
  intro Δ Γ h
  refine ⟨Δ, Γ, fun lk => ?_⟩
  replace h := h lk
  have A := Γ.lookup_wf lk
  exact ⟨h.1.wf_left, h.1.wf_right, h.1, h.2.wf_left, WfTm.conv h.2.wf_right h.1, h.2⟩

name: snoc
statement:
theorem snoc : EqSb E Δ σ σ' Γ → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E ∣ Δ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A.subst σ →
    EqSb E Δ (Expr.snoc σ t) (Expr.snoc σ' t') ((A,l) :: Γ)
proof:
:= by
  intro σσ' A tt'
  apply SubstProof.eqSb_snoc σσ' A (A.subst σσ'.wf_left) (A.subst σσ'.wf_right)
    (A.subst_eq σσ') tt'.wf_left (tt'.wf_right.conv (A.subst_eq σσ')) tt'

name: toSb
statement: theorem toSb : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ t' : A → EqSb E Γ t.toSb t'.toSb ((A, l) :: Γ)
proof:
:=

name: lt_length
statement: theorem lt_length : Lookup Γ i A l → i < Γ.length
proof:
:= by
  intro lk; induction lk <;> (dsimp; omega)

name: lvl_eq
statement: theorem lvl_eq (lk : Lookup Γ i A l) : l = (Γ[i]'lk.lt_length).2

name: tp_uniq

proof:
:= by
  induction lk generalizing A' <;> grind [cases Lookup]

name: of_lt_length
statement: theorem of_lt_length : i < Γ.length → ∃ A l, Lookup Γ i A l
proof:
:= by
  intro lt
  induction Γ generalizing i
  · cases lt
  · cases i
    · exact ⟨_, _, Lookup.zero ..⟩
    · rename_i ih _
      have ⟨A, l, h⟩ := ih <| Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp lt
      exact ⟨A.subst Expr.wk, l, Lookup.succ _ h⟩

name: eq_synthLvl
statement:
theorem eq_synthLvl :
    (∀ {Γ l A}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → l = synthLvl Γ A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → l = synthLvl Γ t)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfTp
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  case bvar lk _ => simp [synthLvl, synthLvl.go, lk.lt_length, lk.lvl_eq]
  all_goals grind [synthLvl, synthLvl.go]

statement: theorem WfTp.uniq_lvl : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A → E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] A → l = l'

name: WfTm.uniq_lvl
statement: theorem WfTm.uniq_lvl : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E' ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] t : A' → l = l'

name: WfTm.tp_eq_synthTp
statement: theorem WfTm.tp_eq_synthTp : ∀ {Γ l A t}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ synthTp Γ t
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  case ax A _ _ =>
    simp only [synthTp]
    apply EqTp.refl_tp A
  case bvar Γ lk _ =>
    induction lk
    . simp only [synthTp, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.getD_some]
      apply EqTp.refl_tp
      exact Γ.inv_snoc.subst (WfSb.wk Γ.inv_snoc)
    . rename_i ih
      simp only [synthTp, List.drop_succ_cons, List.drop_zero]
      exact ih Γ.inv_snoc.wf_ctx |>.subst (WfSb.wk Γ.inv_snoc)
  case lam' => grind [EqTp.cong_pi]
  case app' => grind [WfTp.subst, WfSb.toSb]
  case pair' => grind [EqTp.cong_sigma]
  case fst' => grind
  case snd' => grind [WfTp.subst, WfSb.toSb, WfTm.fst]
  case refl' =>
    simp only [synthTp]
    gcongr <;> grind
  case idRec' C _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    unfold synthTp
    apply EqTp.refl_tp <| C.subst <| WfSb.snoc (WfSb.toSb ..) ..
    all_goals (try autosubst); grind [WfTp.Id_bvar, WfTp.wf_ctx]
  case code => grind [WfTp.lvl_eq_synthLvl, WfTp.univ, WfTp.wf_ctx]
  case conv => grind

name: WfTm.with_synthTp
statement: theorem WfTm.with_synthTp : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : synthTp Γ t

name: WfTm.uniq_tp
statement: theorem WfTm.uniq_tp : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] t : A' → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A'
proof:
:=
  fun tA tB => tA.tp_eq_synthTp.trans_tp (tA.uniq_lvl tB ▸ tB).tp_eq_synthTp.symm_tp

name: ValEqTp.inv_pi
statement:
theorem ValEqTp.inv_pi {Γ C vA vB l k k'} : ValEqTp E Γ l (.pi k k' vA vB) C →
    l = max k k' ∧ ∃ A B, ValEqTp E Γ k vA A ∧ ClosEqTp E Γ k k' A vB B ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max k k'] C ≡ .pi k k' A B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vC C}, ValEqTp E Γ l vC C →
      ∀ {vA vB k k'}, vC = .pi k k' vA vB →
        l = max k k' ∧ ∃ A B, ValEqTp E Γ k vA A ∧ ClosEqTp E Γ k k' A vB B ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max k k'] C ≡ .pi k k' A B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals grind [WfTp.pi, ClosEqTp.wf_tp]

name: ValEqTp.inv_sigma
statement:
theorem ValEqTp.inv_sigma {Γ C vA vB l k k'} : ValEqTp E Γ l (.sigma k k' vA vB) C →
    l = max k k' ∧ ∃ A B, ValEqTp E Γ k vA A ∧ ClosEqTp E Γ k k' A vB B ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max k k'] C ≡ .sigma k k' A B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vC C}, ValEqTp E Γ l vC C →
      ∀ {vA vB k k'}, vC = .sigma k k' vA vB →
        l = max k k' ∧ ∃ A B, ValEqTp E Γ k vA A ∧ ClosEqTp E Γ k k' A vB B ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max k k'] C ≡ .sigma k k' A B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals grind [WfTp.sigma, ClosEqTp.wf_tp]

name: ValEqTp.inv_Id
statement:
theorem ValEqTp.inv_Id {Γ C vA vt vu l k} : ValEqTp E Γ l (.Id k vA vt vu) C →
    l = k ∧ ∃ A t u,
      ValEqTp E Γ k vA A ∧ ValEqTm E Γ k vt t A ∧ ValEqTm E Γ k vu u A ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C ≡ .Id k A t u)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vC C}, ValEqTp E Γ l vC C →
    ∀ {vA vt vu k}, vC = .Id k vA vt vu →
    l = k ∧ ∃ A t u, ValEqTp E Γ k vA A ∧ ValEqTm E Γ k vt t A ∧ ValEqTm E Γ k vu u A ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C ≡ .Id k A t u) from
  fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  case Id =>
    introv vA vt vu
    have := WfTp.Id vt.wf_tm vu.wf_tm
    grind
  all_goals grind

name: ValEqTp.inv_univ
statement:
theorem ValEqTp.inv_univ {Γ l k t} : ValEqTp E Γ l (.univ k) t → l = k + 1 ∧
    (E ∣ Γ ⊢[k + 1] t ≡ .univ k)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vt t}, ValEqTp E Γ l vt t → ∀ {k}, vt = .univ k → l = k + 1 ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[k + 1] t ≡ .univ k) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals grind [WfTp.univ]

name: ValEqTp.inv_el
statement:
theorem ValEqTp.inv_el {Γ l na A} : ValEqTp E Γ l (.el na) A →
    ∃ a, NeutEqTm E Γ (l + 1) na a (.univ l) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ .el a)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vA A}, ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → ∀ {na}, vA = .el na →
      ∃ a, NeutEqTm E Γ (l + 1) na a (.univ l) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ .el a) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals grind [WfTp.el, NeutEqTm.wf_tm]

name: ValEqTm.inv_lam
statement:
theorem ValEqTm.inv_lam {Γ C vA vb t l₀ l l'} : ValEqTm E Γ l₀ (.lam l l' vA vb) t C →
    l₀ = max l l' ∧ ∃ A B b,
      (ValEqTp E Γ l vA A) ∧
      (ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] t ≡ .lam l l' A b : C) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] C ≡ .pi l l' A B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ vt t C}, ValEqTm E Γ l₀ vt t C → ∀ {l l' vA vb}, vt = .lam l l' vA vb →
        l₀ = max l l' ∧ ∃ A B b, (ValEqTp E Γ l vA A) ∧
          (ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] t ≡ .lam l l' A b : C) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] C ≡ .pi l l' A B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_nf => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case lam => grind [WfTm.lam, ClosEqTm.wf_tm, WfTm.wf_tp, WfTp.pi]

name: ValEqTm.inv_pair
statement:
theorem ValEqTm.inv_pair {Γ C vt vu p l₀ l l'} : ValEqTm E Γ l₀ (.pair l l' vt vu) p C →
    l₀ = max l l' ∧ ∃ A B t u, (ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A) ∧ (ValEqTm E Γ l' vu u (B.subst t.toSb)) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p ≡ .pair l l' B t u : C) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] C ≡ .sigma l l' A B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ vp p C}, ValEqTm E Γ l₀ vp p C → ∀ {vt vu l l'}, vp = .pair l l' vt vu →
        l₀ = max l l' ∧ ∃ A B t u,
          (ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A) ∧
          (ValEqTm E Γ l' vu u (B.subst t.toSb)) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] p ≡ .pair l l' B t u : C) ∧
          (E ∣ Γ ⊢[max l l'] C ≡ .sigma l l' A B) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_nf => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case pair => grind [WfTm.pair, ValEqTm.wf_tm, WfTp.sigma]

name: ValEqTm.inv_refl
statement:
theorem ValEqTm.inv_refl {Γ C vt r l₀ l} : ValEqTm E Γ l₀ (.refl l vt) r C →
    l₀ = l ∧ ∃ A t, (ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] r ≡ .refl l t : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ .Id l A t t)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l₀ vr r C}, ValEqTm E Γ l₀ vr r C → ∀ {vt l}, vr = .refl l vt → l₀ = l ∧ ∃ A t,
      (ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] r ≡ .refl l t : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ .Id l A t t) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  case refl =>
    introv vt
    have := vt.wf_tm
    grind [WfTm.refl, WfTp.Id]
  all_goals grind [EqTm.conv_eq]

name: ValEqTm.inv_code
statement:
theorem ValEqTm.inv_code {Γ C vA c l₀} : ValEqTm E Γ l₀ (.code vA) c C →
    ∃ l A, l₀ = l + 1 ∧
      (ValEqTp E Γ l vA A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] c ≡ .code A : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ .univ l)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
      ∀ {Γ l₀ vc c C}, ValEqTm E Γ l₀ vc c C → ∀ {vA}, vc = .code vA →
        ∃ l A, l₀ = l + 1 ∧
          (ValEqTp E Γ l vA A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] c ≡ .code A : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ .univ l) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_nf => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case code => grind [WfTp.univ, WfTm.code, ValEqTp.wf_tp, WfTp.wf_ctx]

name: ValEqTm.inv_neut
statement:
theorem ValEqTm.inv_neut {Γ vA A vt t l} : ValEqTm E Γ l (.neut vt vA) t A →
    ValEqTp E Γ l vA A ∧ NeutEqTm E Γ l vt t A
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vt t A}, ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ∀ {n vA}, vt = .neut n vA →
      ValEqTp E Γ l vA A ∧ NeutEqTm E Γ l n t A from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  all_goals grind [NeutEqTm.conv_neut, ValEqTp.conv_tp]

name: NeutEqTm.inv_ax
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.inv_ax {Γ C c vA t l₀} : NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ (.ax c vA) t C → ∃ Al,
   l₀ = Al.val.2 ∧ E c = some Al ∧ ValEqTp E Γ Al.val.2 vA Al.val.1 ∧
    (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] t ≡ .ax c Al.val.1 : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ Al.val.1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l₀ vt t C}, NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ vt t C → ∀ {c vA}, vt = .ax c vA → ∃ Al,
      l₀ = Al.val.2 ∧ E c = some Al ∧ ValEqTp E Γ Al.val.2 vA Al.val.1 ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] t ≡ .ax c Al.val.1 : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l₀] C ≡ Al.val.1) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_neut ih =>
    have ⟨Al,  _⟩ := ih rfl
    refine ⟨Al, ?_⟩
    grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case ax Γ Ec vA _ =>
    exact ⟨_, rfl, Ec, vA, EqTm.refl_tm <| WfTm.ax Γ Ec vA.wf_tp, EqTp.refl_tp vA.wf_tp⟩

name: NeutEqTm.inv_bvar
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.inv_bvar {Γ A t i l} : NeutEqTm E Γ l (.bvar i) t A →
    ∃ A', Lookup Γ (Γ.length - i - 1) A' l ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ .bvar (Γ.length - i - 1) : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A')
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l vn n A}, NeutEqTm E Γ l vn n A → ∀ {i}, vn = .bvar i →
      ∃ A', Lookup Γ (Γ.length - i - 1) A' l ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] n ≡ .bvar (Γ.length - i - 1) : A) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ A') from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction NeutEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case bvar Γ _ i _ Γwf lk =>
    have := lk.lt_length
    rw [show Γ.length - (Γ.length - i - 1) - 1 = i by omega]
    exact ⟨_, lk, EqTm.refl_tm (WfTm.bvar (by omega) lk), EqTp.refl_tp (Γwf.lookup_wf lk)⟩
  case conv_neut => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]

name: NeutEqTm.inv_app
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.inv_app {Γ vA C vf va t l₀ l l'} : NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ (.app l l' vA vf va) t C →
    l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A B f a,
      ValEqTp E Γ l vA A ∧ NeutEqTm E Γ (max l l') vf f (.pi l l' A B) ∧ ValEqTm E Γ l va a A ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] t ≡ .app l l' B f a : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ B.subst a.toSb)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l₀ vn n C}, NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ vn n C → ∀ {vA vf va l l'}, vn = .app l l' vA vf va →
      l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A B f a,
        ValEqTp E Γ l vA A ∧ NeutEqTm E Γ (max l l') vf f (.pi l l' A B) ∧ ValEqTm E Γ l va a A ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] n ≡ .app l l' B f a : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ B.subst a.toSb) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction NeutEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_neut => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case app =>
    grind [WfTm.app, ValEqTm.wf_tm, NeutEqTm.wf_tm, WfSb.toSb, WfTp.subst, WfTp.inv_pi, WfTm.wf_tp]

name: NeutEqTm.inv_fst
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.inv_fst {Γ C vp f l₀ l l'} : NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ (.fst l l' vp) f C →
    l₀ = l ∧ ∃ A B p, NeutEqTm E Γ (max l l') vp p (.sigma l l' A B) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] f ≡ .fst l l' A B p : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ A)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l₀ vn n C}, NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ vn n C → ∀ {vp l l'}, vn = .fst l l' vp →
      l₀ = l ∧ ∃ A B p, NeutEqTm E Γ (max l l') vp p (.sigma l l' A B) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] n ≡ .fst l l' A B p : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] C ≡ A) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction NeutEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_neut => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case fst =>
    grind [WfTm.fst, NeutEqTm.wf_tm, WfTm.wf_tp, WfTp.inv_sigma, WfTp.wf_ctx, WfCtx.inv_snoc]

name: NeutEqTm.inv_snd
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.inv_snd {Γ C vp s l₀ l l'} : NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ (.snd l l' vp) s C →
    l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A B p, NeutEqTm E Γ (max l l') vp p (.sigma l l' A B) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] s ≡ .snd l l' A B p : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ B.subst (Expr.fst l l' A B p).toSb)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {Γ l₀ vn n C}, NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ vn n C → ∀ {vp l l'}, vn = .snd l l' vp →
      l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A B p, NeutEqTm E Γ (max l l') vp p (.sigma l l' A B) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] n ≡ .snd l l' A B p : C) ∧ (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ B.subst (Expr.fst l l' A B p).toSb) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction NeutEqTm
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals rename_i eq; cases eq
  case conv_neut => grind [EqTm.conv_eq]
  case snd =>
    grind [WfTm.snd, NeutEqTm.wf_tm, WfTm.wf_tp, WfTp.inv_sigma, WfTp.wf_ctx, WfCtx.inv_snoc]

name: NeutEqTm.inv_idRec
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.inv_idRec {Γ C vA cM va vr nh j l₀ l l'} :
    NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ (.idRec l l' vA va cM vr nh) j C → l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A M t r u h,
      (ValEqTp E Γ l vA A) ∧
      (ValEqTm E Γ l va t A) ∧
      (Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0)) l l' cM M) ∧
      (ValEqTm E Γ l' vr r (M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t))) ∧
      (NeutEqTm E Γ l nh h (.Id l A t u)) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] j ≡ .idRec l l' t M r u h : C) ∧
      (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ M.subst (.snoc u.toSb h))
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    ∀ {Γ l₀ vj j C}, NeutEqTm E Γ l₀ vj j C → ∀ {vA cM va vr nh l l'},
      vj = .idRec l l' vA va cM vr nh → l₀ = l' ∧ ∃ A M t r u h,
        (ValEqTp E Γ l vA A) ∧
        (ValEqTm E Γ l va t A) ∧
        (Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l (.Id l (A.subst Expr.wk) (t.subst Expr.wk) (.bvar 0)) l l' cM M) ∧
        (ValEqTm E Γ l' vr r (M.subst (.snoc t.toSb <| .refl l t))) ∧
        (NeutEqTm E Γ l nh h (.Id l A t u)) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] j ≡ .idRec l l' t M r u h : C) ∧
        (E ∣ Γ ⊢[l'] C ≡ M.subst (.snoc u.toSb h)) from
    fun h => this h rfl
  mutual_induction ValEqTm
  case idRec => grind [NeutEqTm.wf_tm, WfTm.wf_tp, → NeutEqTm.idRec]
  all_goals grind [EqTm.conv_eq]

name: wf_dom
statement: theorem wf_dom : ∀ {Δ Eᵥ σ Γ}, EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ → WfCtx E Δ

name: wf_cod
statement: theorem wf_cod : ∀ {Δ Eᵥ σ Γ}, EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ → WfCtx E Γ
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction EnvEqSb
  all_goals grind [WfCtx.nil, WfCtx.snoc]

name: eq_length
statement: theorem eq_length : ∀ {Δ Eᵥ σ Γ}, EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ → Eᵥ.length = Γ.length
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction EnvEqSb
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  all_goals simp; try grind

name: lookup_lt
statement: theorem lookup_lt {Δ Γ Eᵥ σ i A l} : EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ → Lookup Γ i A l → i < Eᵥ.length

name: lookup_eq
statement:
theorem lookup_eq : ∀ {Δ Eᵥ σ Γ}, (env : EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ) →
    ∀ {A i l}, (lk : Lookup Γ i A l) →
    ValEqTm E Δ l (Eᵥ[i]'(env.lookup_lt lk)) (σ i) (A.subst σ)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction EnvEqSb
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  case nil lk => cases lk
  case snoc E A v ih _ _ _ _ lk =>
    rcases lk with _ | ⟨_, lk⟩
    . exact autosubst% v
    . exact autosubst% ih lk

name: Expr.eq_snoc_get_zero
statement:
private lemma Expr.eq_snoc_get_zero (σ : Nat → Expr χ) :
    σ = Expr.snoc (Expr.comp σ Expr.wk) (σ 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; cases i <;> rfl

name: mk
statement:
theorem mk : ∀ {Γ}, WfCtx E Γ → ∀ {Δ} {Eᵥ : List (Val χ)} {σ},
    WfCtx E Δ → (eq : Γ.length = Eᵥ.length) →
    (∀ {i A l}, (lk : Lookup Γ i A l) →
      ValEqTm E Δ l (Eᵥ[i]'(eq ▸ lk.lt_length)) (σ i) (A.subst σ)) →
    EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfCtx
  all_goals intros; try exact True.intro
  case nil eq _ =>
    have := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp eq.symm
    grind [EnvEqSb.nil]
  case snoc ih _ _ E σ Δ eq h =>
    cases E
    . cases eq
    . replace eq := Nat.succ_inj.mp eq
      rw [Expr.eq_snoc_get_zero σ]
      apply EnvEqSb.snoc
      . refine ih Δ eq fun lk => ?_
        exact autosubst% h (lk.succ ..)
      . assumption
      . exact autosubst% h (Lookup.zero ..)

name: wf_expr
statement:
private theorem wf_expr :
    (∀ {Γ l vA A}, ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, NeutEqTm E Γ l vt t A → E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A vB B}, ClosEqTp E Γ l l' A vB B → E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] B) ∧
    (∀ {Γ A l B l' l'' cC C}, Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l B l' l'' cC C → E ∣ (B, l') :: (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l''] C) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A B vb b}, ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b → E ∣ (A, l) :: Γ ⊢[l'] b : B) ∧
    (∀ {Γ Eᵥ σ Γ'}, EnvEqSb E Γ Eᵥ σ Γ' → WfSb E Γ σ Γ')
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals dsimp; intros
  case ax => apply WfTm.ax <;> assumption
  case conv_tp => grind [EqTp.wf_right]
  case conv_nf tt' AA' _ => exact tt'.wf_right.conv AA'
  case conv_neut nn' AA' _ => exact nn'.wf_right.conv AA'
  case clos₂_tp Aenv Benv C σ =>
    have B := C.wf_binder
    have A := B.wf_binder
    apply WfTp.conv_ctx _ <| C.subst (σ.up A |>.up B)
    apply EqCtx.refl Aenv.wf_ctx
      |>.snoc Aenv
      |>.snoc (Benv.conv_binder Aenv.symm_tp)
  case clos₂_val_tp Aenv Benv _ σ C =>
    have B := C.wf_binder
    have A := B.wf_binder
    apply WfTp.conv_ctx _ <| C.subst (σ.up A |>.up B)
    apply EqCtx.refl Aenv.wf_ctx
      |>.snoc Aenv
      |>.snoc (Benv.conv_binder Aenv.symm_tp)
  case clos_tp Aenv B σ =>
    have := B.subst (σ.up B.wf_binder)
    exact this.conv_binder Aenv
  case clos_val_tp Aenv _ σ B =>
    have := B.subst (σ.up B.wf_binder)
    exact this.conv_binder Aenv
  case clos_tm Aenv Benv b σ =>
    have := b.subst (σ.up b.wf_binder)
    have := this.conv_ctx (EqCtx.refl Aenv.wf_ctx |>.snoc Aenv)
    exact this.conv Benv
  case clos_val_tm Aenv Benv _ σ b =>
    have := b.subst (σ.up b.wf_binder)
    have := this.conv_ctx (EqCtx.refl Aenv.wf_ctx |>.snoc Aenv)
    exact this.conv Benv
  case nil => apply WfSb.terminal; assumption
  grind_cases

name: conv_ctx_all
statement:
private theorem conv_ctx_all :
    (∀ {Γ l vA A}, ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → ∀ {Γ'},
      EqCtx E Γ Γ' → ValEqTp E Γ' l vA A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ∀ {Γ'},
      EqCtx E Γ Γ' → ValEqTm E Γ' l vt t A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, NeutEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ∀ {Γ'},
      EqCtx E Γ Γ' → NeutEqTm E Γ' l vt t A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A vB B}, ClosEqTp E Γ l l' A vB B → ∀ {Γ'},
      EqCtx E Γ Γ' → ClosEqTp E Γ' l l' A vB B) ∧
    (∀ {Γ A l B l' l'' vC C}, Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l B l' l'' vC C →
      ∀ {Γ'}, EqCtx E Γ Γ' → Clos₂EqTp E Γ' A l B l' l'' vC C) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A B vb b}, ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b → ∀ {Γ'}, EqCtx E Γ Γ' →
      ClosEqTm E Γ' l l' A B vb b) ∧
    (∀ {Γ Eᵥ σ Δ}, EnvEqSb E Γ Eᵥ σ Δ → ∀ {Γ'}, EqCtx E Γ Γ' → EnvEqSb E Γ' Eᵥ σ Δ)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals intros
  case ax => apply NeutEqTm.ax <;> grind [EqCtx.wf_right]
  case univ => grind [ValEqTp.univ, EqCtx.wf_right]
  case pair B _ _ _ _ _ eq =>
    apply ValEqTm.pair (B.conv_ctx (eq.snoc <| EqTp.refl_tp B.wf_binder)) <;> grind
  case bvar lk _ eq =>
    have ⟨A', _, lk'⟩ := Lookup.of_lt_length <| eq.length_eq ▸ lk.lt_length
    obtain ⟨rfl, eqA⟩ := eq.lookup_eq lk lk'
    have := NeutEqTm.bvar eq.wf_right lk'
    rw [eq.length_eq]
    exact NeutEqTm.conv_neut this (EqTm.refl_tm this.wf_tm) (eqA.symm_tp.conv_ctx eq)
  case clos₂_tp Aeq Beq C ihE _ eq =>
    apply Clos₂EqTp.clos₂_tp (ihE eq) (Aeq.conv_ctx eq) (Beq.conv_ctx _) C
    grind [Clos₂EqTp.clos₂_tp, EqTp.conv_ctx, EqCtx.snoc]
  case clos₂_val_tp Aeq Beq C ihE _ _ eq =>
    apply Clos₂EqTp.clos₂_val_tp (ihE eq) (Aeq.conv_ctx eq) (Beq.conv_ctx _) C
    grind [Clos₂EqTp.clos₂_tp, EqTp.conv_ctx, EqCtx.snoc]
  case clos_tm Aeq Beq b env _ eq =>
    exact ClosEqTm.clos_tm (env eq) (Aeq.conv_ctx eq)
      (Beq.conv_ctx <| eq.snoc <| EqTp.refl_tp Aeq.wf_right)
      (b.conv_ctx b.wf_ctx.eq_self)
  case clos_val_tm Aeq Beq vb env _ _ eq =>
    exact ClosEqTm.clos_val_tm (env eq) (Aeq.conv_ctx eq)
      (Beq.conv_ctx <| eq.snoc <| EqTp.refl_tp Aeq.wf_right) vb
  case nil eq => exact .nil _ eq.wf_right
  grind_cases

name: ValEqTp.conv_ctx
statement: theorem ValEqTp.conv_ctx {Γ Γ' l vA A} : ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → EqCtx E Γ Γ' → ValEqTp E Γ' l vA A
proof:
:=
  fun h eq => conv_ctx_all.1 h eq

statement:
theorem ValEqTm.conv_ctx {Γ Γ' l vt t A} : ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → EqCtx E Γ Γ' →

:=

name: wk_all
statement:
private theorem wk_all :
    (∀ {Γ l vA A}, ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → ∀ {C k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C →
      ValEqTp E ((C,k) :: Γ) l vA (A.subst Expr.wk)) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ∀ {C k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C →
      ValEqTm E ((C,k) :: Γ) l vt (t.subst Expr.wk) (A.subst Expr.wk)) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, NeutEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ∀ {C k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C →
      NeutEqTm E ((C,k) :: Γ) l vt (t.subst Expr.wk) (A.subst Expr.wk)) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A vB B}, ClosEqTp E Γ l l' A vB B → ∀ {C k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C →
      ClosEqTp E ((C,k) :: Γ) l l' (A.subst Expr.wk) vB (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk))) ∧
    (∀ {Γ A l B l' l'' vC C}, Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l B l' l'' vC C → ∀ {D k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] D →
      Clos₂EqTp E ((D,k) :: Γ) (A.subst Expr.wk) l (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk)) l' l''
        vC (C.subst (Expr.up <| Expr.up Expr.wk))) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A B vb b}, ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b → ∀ {C k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C →
      ClosEqTm E ((C,k) :: Γ) l l' (A.subst Expr.wk) (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk))
        vb (b.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk))) ∧
    (∀ {Γ Eᵥ σ Δ}, EnvEqSb E Γ Eᵥ σ Δ → ∀ {C k}, E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C →
      EnvEqSb E ((C,k) :: Γ) Eᵥ (Expr.comp Expr.wk σ) Δ)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  all_goals intros; try dsimp [Expr.subst] at *
  case ax Al _ _ _ ihA _ _ C =>
    have := ihA C
    rw [Expr.subst_of_isClosed _ Al.2.1] at this ⊢
    apply NeutEqTm.ax <;> grind [WfCtx.snoc]
  case univ => grind [ValEqTp.univ, WfCtx.snoc]
  case conv_tp => grind [ValEqTp.conv_tp, EqTp.subst, WfSb.wk]
  case pair B _ _ iht ihu _ _ C =>
    have := B.subst (WfSb.wk C |>.up B.wf_binder)
    apply ValEqTm.pair this (iht C) (autosubst% ihu C)
  case conv_nf => grind [ValEqTm.conv_nf, EqTp.subst, EqTm.subst, WfSb.wk]
  case bvar Γ lk _ _ C =>
    convert NeutEqTm.bvar (Γ.snoc C) (.succ _ lk) using 1; grind
  case app ihA ihf iha _ _ C =>
    exact autosubst% NeutEqTm.app (ihA C) (ihf C) (iha C)
  case snd ih _ _ C =>
    exact autosubst% NeutEqTm.snd (ih C)
  case idRec b _ ihA iha ihM ihr ihh _ _ C =>
    exact autosubst% NeutEqTm.idRec
      (ihA C)
      (iha C)
      (autosubst% ihM C)
      (autosubst% ihr C)
      (ihh C)
  case conv_neut => grind [NeutEqTm.conv_neut, EqTp.subst, EqTm.subst, WfSb.wk]
  case clos_tp Aeq B ihE _ _ C =>
    have := Aeq.subst (WfSb.wk C)
    exact autosubst% ClosEqTp.clos_tp (ihE C) (autosubst% this) B
  case clos_val_tp Aeq B ihE _ _ _ C =>
    have := Aeq.subst (WfSb.wk C)
    exact autosubst% ClosEqTp.clos_val_tp (ihE C) (autosubst% this) B
  case clos₂_tp Aeq Beq C ihE _ _ D =>
    have Aeq' := Aeq.subst (WfSb.wk D)
    have Beq' := Beq.subst (WfSb.up (WfSb.wk D) Aeq.wf_right)
    exact autosubst% Clos₂EqTp.clos₂_tp (ihE D) (autosubst% Aeq') (autosubst% Beq') C
  case clos₂_val_tp Aeq Beq C ihE _ _ _ D =>
    have Aeq' := Aeq.subst (WfSb.wk D)
    have Beq' := Beq.subst (WfSb.up (WfSb.wk D) Aeq.wf_right)
    exact autosubst% Clos₂EqTp.clos₂_val_tp (ihE D) (autosubst% Aeq') (autosubst% Beq') C
  case clos_tm Aeq Beq b ihE _ _ C =>
    have CAeq := Aeq.subst <| WfSb.wk C
    have CBeq := Beq.subst <| (WfSb.wk C).up Aeq.wf_right
    exact autosubst% ClosEqTm.clos_tm (ihE C) (autosubst% CAeq) (autosubst% CBeq) b
  case clos_val_tm Aeq Beq vb ihE _ _ _ C =>
    have CAeq := Aeq.subst <| WfSb.wk C
    have CBeq := Beq.subst <| (WfSb.wk C).up Aeq.wf_right
    exact autosubst% ClosEqTm.clos_val_tm (ihE C) (autosubst% CAeq) (autosubst% CBeq) vb
  case nil C => apply EnvEqSb.nil _ (C.wf_ctx.snoc C)
  case snoc =>
    simp only [autosubst] at *
    grind [EnvEqSb.snoc]
  grind_cases

statement:

    ValEqTm E ((C,k) :: Γ) l vt (t.subst Expr.wk) (A.subst Expr.wk)

statement:

    NeutEqTm E ((C,k) :: Γ) l vn (n.subst Expr.wk) (A.subst Expr.wk)

    ClosEqTp E ((C,k) :: Γ) l l' (A.subst Expr.wk) vB (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk))

name: Clos
statement:
theorem Clos₂EqTp.wk {Γ A l B l' l'' vC C} (h : Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l B l' l'' vC C)
    {D k} (hD : E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] D) :
    Clos₂EqTp E ((D,k) :: Γ) (A.subst Expr.wk) l (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk)) l' l''
      vC (C.subst (Expr.up (Expr.up Expr.wk)))

name: ClosEqTm.wk
statement:
theorem ClosEqTm.wk {Γ l l' A B vb b} (h : ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b) {C k} (hC : E ∣ Γ ⊢[k] C) :
    ClosEqTm E ((C,k) :: Γ) l l' (A.subst Expr.wk) (B.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk))
      vb (b.subst (Expr.up Expr.wk))

statement:
theorem EnvEqSb.wk {Δ Eᵥ σ Γ} (h : EnvEqSb E Δ Eᵥ σ Γ) {C k} (hC : E ∣ Δ ⊢[k] C) :
    EnvEqSb E ((C,k) :: Δ) Eᵥ (Expr.comp Expr.wk σ) Γ

name: wf_ctx
statement: theorem wf_ctx {vΓ Γ} : TpEnvEqCtx E vΓ Γ → WfCtx E Γ
proof:
:= by
  intro vΓ; induction vΓ <;> grind [WfCtx.nil, WfCtx.snoc, ValEqTp.wf_tp]

name: length_eq
statement: theorem length_eq {vΓ Γ} : TpEnvEqCtx E vΓ Γ → vΓ.length = Γ.length
proof:
:= by
  intro vΓ; induction vΓ <;> simp [*]

name: lt_length
statement: theorem lt_length {vΓ Γ i A l} : TpEnvEqCtx E vΓ Γ → Lookup Γ i A l → i < vΓ.length

name: lvl_eq
statement:
theorem lvl_eq {vΓ Γ i A l} : (h : TpEnvEqCtx E vΓ Γ) → (lk : Lookup Γ i A l) →
    (vΓ[i]'(h.lt_length lk)).2 = l
proof:
:= by
  intro h lk
  induction h generalizing i A <;> cases lk <;> grind

name: lookup_wf
statement:
theorem lookup_wf {vΓ Γ i A l} : (h : TpEnvEqCtx E vΓ Γ) → (lk : Lookup Γ i A l) →
    ValEqTp E Γ l (vΓ[i]'(h.lt_length lk)).1 A
proof:
:= by
  intro h lk
  induction h generalizing i A <;> cases lk
  case zero vA => exact vA.wk vA.wf_tp
  case snoc vA ih _ _ lk => exact (ih lk).wk vA.wf_tp

name: length_toEnv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_toEnv (vΓ : TpEnv χ) : vΓ.toEnv.length = vΓ.length

name: toEnv_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toEnv_cons (vA : Val χ) (l : Nat) (vΓ : TpEnv χ) :
    toEnv ((vA, l) :: vΓ) = .neut (.bvar vΓ.length) vA :: vΓ.toEnv

name: TpEnvEqCtx.toEnv_wf
statement: theorem TpEnvEqCtx.toEnv_wf {vΓ Γ} : TpEnvEqCtx E vΓ Γ → EnvEqSb E Γ vΓ.toEnv Expr.bvar Γ
proof:
:= by
  intro vΓ
  have Γ := vΓ.wf_ctx
  refine EnvEqSb.mk Γ Γ ?_ fun lk => ?_
  . rw [TpEnv.length_toEnv, vΓ.length_eq]
  . simp only [TpEnv.toEnv, List.getElem_mapIdx]
    apply ValEqTm.neut_tm
    . exact autosubst% vΓ.lookup_wf lk
    . rw [vΓ.length_eq]
      apply NeutEqTm.bvar Γ
      exact autosubst% lk

name: of_axioms_le_all
statement:
private theorem of_axioms_le_all {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') :
    (∀ {Γ l vA A}, ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → ValEqTp E' Γ l vA A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ValEqTm E' Γ l vt t A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l vt t A}, NeutEqTm E Γ l vt t A → NeutEqTm E' Γ l vt t A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A vB B}, ClosEqTp E Γ l l' A vB B → ClosEqTp E' Γ l l' A vB B) ∧
    (∀ {Γ A l B l' l'' vC C}, Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l B l' l'' vC C → Clos₂EqTp E' Γ A l B l' l'' vC C) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l l' A B vb b}, ClosEqTm E Γ l l' A B vb b → ClosEqTm E' Γ l l' A B vb b) ∧
    (∀ {Γ Eᵥ σ Δ}, EnvEqSb E Γ Eᵥ σ Δ → EnvEqSb E' Γ Eᵥ σ Δ)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction ValEqTp
  case ax => introv _ Ec _ ihA; apply NeutEqTm.ax _ (le Ec) ihA; grind
  grind_cases

name: ValEqTp.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem ValEqTp.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Γ l vA A} :
    ValEqTp E Γ l vA A → ValEqTp E' Γ l vA A

name: ValEqTm.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem ValEqTm.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Γ l vt t A} :
    ValEqTm E Γ l vt t A → ValEqTm E' Γ l vt t A

name: NeutEqTm.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem NeutEqTm.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Γ l vn n A} :
    NeutEqTm E Γ l vn n A → NeutEqTm E' Γ l vn n A

theorem ClosEqTp.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Γ l l' A vB B} :

name: Clos
statement:
theorem Clos₂EqTp.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Γ A l B l' l'' vC C} :
    Clos₂EqTp E Γ A l B l' l'' vC C → Clos₂EqTp E' Γ A l B l' l'' vC C

name: ClosEqTm.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem ClosEqTm.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Γ l l' A B vb b} :

name: EnvEqSb.of_axioms_le
statement:
theorem EnvEqSb.of_axioms_le {E E' : Axioms χ} (le : E ≤ E') {Δ Eᵥ σ Γ} :
