statement:
theorem WfTmIH.refl {Γ l A t} : I.WfTmIH Γ l A t → I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, eq⟩ => ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ht, eq⟩

name: EqTmIH.symm
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.symm {Γ l A t u} : I.EqTmIH Γ l A t u → I.EqTmIH Γ l A u t
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, hu, tp⟩ => ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, hu, ht, tp⟩

name: WfCtxIH.nil
statement: theorem WfCtxIH.nil : I.WfCtxIH []

name: WfCtxIH.snoc
statement:
theorem WfCtxIH.snoc {Γ A l} : I.WfTpIH Γ l A → I.WfCtxIH ((A, l) :: Γ)
  | ⟨_, hΓ, llen, _, hA⟩ => ⟨_, I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.2 ⟨_, hΓ, llen, _, hA, rfl⟩⟩

include slen in

name: WfTpIH.univ
statement:
theorem WfTpIH.univ {Γ l} (_ : l < univMax) : I.WfCtxIH Γ → I.WfTpIH Γ (l + 1) (Expr.univ l)
  | ⟨_, hΓ⟩ => ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _, I.mem_ofType_univ.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: EqTpIH.pi
statement:
theorem EqTpIH.pi {Γ A A' B B' l l'} :
    I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTpIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B B' →
    I.EqTpIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.pi l l' A B) (Expr.pi l l' A' B')
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, hA'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, hB'⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA₁ hA
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _,
      I.mem_ofType_pi.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _, hB, rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofType_pi.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA', _, hB', rfl⟩⟩

name: EqTpIH.sigma
statement:
theorem EqTpIH.sigma {Γ A A' B B' l l'} :
    I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTpIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B B' →
    I.EqTpIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.sigma l l' A B) (Expr.sigma l l' A' B')
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, hA'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, hB'⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA₁ hA
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _,
      I.mem_ofType_sigma.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _, hB, rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofType_sigma.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA', _, hB', rfl⟩⟩

name: EqTpIH.Id
statement:
theorem EqTpIH.Id {Γ A A' t t' u u' l} :
    I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t' → I.EqTmIH Γ l A u u' →
    I.EqTpIH Γ l (Expr.Id l A t u) (Expr.Id l A' t' u')
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, hA'⟩,
    ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩,
    ⟨_, hΓ₂, _, _, hA₂, _, hu, hu', utp⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₂
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₂
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, ‹_›, _,
      I.mem_ofType_Id.2 ⟨_, hA, _, ht, _, hu, ttp, utp, rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofType_Id.2 ⟨_, hA', _, ht', _, hu', ttp, utp, rfl⟩⟩

name: EqTpIH.el
statement:
theorem EqTpIH.el {Γ A A' l} : I.EqTmIH Γ (l + 1) (Expr.univ l) A A' → I.EqTpIH Γ l A.el A'.el
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, eq⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofType_univ.1 hA
    simp at eq; subst eq
    exact ⟨_, ‹_›, _, _,
      I.mem_ofType_el.2 ⟨_, _, ht, ttp, rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofType_el.2 ⟨_, _, ht', ttp, rfl⟩⟩

name: EqTpIH.el_code
statement:
theorem EqTpIH.el_code {Γ A l} (_ : l < univMax) : I.WfTpIH Γ l A → I.EqTpIH Γ l A.code.el A
  | ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hA⟩ =>
    ⟨_, ‹_›, ‹_›, _,
      I.mem_ofType_el.2 ⟨by omega, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_code.2 ⟨_, rfl, _, hA, by simp; rfl⟩, s.code_tp .., rfl⟩,
      by rwa [s.el_code]⟩

name: EqTpIH.trans
statement:
theorem EqTpIH.trans {Γ A A' A'' l} : I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTpIH Γ l A' A'' → I.EqTpIH Γ l A A''
  | ⟨_, hΓ, hl, _, hA, hA'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA'₁, hA''⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA' hA'₁
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, hl, _, hA, hA''⟩

name: WfTmIH.bvar
statement:
theorem WfTmIH.bvar {Γ A i l} (H : Lookup Γ i A l) : I.WfCtxIH Γ → I.WfTmIH Γ l A (Expr.bvar i)
  | ⟨_, hΓ⟩ =>
    have ⟨llen, _, h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= I.var_sound H hΓ
    ⟨_, ‹_›, llen, _, h2, _, h1, rfl⟩

name: EqTmIH.lam
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.lam {Γ A A' B t t' l l'} :
    I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTmIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B t t' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.pi l l' A B) (Expr.lam l l' A t) (Expr.lam l l' A' t')
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, hA'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, I.mem_ofType_pi.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _, hB, by simp⟩, _,
      I.mem_ofTerm_lam.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _, ht, by simp⟩,
      I.mem_ofTerm_lam.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA', _, ht', by simp⟩, mkLam_tp (t_tp := ttp) ..⟩

name: EqTmIH.app
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.app {Γ A B B' f f' a a' l l'} :
    I.EqTpIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B B' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.pi l l' A B) f f' → I.EqTmIH Γ l A a a' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (Expr.subst a.toSb B) (Expr.app l l' B f a) (Expr.app l l' B' f' a')
  | ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, hB'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hF, _, hf, hf', ftp⟩,
    ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA, _, ha, ha', atp⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    refine ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, I.mem_ofType_toSb _ ha _ hB, _,
      I.mem_ofTerm_app.2 ⟨_, _, hf, _, ha, _, atp, _, hB, ?a, rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofTerm_app.2 ⟨_, _, hf', _, ha', _, atp, _, hB', ?a, rfl⟩,
      mkApp_tp ..⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, hA₁, _, hB₁, eq⟩ := I.mem_ofType_pi.1 hF; simp at eq
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hB hB₁
    rwa [ftp]

name: EqTmIH.pair
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.pair {Γ A B B' t t' u u' l l'} :
    I.EqTpIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B B' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t' → I.EqTmIH Γ l' (Expr.subst t.toSb B) u u' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.sigma l l' A B) (Expr.pair l l' B t u) (Expr.pair l l' B' t' u')
  | ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, hB'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩,
    ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hBt, _, hu, hu', utp⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    refine ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _,
      I.mem_ofType_sigma.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _, hB, by simp; rfl⟩, _,
      I.mem_ofTerm_pair.2 ⟨rfl, _, ht, _, ttp, _, hB, _, hu, ?a, by simp; rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofTerm_pair.2 ⟨rfl, _, ht', _, ttp, _, hB', _, hu', ?a, by simp⟩,
      mkPair_tp ..⟩
    exact utp ▸ Part.mem_unique hBt (I.mem_ofType_toSb _ ht _ hB)

name: EqTmIH.fst_snd
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.fst_snd {Γ A A' B B' p p' l l'} :
    I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTpIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B B' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.sigma l l' A B) p p' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A (Expr.fst l l' A B p) (Expr.fst l l' A' B' p') ∧
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (Expr.subst (Expr.fst l l' A B p).toSb B)
      (Expr.snd l l' A B p) (Expr.snd l l' A' B' p')
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, hA'⟩, ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, hB'⟩,
    ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hP, _, hp, hp', ptp⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    refine ⟨
      ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_fst.2 ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, ?a, rfl⟩,
        I.mem_ofTerm_fst.2 ⟨_, _, hA', _, hB', _, hp', ?a, rfl⟩,
        mkFst_tp ..⟩,
      ⟨_, hΓ, _, _,
        I.mem_ofType_toSb _ (I.mem_ofTerm_fst.2 ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, ?a, rfl⟩) _ hB, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_snd.2 ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, ?a, rfl⟩,
        I.mem_ofTerm_snd.2 ⟨_, _, hA', _, hB', _, hp', ?a, rfl⟩,
        mkSnd_tp ..⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, hA₁, _, hB₁, eq⟩ := I.mem_ofType_sigma.1 hP; simp at eq
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hB hB₁
    rwa [ptp]

name: EqTmIH.refl_tm
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.refl_tm {Γ A t t' l} :
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t' → I.EqTmIH Γ l (Expr.Id l A t t) (Expr.refl l t) (Expr.refl l t')
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩ => by
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, _, _,
      I.mem_ofType_Id.2 ⟨_, hA, _, ht, _, ht, ttp, ttp, rfl⟩, _,
      I.mem_ofTerm_refl.2 ⟨_, ht, rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofTerm_refl.2 ⟨_, ht', rfl⟩,
      mkRefl_tp ..⟩

name: EqTmIH.idRec
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.idRec {Γ A M M' t t' r r' u u' h h' l l'} :
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t' →
    I.EqTpIH ((.Id l (.subst .wk A) (.subst .wk t) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ) l' M M' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (.subst (.snoc t.toSb (.refl l t)) M) r r' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A u u' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l (.Id l A t u) h h' →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (.subst (.snoc u.toSb h) M)
      (.idRec l l' t M r u h) (.idRec l l' t' M' r' u' h')
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩ ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hM, hM'⟩
    ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hR, _, hr, hr', rtp⟩ ⟨_, hΓ₂, _, _, hA₁, _, hu, hu', utp⟩
    ⟨_, hΓ₃, _, _, hH, _, hh, hh', htp⟩
  cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
  cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₂
  cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₃
  cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
  obtain ⟨_, hΓ'', _, B, hB, rfl⟩ := I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
  obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩ := I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ''
  cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
  cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
  obtain ⟨_, sA, _, st, _, hv, stp, vtp, Beq⟩ := I.mem_ofType_Id.1 hB
  have sAeq := Part.mem_unique sA (I.mem_ofType_wk _ hA)
  cases Part.mem_unique (I.mem_ofTerm_wk _ ht) st
  obtain ⟨_, hv⟩ := CObj.mem_var_zero.1 (I.ofTerm_bvar ▸ hv :); simp at hv; subst hv
  obtain ⟨_, hA₁, _, ht₁, _, hu₁, _, _, rfl⟩ := I.mem_ofType_Id.1 hH
  cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
  cases Part.mem_unique ht ht₁
  cases Part.mem_unique hu hu₁
  refine ⟨_, hΓ, _, _,
    (I.mem_ofType_ofTerm_subst _ (.snoc (.sub1 _ _ _ utp hu) _ _ _ ?_ hh) ?_).1 hM, _,
    I.mem_ofTerm_idRec.2 ⟨_, _, ht, _, ttp, B, ?b, _, hM, _, hr, ?a, _, hu, utp, _, hh, htp, rfl⟩,
    I.mem_ofTerm_idRec.2 ⟨_, _, ht', _, ttp, B, ?b, _, hM', _, hr', ?a, _, hu', utp, _, hh', htp, rfl⟩,
    mkIdRec_tp ..⟩
  · rw [htp, Beq, comp_mkId]
    · congr 1 <;> simp
    · simp [sAeq]
  · simp
  · simp [Beq, sAeq]
  · refine rtp ▸ Part.mem_unique hR ?_
    refine (I.mem_ofType_ofTerm_subst _
      (.snoc (.sub1 _ _ _ ttp ht) _ _ (.refl l t) _ ?_) ?_).1 hM
    · exact I.mem_ofTerm_refl.2 ⟨_, ht, rfl⟩
    · simp

name: EqTmIH.code
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.code {Γ A A' l} (_ : l < univMax) :
    I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTmIH Γ (l + 1) (Expr.univ l) A.code A'.code
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, hA'⟩ =>
    ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _,
      I.mem_ofType_univ.2 ⟨rfl, by simp⟩, _,
      I.mem_ofTerm_code.2 ⟨_, rfl, _, hA, by simp; rfl⟩,
      I.mem_ofTerm_code.2 ⟨_, rfl, _, hA', by simp⟩,
      s.code_tp ..⟩

name: EqTmIH.app_lam
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.app_lam {Γ A B t u l l'} :
    I.WfTmIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B t → I.WfTmIH Γ l A u →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (Expr.subst u.toSb B) (Expr.app l l' B (Expr.lam l l' A t) u)
      (Expr.subst u.toSb t)
  | ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB, _, ht, ttp⟩, ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, hu, utp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, I.mem_ofType_toSb _ hu utp hB, _,
      I.mem_ofTerm_app.2 ⟨_, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_lam.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _, ht, by simp⟩, _, hu, _, utp, _, hB,
        s.mkLam_tp (t_tp := ttp) ..,
        (s.mkApp_mkLam (t_tp := ttp) ..).symm⟩,
      I.mem_ofTerm_toSb _ hu _ ht, by simp [ttp]⟩

name: EqTmIH.fst_snd_pair
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.fst_snd_pair {Γ A B t u l l'} :
    I.WfTpIH ((A, l) :: Γ) l' B → I.WfTmIH Γ l A t → I.WfTmIH Γ l' (Expr.subst t.toSb B) u →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A (Expr.fst l l' A B (Expr.pair l l' B t u)) t ∧
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (Expr.subst t.toSb B) (Expr.snd l l' A B (Expr.pair l l' B t u)) u
  | ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hB⟩, ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ttp⟩, ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hU, _, hu, utp⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hU (I.mem_ofType_toSb _ ht ttp hB)
    refine
      have hp := I.mem_ofTerm_pair.2 ⟨rfl, _, ht, _, ttp, _, hB, _, hu, utp, by simp⟩
      have tp := mkPair_tp (u_tp := utp) ..
      ⟨⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_fst.2 ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, tp, (mkFst_mkPair ..).symm⟩, ht, ttp⟩,
       ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, I.mem_ofType_toSb _ ht ttp hB, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_snd.2 ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, tp, (mkSnd_mkPair ..).symm⟩, hu, utp⟩⟩

name: EqTmIH.idRec_refl
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.idRec_refl {Γ A M t r l l'} :
    I.WfTmIH Γ l A t →
    I.WfTpIH ((.Id l (.subst .wk A) (.subst .wk t) (.bvar 0), l) :: (A, l) :: Γ) l' M →
    I.WfTmIH Γ l' (.subst (.snoc t.toSb (.refl l t)) M) r →
    I.EqTmIH Γ l' (.subst (.snoc t.toSb (.refl l t)) M)
      (.idRec l l' t M r t (.refl l t)) r
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ht, ttp⟩ ⟨_, hΓ', _, _, hM⟩ ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hR, _, hr, rtp⟩
  cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
  obtain ⟨_, hΓ'', _, B, hB, rfl⟩ := I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ'
  obtain ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, rfl⟩ := I.mem_ofCtx_snoc.1 hΓ''
  cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
  cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
  obtain ⟨_, sA, _, st, _, hv, stp, vtp, Beq⟩ := I.mem_ofType_Id.1 hB
  have sAeq := Part.mem_unique sA (I.mem_ofType_wk _ hA)
  cases Part.mem_unique (I.mem_ofTerm_wk _ ht) st
  obtain ⟨_, hv⟩ := CObj.mem_var_zero.1 (I.ofTerm_bvar ▸ hv :); simp at hv; subst hv
  refine
    have h1 := I.mem_ofTerm_refl.2 ⟨_, ht, rfl⟩
    have h2 := mkRefl_tp ..
    have sM := (I.mem_ofType_ofTerm_subst _
      (.snoc (.sub1 _ _ _ ttp ht) _ _ (.refl l t) (h2 ▸ ?_) h1) (by simp)).1 hM
    have sr := rtp ▸ Part.mem_unique hR sM
    have ir := I.mem_ofTerm_idRec.2 ⟨_, _, ht, _, ttp, B, by simp [Beq, sAeq],
      _, hM, _, hr, sr, _, ht, ttp, _, h1, h2, (mkIdRec_mkRefl ..).symm⟩
    ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, sM, _, ir, hr, sr⟩
  simp [Beq, comp_mkId, sAeq]

name: EqTmIH.lam_app
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.lam_app {Γ A B f l l'} :
    I.WfTmIH Γ (max l l') (.pi l l' A B) f →
    I.EqTmIH Γ (max l l') (.pi l l' A B) f
      (.lam l l' A (.app l l' (.subst (.up .wk) B) (.subst .wk f) (.bvar 0)))
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hF, _, hf, ftp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, eq⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofType_pi.1 hF; simp at eq; subst eq
    refine
      have sB := (I.mem_ofType_ofTerm_subst _ (.up (.wk _ _) _ _ _ rfl) (CSb.up_toSb _)).1 hB
      have hv := I.ofTerm_bvar ▸ CObj.mem_var_zero.2 ⟨rfl, by simp⟩
      have hl := I.mem_ofTerm_lam.2 ⟨rfl, _, hA, _,
        I.mem_ofTerm_app.2 ⟨_, _, I.mem_ofTerm_wk _ hf, _, hv, _, by simp, _, sB, ?_, rfl⟩,
        (s.etaExpand_eq (f_tp := ftp) ..).symm⟩
      ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hF, _, hf, hl, ftp⟩
    simp [ftp, comp_mkPi]

name: EqTmIH.pair_fst_snd
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.pair_fst_snd {Γ A B p l l'} :
    I.WfTmIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.sigma l l' A B) p →
    I.EqTmIH Γ (max l l') (Expr.sigma l l' A B) p
      (Expr.pair l l' B (Expr.fst l l' A B p) (Expr.snd l l' A B p))
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hP, _, hp, ptp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, _, hA, _, hB, eq⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofType_sigma.1 hP; simp at eq; subst eq
    exact
      have h1 := I.mem_ofTerm_fst.2 ⟨by omega, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, ptp, rfl⟩
      have h2 := I.mem_ofTerm_snd.2 ⟨by omega, _, hA, _, hB, _, hp, ptp, rfl⟩
      have pr := I.mem_ofTerm_pair.2 ⟨rfl, _, h1, _, mkFst_tp .., _, hB, _, h2, mkSnd_tp .., by simp⟩
      ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hP, _, hp, pr, ptp⟩

name: EqTmIH.code_el
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.code_el {Γ a l} :
    I.WfTmIH Γ (l + 1) (Expr.univ l) a → I.EqTmIH Γ (l + 1) (Expr.univ l) a a.el.code
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, _, ha, atp⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨_, eq⟩
proof:
:= I.mem_ofType_univ.1 hA; simp at eq; subst eq
    exact
      have h1 := I.mem_ofType_el.2 ⟨_, _, ha, atp, rfl⟩
      ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _, hA, _, ha, I.mem_ofTerm_code.2 ⟨_, rfl, _, h1, by simp⟩, atp⟩

name: EqTmIH.conv
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.conv {Γ A A' t t' l} : I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t' → I.EqTpIH Γ l A A' → I.EqTmIH Γ l A' t t'
  | ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA, ht⟩, ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, hA₁, hA'⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique hA hA₁
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, _, _, hA', ht⟩

name: EqTmIH.trans
statement:
theorem EqTmIH.trans {Γ A t t' t'' l} :
    I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t' → I.EqTmIH Γ l A t' t'' → I.EqTmIH Γ l A t t''
  | ⟨_, hΓ, hl, _, hA, _, ht, ht', ttp⟩, ⟨_, hΓ₁, _, _, _, _, ht'₁, ht'', _⟩ => by
    cases Part.mem_unique hΓ hΓ₁
    cases Part.mem_unique ht' ht'₁
    exact ⟨_, hΓ, hl, _, hA, _, ht, ht'', ttp⟩

/
structure Wf (I : Interpretation χ s) (E : Axioms χ) : Prop where
  ax {c Al} (Ec : E c = some Al) :
    ∃ sc, I.ax c Al.1.2 = some sc ∧
    ∃ sA : y(𝟭_ 𝒞) ⟶ s[Al.1.2].Ty,
      sA ∈ I.ofType s.nilCObj Al.1.2 Al.1.1 ∧
      sc ≫ s[Al.1.2].tp = sA

variable {E : Axioms χ} {slen} [Iwf : Fact (I.Wf slen E)]
include Iwf

name: WfTmIH.ax
statement:
theorem WfTmIH.ax {Γ c Al} (Ec : E c = some Al) :
    I.WfCtxIH Γ → I.WfTmIH Γ Al.val.2 Al.val.1 (Expr.ax c Al.val.1)
  | ⟨Γ, hΓ⟩ => by
    have ⟨_, eq, _, sA, sA_tp⟩
proof:
:= Iwf.out.ax Ec
    have := I.mem_ofType_of_isClosed Al.2.1 Γ (by omega) sA
    refine ⟨_, hΓ, by omega, _, this, ?_⟩
    simp [ofTerm, eq, sA_tp]

name: ofType_ofTerm_sound
statement:
theorem ofType_ofTerm_sound :
    (∀ {Γ}, WfCtx E Γ → I.WfCtxIH Γ) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A}, (Awf : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) → I.WfTpIH Γ l A) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A B}, (Aeq : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B) → I.EqTpIH Γ l A B) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t}, (twf : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) → I.WfTmIH Γ l A t) ∧
    (∀ {Γ l A t u}, (teq : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A) → I.EqTmIH Γ l A t u)
proof:
:= by
  mutual_induction WfCtx

  case nil => exact .nil
  case snoc => exact fun _ _ _ => .snoc

  case pi' => exact fun _ _ h1 h2 => (h1.refl.pi h2.refl).left
  case sigma' => exact fun _ _ h1 h2 => (h1.refl.sigma h2.refl).left
  case Id' => exact fun _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h1.refl.Id h2.refl h3.refl).left
  case univ => exact fun _ => .univ slen
  case el => exact fun _ h1 => (EqTpIH.el h1.refl).left

  case cong_pi' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => .pi
  case cong_sigma' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => .sigma
  case cong_Id => exact fun _ _ _ => .Id
  case cong_el => exact fun _ => .el
  case el_code => exact fun h _ => .el_code slen h
  case refl_tp => exact fun _ h => h.refl
  case symm_tp => exact fun _ => .symm
  case trans_tp => exact fun _ _ => .trans

  case ax => exact fun _ Ec _ h _ => .ax Ec h
  case bvar => exact fun _ => .bvar
  case lam' => exact fun _ _ h1 h2 => (h2.refl.lam h1.refl).left
  case app' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h2.refl.app h1.refl h3.refl).left
  case pair' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h2.refl.pair h1.refl h3.refl).left
  case fst' => exact fun _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h3.refl.fst_snd h1.refl h2.refl).1.left
  case snd' => exact fun _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h3.refl.fst_snd h1.refl h2.refl).2.left
  case refl' => exact fun _ _ _ h1 => h1.refl.refl_tm.left
  case idRec' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 =>
    (h1.refl.idRec h2.refl h3.refl h4.refl h5.refl).left
  case code => exact fun h _ h1 => (EqTmIH.code slen h h1.refl).left
  case conv => exact fun _ _ h1 h2 => (h1.refl.conv h2).left

  case cong_lam' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => .lam
  case cong_app' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ => .app
  case cong_pair' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ => .pair
  case cong_fst' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h3.fst_snd h1 h2).1
  case cong_snd' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (h3.fst_snd h1 h2).2
  case cong_refl' => exact fun _ _ _ => .refl_tm
  case cong_idRec' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => .idRec
  case cong_code => exact fun h _ => .code slen h
  case app_lam' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => .app_lam
  case fst_pair' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (EqTmIH.fst_snd_pair h1 h2 h3).1
  case snd_pair' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 => (EqTmIH.fst_snd_pair h1 h2 h3).2
  case idRec_refl' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ => .idRec_refl
  case lam_app' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ => .lam_app
  case pair_fst_snd' => exact fun _ _ _ _ _ => .pair_fst_snd
  case code_el => exact fun _ => .code_el
  case conv_eq => exact fun _ _ => .conv
  case refl_tm => exact fun _ h => h.refl
  case symm_tm' => exact fun _ _ _ => .symm
  case trans_tm' => exact fun _ _ _ _ => .trans

name: interpCtx_mem
statement: @[simp] theorem interpCtx_mem (H : WfCtx E Γ) : I.interpCtx H ∈ I.ofCtx Γ

name: interpTy_mem
statement: @[simp] theorem interpTy_mem (H : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A) : I.interpTy H ∈ I.ofType _ l A

name: interpTy_eq
statement:
theorem interpTy_eq (H : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] A ≡ B) :
    I.interpTy H.wf_left = I.interpTy H.wf_right
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨_, h1, _, _, ⟨_, eq⟩, _, rfl⟩ := I.ofType_ofTerm_sound.2.2.1 H
  unfold interpTy
  cases Part.mem_unique (I.interpCtx_mem H.wf_ctx) h1
  exact eq

name: interpTm_mem
statement: @[simp] theorem interpTm_mem (H : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) : I.interpTm H ∈ I.ofTerm _ l t

name: interpTm_tp
statement:
@[simp] theorem interpTm_tp (H : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t : A) :
    I.interpTm H ≫ (s[l]'(H.lt_slen slen)).tp = I.interpTy H.wf_tp
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨_, h1, _, _, ⟨_, rfl⟩, _, ⟨_, rfl⟩, h2⟩ := I.ofType_ofTerm_sound.2.2.2.1 H
  cases Part.mem_unique (I.interpCtx_mem H.wf_ctx) h1
  exact h2

name: interpTm_eq
statement:
theorem interpTm_eq (H : E ∣ Γ ⊢[l] t ≡ u : A) :
    I.interpTm H.wf_left = I.interpTm H.wf_right
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨_, h1, _, _, _, _, ⟨_, h2⟩, ⟨_, rfl⟩, _⟩ := I.ofType_ofTerm_sound.2.2.2.2 H
  cases Part.mem_unique (I.interpCtx_mem H.wf_ctx) h1
  exact h2

name: UHom.comp_wkU
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem UHom.comp_wkU {M N : UnstructuredUniverse Ctx} {Δ Γ : Ctx} (α : UHom M N) (f : (Δ) ⟶ (Γ)) :
    f ≫ α.wkU Γ = α.wkU Δ

name: Hom.extCompMapTyIsoExt_hom_comp_substWk
statement:
lemma Hom.extCompMapTyIsoExt_hom_comp_substWk  :
    (α.extCompMapTyIsoExt σA).hom ≫ M.substWk σ A σA eq =
    N.substWk σ (A ≫ α.mapTy) (σA ≫ α.mapTy) (by simp [← eq]) ≫ (α.extCompMapTyIsoExt A).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext
  · apply α.pb.hom_ext
    · simp [extCompMapTyIsoExt]
    · simp [eq, extCompMapTyIsoExt]
  · simp [extCompMapTyIsoExt]

name: hom_comp_trans
statement:
theorem hom_comp_trans (s : UHomSeq Ctx) (i j k : Nat) (ij : i < j) (jk : j < k)
    (klen : k < s.length + 1) :
    (s.hom i j ij).comp (s.hom j k jk) = s.hom i k (ij.trans jk)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => unfold hom
  conv in s.hom i j _ => unfold hom
  split_ifs
  all_goals try omega
  . rename_i h _
    cases h
    simp
  . rw [UHom.comp_assoc, hom_comp_trans]

name: unlift_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unlift_tp {i j ij jlen Γ A}
    {t : (Γ) ⟶ _} (eq : t ≫ s[j].tp = A ≫ (s.homOfLe i j).mapTy) :
    s.unlift i j ij jlen A t eq ≫ (s[i]'(ij.trans_lt jlen)).tp = A

name: unlift_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unlift_lift {i j ij jlen Γ A}
    {t : (Γ) ⟶ _} (eq : t ≫ s[j].tp = A ≫ (s.homOfLe i j).mapTy) :
    s.unlift i j ij jlen A t eq ≫ (s.homOfLe i j).mapTm = t

name: unliftVar_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unliftVar_tp {i j ij jlen Γ A} {A' : (Γ) ⟶ s[j].Ty}
    (eq : A ≫ (s.homOfLe i j).mapTy = A') :
    s.unliftVar i j ij jlen A eq ≫ (s[i]'(ij.trans_lt jlen)).tp = (s[j].disp _) ≫ A

name: substCons_unliftVar
proof:
:= by
  simp [unlift, unliftVar]; apply (s.homOfLe i j).pb.hom_ext <;> simp [*]

name: code_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem code_tp {Γ : Ctx} {i : Nat} (s : UHomSeq Ctx) (ilen : i < s.length) (A : (Γ) ⟶ s[i].Ty) :
    s.code ilen A ≫ s[i+1].tp = (s.homSucc i).wkU Γ

name: comp_code
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_code {Δ Γ : Ctx} {i : Nat} (s : UHomSeq Ctx) (ilen : i < s.length)
    (σ : (Δ) ⟶ (Γ)) (A : (Γ) ⟶ s[i].Ty) :
    σ ≫ s.code ilen A = s.code ilen (σ ≫ A)

name: comp_el
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_el (s : UHomSeq Ctx) {Δ Γ : Ctx} {i : Nat} (ilen : i < s.length)
    (σ : (Δ) ⟶ (Γ)) (a : (Γ) ⟶ s[i+1].Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ s[i+1].tp = (s.homSucc i).wkU Γ) :
    σ ≫ s.el ilen a a_tp = s.el ilen (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp])

name: el_code
statement:
@[simp]
lemma el_code {Γ : Ctx} {i : Nat} (s : UHomSeq Ctx) (ilen : i < s.length) (A : (Γ) ⟶ s[i].Ty) :
    el s ilen (code s ilen A) (code_tp _ _ _) = A

name: code_el
statement:
@[simp]
lemma code_el (s : UHomSeq Ctx) {Γ : Ctx} {i : Nat} (ilen : i < s.length)
    (a : (Γ) ⟶ s[i+1].Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ s[i+1].tp = (s.homSucc i).wkU Γ) :
    code s ilen (el s ilen a a_tp) = a

name: symm_symm'
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma symm_symm' : cyl.symm ≫ cyl.symm = 𝟙 _

name: whiskerRight_
statement:
lemma whiskerRight_δ0_I_symm : whiskerRight cyl.δ0 cyl.I ≫ cyl.symm =
    whiskerLeft cyl.I cyl.δ0

name: whiskerRight_
statement:
lemma whiskerRight_δ1_I_symm : whiskerRight cyl.δ1 cyl.I ≫ cyl.symm =
    whiskerLeft cyl.I cyl.δ1

name: I_map_
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma I_map_δ0_app_comp_symm_app (X) : cyl.I.map (cyl.δ0.app X) ≫ cyl.symm.app X = cyl.δ0.app _

name: I_map_
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma I_map_δ1_app_comp_symm_app (X) : cyl.I.map (cyl.δ1.app X) ≫ cyl.symm.app X = cyl.δ1.app _

name: symm_
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma symm_π_π'_app (X) : cyl.symm.app X ≫ cyl.π.app (cyl.I.obj X) ≫ cyl.π.app X =
    cyl.π.app (cyl.I.obj X) ≫ cyl.π.app X

name: Hurewicz.lift_comp_self'
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma Hurewicz.lift_comp_self' {Γ} (y : Γ ⟶ Y) (p : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ X)
    (comm_sq : y ≫ f = cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p) : hrwcz.lift y p comm_sq ≫ f = p

name: Hurewicz.
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma Hurewicz.δ0_comp_lift' {Γ} (y : Γ ⟶ Y) (p : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ X)
    (comm_sq : y ≫ f = cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p) : cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ hrwcz.lift y p comm_sq = y

name: Hurewicz.lift_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hurewicz.lift_comp [IsUniform hrwcz] {Γ Δ} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (y : Γ ⟶ Y) (p : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ X)
    (comm_sq : y ≫ f = cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p) : hrwcz.lift (σ ≫ y) (cyl.I.map σ ≫ p)
    (by simp [comm_sq, δ0_naturality_assoc]) = cyl.I.map σ ≫ hrwcz.lift y p comm_sq

name: Hurewicz.isNormal
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hurewicz.isNormal [IsNormal hrwcz] {Γ} (y : Γ ⟶ Y) (p : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ X)
    (comm_sq : y ≫ f = cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p) (x : Γ ⟶ X) (hp : p = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ x) :
    hrwcz.lift y p comm_sq = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ y
proof:
:=
  IsNormal.isNormal y p comm_sq x hp

name: path_tp'
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma path_tp' {Γ} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (a0 a1 : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (p : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ U0.Tm)
    (p_tp : p ≫ U0.tp = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ A) (δ0_p : cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p = a0)
    (δ1_p : cyl.δ1.app Γ ≫ p = a1) : P0.path p p_tp ≫ U0.tp =
    P0.Path (A := A) a0 a1 (by simp [← δ0_p, p_tp]) (by simp [← δ1_p, p_tp])
proof:
:=
  P0.path_tp a0 a1 p p_tp δ0_p δ1_p

name: unpath_tp'
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma unpath_tp' {Γ} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (a0 a1 : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (a0_tp : a0 ≫ U0.tp = A)
    (a1_tp : a1 ≫ U0.tp = A) (p : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (p_tp : p ≫ U0.tp = P0.Path a0 a1 a0_tp a1_tp) :
    P0.unpath a0 a1 a0_tp a1_tp p p_tp ≫ U0.tp = cyl.π.app _ ≫ A

name: unpath_path'
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma unpath_path' {Γ} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (a0 a1 : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (p : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ U0.Tm)
    (p_tp : p ≫ U0.tp = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ A) (δ0_p : cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p = a0)
    (δ1_p : cyl.δ1.app Γ ≫ p = a1) :
    P0.unpath (A := A) a0 (a1) (by simp [← δ0_p, p_tp]) (by simp [← δ1_p, p_tp])
    (P0.path p p_tp) (P0.path_tp a0 a1 p p_tp δ0_p δ1_p) = p
proof:
:=
  P0.unpath_path a0 a1 p p_tp δ0_p δ1_p

name: path_unpath'
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma path_unpath' {Γ} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (a0 a1 : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (a0_tp : a0 ≫ U0.tp = A)
    (a1_tp : a1 ≫ U0.tp = A) (p : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (p_tp : p ≫ U0.tp = P0.Path a0 a1 a0_tp a1_tp) :
    P0.path (A := A) (P0.unpath a0 a1 a0_tp a1_tp p p_tp) (P0.unpath_tp ..) = p

name: unpath_ext
statement:
lemma unpath_ext {Γ} (A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty) (a0 a1 : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (p1 p2 : cyl.I.obj Γ ⟶ U0.Tm)
    (p1_tp : p1 ≫ U0.tp = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ A) (p2_tp : p2 ≫ U0.tp = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ A)
    (h : P0.path p1 p1_tp = P0.path p2 p2_tp)
    (δ0_p1 : cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p1 = a0) (δ1_p1 : cyl.δ1.app Γ ≫ p1 = a1)
    (δ0_p2 : cyl.δ0.app Γ ≫ p2 = a0) (δ1_p2 : cyl.δ1.app Γ ≫ p2 = a1) : p1 = p2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P0.unpath_path (A := A) a0 a1 p1 p1_tp δ0_p1 δ1_p1]
  rw [← P0.unpath_path a0 a1 p2 p2_tp δ0_p2 δ1_p2]
  rw! [h]

name: unpath_comp
statement:
lemma unpath_comp {Γ Δ} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (a0 a1 : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (a0_tp : a0 ≫ U0.tp = A)
    (a1_tp : a1 ≫ U0.tp = A) (p : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (p_tp : p ≫ U0.tp = P0.Path a0 a1 a0_tp a1_tp) :
    P0.unpath (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a0) (σ ≫ a1) (by simp [a0_tp]) (by simp [a1_tp]) (σ ≫ p)
    (by simp [p_tp, ← Path_comp]) = cyl.I.map σ ≫ P0.unpath a0 a1 a0_tp a1_tp p p_tp
proof:
:= by
  apply P0.unpath_ext (σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a0) (σ ≫ a1) <;> simp [path_comp, δ0_naturality_assoc,
    δ1_naturality_assoc]

name: substConsEv_disp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma substConsEv_disp : P0.substConsEv a a_tp ≫ disp .. = cyl.π.app _ ≫ U0.disp _ ≫ U0.disp A

name: substConsEv_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma substConsEv_var : P0.substConsEv a a_tp ≫ var .. = P0.unpath (A := disp .. ≫ disp .. ≫ A)
    (U0.disp .. ≫ U0.disp A ≫ a) (U0.disp .. ≫ U0.var A)
    (by cat_disch) (by simp) (U0.var ..) (by simp [← Path_comp])

name: substConsEv_comp_substWk
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma substConsEv_comp_substWk : P0.substConsEv (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp]) ≫
    U0.substWk σ A =
    cyl.I.map (U0.substWk (U0.substWk σ A) (weakenId _ a a_tp) _ ((weakenId_comp ..).symm)) ≫
    P0.substConsEv a a_tp

name: I_map_reflInst_comp_substConsEv
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma I_map_reflInst_comp_substConsEv : cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp) ≫
    P0.substConsEv a a_tp = cyl.π.app Γ ≫ U0.sec A a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext <;> simp [substConsEv, reflInst, ← unpath_comp, motiveInst]

name: connectionLift_comp
statement:
lemma connectionLift_comp [hrwcz0.IsUniform] :
    P0.connectionLift hrwcz0 (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp]) =
    cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveSubst σ a a_tp) ≫
    P0.connectionLift hrwcz0 a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  simp only [motiveCtx, polymorphicIdIntro_Id, connectionLift, polymorphicIdIntro_refl,
    Functor.id_obj, ← path_comp, NatTrans.naturality_assoc, Functor.id_map, weakenId, motiveSubst,
    ← Hurewicz.lift_comp, substWk_disp_assoc]
  congr 1
  erw [← P0.substConsEv_comp_substWk_assoc]
  simp [← Path_comp]

name: I_map_reflInst_comp_connectionLift
statement:
lemma I_map_reflInst_comp_connectionLift [hrwcz0.IsUniform] [hrwcz0.IsNormal] :
    cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp) ≫ P0.connectionLift hrwcz0 a a_tp =
    P0.path (A := cyl.π.app Γ ≫ A) (cyl.π.app _ ≫ cyl.π.app Γ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [connectionLift]
  rw [← Hurewicz.lift_comp]
  rw [hrwcz0.isNormal _ _ _ (U0.sec A a a_tp ≫ P0.Path (A := U0.disp A ≫ A) (U0.disp A ≫ a)
    (U0.var A) (by simp [a_tp]) (by simp))]
  · simp [← path_comp, reflInst, motiveInst]
  · simp [I_map_reflInst_comp_substConsEv_assoc]

name: connection_tp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma connection_tp : P0.connection hrwcz0 a a_tp ≫ U0.tp =
    cyl.π.app (cyl.I.obj (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveCtx a a_tp)) ≫
    cyl.π.app (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveCtx a a_tp) ≫
    U0.disp (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.weakenId a a_tp) ≫ U0.disp A ≫ A

name: I_
statement:
@[simp]
lemma I_δ0_connection : cyl.I.map (cyl.δ0.app _) ≫ P0.connection hrwcz0 a a_tp =
    cyl.π.app _ ≫ disp .. ≫ U0.disp A ≫ a
proof:
:= by
  fapply P0.unpath_ext (disp .. ≫ U0.disp A ≫ A) (disp .. ≫ U0.disp A ≫ a) (disp .. ≫ U0.disp A ≫ a)
    <;> simp [a_tp, connection, ← unpath_comp]
  erw [δ0_connectionLift] 
  simp [← path_comp]

name: connection_comp
statement:
lemma connection_comp [hrwcz0.IsUniform] :
    P0.connection hrwcz0 (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp]) =
    cyl.I.map (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveSubst σ a a_tp)) ≫
    P0.connection hrwcz0 (a) a_tp
proof:
:= by
  simp only [connection]
  rw! [connectionLift_comp _ _ _ _ a_tp]
  simp [← unpath_comp, motiveSubst]

name: I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_connection
statement:
lemma I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_connection [hrwcz0.IsUniform] [hrwcz0.IsNormal] :
    cyl.I.map (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp)) ≫ P0.connection hrwcz0 a a_tp =
    cyl.π.app (cyl.I.obj Γ) ≫ cyl.π.app Γ ≫ a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [connection, unpath']
  fapply P0.unpath_ext
    (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp) ≫ P0.substConsEv a a_tp ≫ U0.disp A ≫ A)
    (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp) ≫ P0.substConsEv a a_tp ≫ U0.disp A ≫ a)
    (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp) ≫ P0.substConsEv a a_tp ≫ U0.var A)
    <;> simp [a_tp, ← unpath_comp, reflInst, motiveInst]
  erw [I_map_reflInst_comp_connectionLift]

name: symmConnection_tp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma symmConnection_tp : P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp ≫ U0.tp =
    cyl.π.app (cyl.I.obj (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveCtx a a_tp)) ≫
    cyl.π.app (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveCtx a a_tp) ≫
    U0.disp (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.weakenId a a_tp) ≫ U0.disp A ≫ A

name: I_
statement:
@[simp]
lemma I_δ0_symmConnection : cyl.I.map (cyl.δ0.app _) ≫ P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp =
    cyl.π.app _ ≫ disp .. ≫ U0.disp A ≫ a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [motiveCtx, Functor.id_obj, symmConnection, Functor.comp_obj,
    I_map_δ0_app_comp_symm_app_assoc]
  erw [δ0_connection]

name: I_
statement:
@[simp]
lemma I_δ1_symmConnection : cyl.I.map (cyl.δ1.app _) ≫ P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp =
    P0.ev a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  simp only [motiveCtx, polymorphicIdIntro_Id, Functor.id_obj, symmConnection, Functor.comp_obj,
    I_map_δ1_app_comp_symm_app_assoc]
  erw [δ1_connection]

name: I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_symmConnection
statement:
lemma I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_symmConnection [hrwcz0.IsUniform] [hrwcz0.IsNormal] :
    cyl.I.map (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp)) ≫
    P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp = cyl.π.app (cyl.I.obj Γ) ≫ cyl.π.app Γ ≫ a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmConnection]
  erw [cyl.symm.naturality_assoc]
  simp [I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_connection, symm_π_π'_app_assoc]

name: symmConnection_comp
statement:
lemma symmConnection_comp [hrwcz0.IsUniform] :
    P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp]) =
    cyl.I.map (cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.motiveSubst σ a a_tp)) ≫
    P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  have := cyl.symm.naturality_assoc
  simp at this
  simp [symmConnection, connection_comp _ _ _ _ a_tp, ← this]

name: pathSymmConnection_tp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pathSymmConnection_tp : P0.pathSymmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp ≫ U0.tp =
    P0.Path (A := cyl.π.app _ ≫ disp .. ≫ disp .. ≫ A)
    (cyl.π.app _ ≫ disp .. ≫ disp .. ≫ a) (cyl.δ1.app _ ≫ P0.symmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp)
    (by simp [a_tp]) (by simp)

name: pathSymmConnection_comp
statement:
lemma pathSymmConnection_comp [hrwcz0.IsUniform] :
    P0.pathSymmConnection hrwcz0 (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp]) =
    cyl.I.map (U0.substWk (U0.substWk σ _ _ rfl) _ _ (by rw [weakenId_comp])) ≫
    P0.pathSymmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathSymmConnection, ← path_comp, symmConnection_comp _ _ _ _ a_tp, motiveSubst]

name: I_map_reflInst_comp_pathSymmConnection
statement:
lemma I_map_reflInst_comp_pathSymmConnection [hrwcz0.IsUniform] [hrwcz0.IsNormal] :
    cyl.I.map (P0.polymorphicIdIntro.reflInst a a_tp) ≫ P0.pathSymmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp =
    cyl.π.app Γ ≫ P0.path (A := A) (cyl.π.app Γ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathSymmConnection, ← path_comp]
  congr 1
  · simp [reflInst, motiveInst]
  · simp [I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_symmConnection]

name: substConnection_var
statement:
@[simp]
lemma substConnection_var : P0.substConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp ≫ var .. =
    P0.pathSymmConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp

name: substConnection_comp_motiveSubst
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma substConnection_comp_motiveSubst [hrwcz0.IsUniform] :
    P0.substConnection hrwcz0 (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp]) ≫ motiveSubst _ σ a a_tp rfl =
    cyl.I.map (motiveSubst _ σ a a_tp) ≫ P0.substConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polymorphicIdIntro_Id, motiveCtx, motiveSubst]
  apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, substWk_var]
    erw [substConnection_var]
    simp [substConnection, pathSymmConnection_comp _ _ _ _ a_tp]
  · apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext
    · simp [substConnection, symmConnection_comp _ _ _ _ a_tp, δ1_naturality_assoc, motiveSubst]
    · simp [substConnection]

name: reflInst_comp_substConnection
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma reflInst_comp_substConnection [hrwcz0.IsUniform] [hrwcz0.IsNormal] :
    cyl.I.map (reflInst _ a a_tp) ≫
    P0.substConnection hrwcz0 a a_tp = cyl.π.app _ ≫ reflInst _ a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substConnection]
  apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext
  · simp [I_map_reflInst_comp_pathSymmConnection]
  · apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext
    · simp [← δ1_naturality_assoc, I_map_I_map_reflInst_comp_symmConnection]
    · simp [reflInst, motiveInst]

name: var_tp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem var_tp {Γ : Ctx} (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) : M.var A ≫ M.tp = (M.disp A) ≫ A

name: substCons_disp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem substCons_disp {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (t : Δ ⟶ M.Tm)
    (tTp : t ≫ M.tp = σ ≫ A) :
    M.substCons σ A t tTp ≫ M.disp A = σ

name: substCons_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem substCons_var {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (t : Δ ⟶ M.Tm)
    (aTp : t ≫ M.tp = σ ≫ A) :
    M.substCons σ A t aTp ≫ M.var A = t

name: comp_substCons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_substCons {Θ Δ Γ : Ctx} (τ : Θ ⟶ Δ) (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (t : Δ ⟶ M.Tm)
    (aTp : t ≫ M.tp = σ ≫ A) :
    τ ≫ M.substCons σ A t aTp = M.substCons (τ ≫ σ) A (τ ≫ t) (by simp [*])

name: substCons_apply_comp_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem substCons_apply_comp_var {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (s : Δ ⟶ M.ext A)
    (s_tp : s ≫ M.disp A = σ) :
    M.substCons σ A (s ≫ M.var A) (by rw [Category.assoc, var_tp, ← Category.assoc, s_tp]) =
    s

name: substSnd_tp
statement:
theorem substSnd_tp {Δ Γ : Ctx} {A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty} (σ : Δ ⟶ M.ext A) :
    M.substSnd σ ≫ M.tp = (M.substFst σ) ≫ A

name: substWk_disp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem substWk_disp {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (A' eq) :
    M.substWk σ A A' eq ≫ M.disp A = M.disp A' ≫ σ

name: substWk_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem substWk_var {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (A' eq) :
    M.substWk σ A A' eq ≫ M.var A = M.var A'

name: var_comp
statement:
lemma var_comp {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) : M.var (σ ≫ A) =
    M.substWk σ A ≫ M.var A

name: sec_disp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem sec_disp {Γ : Ctx} (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (a : Γ ⟶ M.Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ M.tp = A) :
    M.sec A a a_tp ≫ M.disp A = 𝟙 _

name: sec_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem sec_var {Γ : Ctx} (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (a : Γ ⟶ M.Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ M.tp = A) :
    M.sec A a a_tp ≫ M.var A = a

name: comp_sec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_sec {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty) (σA) (eq : σ ≫ A = σA)
    (a : Γ ⟶ M.Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ M.tp = A) :
    σ ≫ M.sec A a a_tp = M.sec σA (σ ≫ a) (by simp [eq, a_tp]) ≫ M.substWk σ A _ eq

name: sec_apply_comp_var
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem sec_apply_comp_var {Γ : Ctx} (A : Γ ⟶ M.Ty)
    (s : Γ ⟶ M.ext A) (s_tp : s ≫ M.disp A = 𝟙 _) :
    M.sec A (s ≫ M.var A) (by rw [Category.assoc, var_tp, ← Category.assoc, s_tp]; simp) = s

name: fst_comp
statement:
lemma fst_comp {Γ Δ} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} {σA} (eq) {B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty}
    (s : Γ ⟶ U2.Tm) (s_tp : s ≫ U2.tp = S.Sig B) :
    S.fst (U0.substWk σ A σA eq ≫ B) (σ ≫ s) (by simp [s_tp, S.Sig_comp]) =
    σ ≫ S.fst B s s_tp
proof:
:= by
  rw! [(S.pair_fst_snd B s (by simp [s_tp])).symm, ← S.pair_comp, S.fst_pair, S.fst_pair]

name: snd_comp
statement:
lemma snd_comp {Γ Δ} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} {σA} (eq) {B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty}
    (s : Γ ⟶ U2.Tm) (s_tp : s ≫ U2.tp = S.Sig B) :
    S.snd (U0.substWk σ A σA eq ≫ B) (σ ≫ s) (by simp [s_tp, S.Sig_comp]) =
    σ ≫ S.snd B s s_tp
proof:
:= by
  rw! [(S.pair_fst_snd B s (by simp [s_tp])).symm, ← S.pair_comp, S.snd_pair, S.snd_pair]

name: unLam_comp
statement:
lemma unLam_comp {Γ Δ} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ) {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} {σA} (eq) {B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty}
    (f : Γ ⟶ U2.Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ U2.tp = P.Pi B) :
    P.unLam (U0.substWk σ A σA eq ≫ B) (σ ≫ f) (by simp [f_tp, P.Pi_comp]) =
    U0.substWk σ A σA eq ≫ P.unLam B f f_tp
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.unLam_lam (U0.substWk σ A σA eq ≫ B) (U0.substWk σ A σA eq ≫ P.unLam B f f_tp)]
  . rw! [P.lam_comp σ eq B, P.lam_unLam]
  . rw [Category.assoc, P.unLam_tp]

name: app_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem app_tp {Γ : Ctx} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty)
    (f : Γ ⟶ U2.Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ U2.tp = P.Pi B)
    (a : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ U0.tp = A) :
    P.app B f f_tp a a_tp ≫ U1.tp = (U0.sec A a a_tp) ≫ B

name: app_comp
statement:
theorem app_comp {Δ Γ : Ctx} (σ : Δ ⟶ Γ)
    {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (σA) (eq : σ ≫ A = σA)
    (B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty)
    (f : Γ ⟶ U2.Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ U2.tp = P.Pi B)
    (a : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ U0.tp = A) :
      P.app (U0.substWk σ A _ eq ≫ B)
        (σ ≫ f) (by simp [f_tp, Pi_comp])
        (σ ≫ a) (by simp [a_tp, eq]) =
      σ ≫ P.app B f f_tp a a_tp
proof:
:= by
  rw [app, app, reassoc_of% comp_sec, unLam_comp]

name: app_lam
statement:
@[simp]
theorem app_lam {Γ : Ctx} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty)
    (t : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Tm) (t_tp : t ≫ U1.tp = B)
    (a : Γ ⟶ U0.Tm) (a_tp : a ≫ U0.tp = A) :
    P.app B (P.lam B t t_tp) (by simp) a a_tp = U0.sec A a a_tp ≫ t

name: etaExpand_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem etaExpand_eq {Γ : Ctx} {A : Γ ⟶ U0.Ty} (B : U0.ext A ⟶ U1.Ty)
    (f : Γ ⟶ U2.Tm) (f_tp : f ≫ U2.tp = P.Pi B) :
    P.etaExpand B f f_tp = f
proof:
:= by
  unfold etaExpand
  convert P.lam_unLam B f f_tp using 2
  rw [app, unLam_comp (f_tp := f_tp), substWk, reassoc_of% comp_substCons]
  simp [substCons]

name: weakenId_comp
statement:
lemma weakenId_comp :
    i.weakenId (A := σ ≫ A) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [*]) =
    U0.substWk σ A ≫ i.weakenId a a_tp

name: motiveInst_comp_motiveSubst
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma motiveInst_comp_motiveSubst
    {σA} (σA_eq : σA = σ ≫ A := by rfl) :
    i.motiveInst (σ ≫ a) (by simp [*]) (σ ≫ b) (by simp [*]) (σ ≫ h) (by simp [*, Id_comp]) ≫
      i.motiveSubst σ a a_tp σA_eq =
    σ ≫ i.motiveInst a a_tp b b_tp h h_tp
proof:
:= by
  subst a_tp σA_eq
  repeat any_goals apply (disp_pullback ..).hom_ext
  any_goals simp [substWk_disp]

name: reflInst_comp_motiveSubst
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma reflInst_comp_motiveSubst {σA} (σA_eq : σA = σ ≫ A := by rfl) :
    i.reflInst (A := σA) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [*]) ≫ i.motiveSubst σ a a_tp σA_eq =
    σ ≫ i.reflInst a a_tp

name: idRec_comp
statement:
theorem idRec_comp (σA) (σA_eq : σ ≫ A = σA)
    (σI) (σI_eq : U0.substWk σ A σA σA_eq ≫ I = σI) :
    e.idRec (A := σA) (σ ≫ a) (by simp [*])
      σI (by simp [← Id_comp, ← σI_eq, *])
      (U1.substWk (U0.substWk σ _ _ σA_eq) _ _ σI_eq ≫ M)
      (σ ≫ r) (by
        rw [Category.assoc, r_tp]
        simp only [← Category.assoc]; congr 1
        apply (U1.disp_pullback _).hom_ext <;>
          simp [← refl_comp, comp_sec, *])
      (σ ≫ b) (by simp [*])
      (σ ≫ h) (by simp [*, ← Id_comp]) =
    σ ≫ e.idRec a a_tp I I_eq M r r_tp b b_tp h h_tp
proof:
:= by
  unfold idRec
  slice_rhs 1 2 => rw [← motiveInst_comp_motiveSubst]
  slice_rhs 2 3 => rw [← jElim_comp]
  cases I_eq
  have : σI =
      i.Id (A := U0.disp σA ≫ σA) (U0.disp σA ≫ σ ≫ a) (U0.var σA) (by simp [*]) (by simp) := by
    cases σI_eq; simp [← Id_comp, *]
  cases this; cases σA_eq
  simp

name: idRec_tp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idRec_tp :
    e.idRec a a_tp I I_eq M r r_tp b b_tp h h_tp ≫ U2.tp =
      U1.substCons (U0.sec A b b_tp) I h (by simp [h_tp, I_eq, ← Id_comp]) ≫ M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [idRec, Category.assoc, jElim_tp]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [I_eq]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]; congr 1
  simp [motiveInst, sec]

name: idRec_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idRec_refl :
    e.idRec a a_tp I I_eq M r r_tp a a_tp (i.refl a a_tp) (by simp) = r
